title: Radiographer fracture detection with and without AI assistance in prospective emergency department use
zh_title: 急诊放射技师骨折检测：AI辅助前后前瞻对比
summary: 单中心三个月前瞻部署，13名放射技师独立判读2496例肌骨影像，AI辅助使准确率由97.6%升至98.0%，净纠正10例错误。
key_points: 单中心前瞻部署，2496例配对判读
AI单独敏感度75.6%，隐匿骨折仅46.2%
技师基线敏感度91.6%，AI辅助准确率小幅提升
reason: 前瞻性真实世界部署、大样本、报告工作流效果，属重要档
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems for fracture detection perform strongly in controlled settings, but prospective real-world evidence is limited. In a three-month deployment in one emergency department, thirteen radiographers in a radiographer-led screening programme independently interpreted 2496 consecutive musculoskeletal examinations (one radiographer per examination), reviewed output from a commercial deep-learning system, then recorded a final decision, giving 2496 paired reads against a radiologist reference standard. Standalone AI sensitivity was 75.6%, falling to 46.2% for subtle fractures, below the radiographers’ baseline sensitivity of 91.6%. Radiographers’ baseline accuracy was high (97.6%; specificity 99.0%) and improved modestly with AI assistance (98.0%; exact McNemar p = 0.0064). With AI assistance, radiographers corrected 11 errors and introduced 1, a net gain of 10 cases. Subgroup gains were directionally consistent but not significant after correction. Radiographers changed their decision in only 11 of 729 discordant cases, and most negative interactions were correct AI recommendations not adopted. No or incomplete AI output was returned for 8.8% of acquired examinations. AI assistance delivered a small, selective benefit arising from complementary rather than superior algorithmic performance. Operational reliability proved as consequential as diagnostic accuracy, and behavioural inferences rest on few events. Downstream clinical outcomes were not measured.
zh_abstract: 用于骨折检测的人工智能（AI）系统在受控环境中表现强劲，但前瞻性真实世界证据有限。在一个急诊科为期三个月的部署中，13名放射技师在一个由放射技师主导的筛查项目中独立判读了2496次连续的肌肉骨骼检查（每次检查由一名放射技师判读），审阅了一个商业深度学习系统的输出，然后记录最终决定，从而产生2496次配对判读，以放射科医生参考标准为对照。独立AI的敏感性为75.6%，对于细微骨折降至46.2%，低于放射技师91.6%的基线敏感性。放射技师的基线准确率很高（97.6%；特异性99.0%），并在AI辅助下略有提高（98.0%；精确McNemar p = 0.0064）。在AI辅助下，放射技师纠正了11个错误并引入了1个错误，净增益为10例。亚组增益方向一致，但校正后不显著。放射技师仅在729例不一致病例中的11例改变了决定，大多数负向交互是未采纳正确的AI建议。8.8%的采集检查未返回AI输出或返回不完整。AI辅助带来了小幅、选择性的获益，其来源是互补而非更优的算法性能。运行可靠性被证明与诊断准确性同样重要，而行为推断仅基于少数事件。未测量下游临床结局。

title: An interpretable graph reasoning framework for enhanced diagnosis in fundus fluorescein angiography
zh_title: FFA-RGNet：眼底荧光造影可解释图推理框架
summary: FFA-RGNet 建模序列造影中病灶的时序与解剖模式，在多中心及前瞻数据上验证诊断性能。
key_points: 建模跨期相、跨部位细粒度病灶时序模式
25312 张图像、2651 例的多中心数据集训练验证
内部测试 F1 95.38%，优于 9 个基线模型
多中心与前瞻性验证集表现一致
reason: 同行评审，多中心大样本加前瞻性验证，达重要档
abstract: Fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA) is the gold standard for diagnosing retinal vascular diseases. However, interpretable artificial intelligence (AI) systems for FFA image analysis that align with clinicians’ reasoning processes and real-world diagnostic workflows remain scarce. In this study, we introduce an interpretable graph reasoning framework, FFA-RGNet, that explicitly models the temporal patterns of fine-grained lesions across imaging phases and anatomical locations for disease diagnosis from sequential FFA images. FFA-RGNet was trained and validated on a large, fine-grained, multi-center dataset consisting of 25,312 FFA images from 2651 patients. FFA-RGNet outperformed nine baseline models on the internal test set, achieving an F1-score of 95.38% (95% CI: 92.24%–97.88%), and demonstrated consistent performance across multi-center and prospective validation datasets. Its diagnostic performance not only surpassed that of ophthalmologists, residents and ophthalmology students, but also improved their diagnostic F1-score by 7.48% to 14.11% when used as an assistive tool. Comprehensive inference analysis further revealed its superior ability to correctly recognize fine-grained semantic entities, and to learn stable, disease-specific graph reasoning patterns aligned with clinical knowledge. These results suggest that FFA-RGNet enables accurate diagnosis with interpretable reasoning progresses, highlighting its strong potential as a reliable AI system for FFA interpretation and clinical decision support.
zh_abstract: 眼底荧光血管造影（fundus fluorescein angiography，FFA）是诊断视网膜血管疾病的金标准。然而，与临床医生推理过程和真实诊断工作流程相一致、用于 FFA 图像分析的可解释人工智能（AI）系统仍然稀缺。在本研究中，我们引入了一个可解释的图推理框架 FFA-RGNet，该框架显式建模序列 FFA 图像中细粒度病变跨成像阶段和解剖位置的时间模式，以进行疾病诊断。FFA-RGNet 在一个大型、细粒度、多中心数据集上进行了训练和验证，该数据集包含来自 2651 例患者的 25,312 张 FFA 图像。FFA-RGNet 在内部测试集上优于九个基线模型，达到 95.38% 的 F1 分数（95% CI：92.24%–97.88%），并在多中心验证数据集和前瞻性验证数据集上表现一致。其诊断性能不仅超过眼科医生、住院医师和眼科学生，而且作为辅助工具使用时，使他们的诊断 F1 分数提高了 7.48% 至 14.11%。全面的推理分析进一步揭示了其优越能力：能够正确识别细粒度语义实体，并学习与临床知识相一致的稳定、疾病特异性图推理模式。这些结果表明，FFA-RGNet 能够以可解释的推理过程实现准确诊断，突显其作为用于 FFA 解读和临床决策支持的可靠 AI 系统的强大潜力。

title: Performance of artificial intelligence for fracture detection: an umbrella review and second-order-meta-analysis
zh_title: AI骨折检测性能的伞状综述与二次Meta分析
summary: 伞状综述与二次Meta分析纳入50篇综述、387项原始研究，汇总AI骨折检测敏感度约0.897。
key_points: 纳入50篇综述、387项原始研究
二次Meta分析合并21项Meta分析
reason: 系统综述纳入387项原始研究且结论明确，达系统综述档
abstract: Fractures affect approximately 178 million people annually, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools for fracture detection are increasingly approved by regulators. We conducted an umbrella review and second-order meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42024516414), searching six databases to 4/06/2025 for systematic reviews or meta-analyses of AI fracture detection using any imaging modality. Screening, extraction, and quality assessment were performed in duplicate. We assessed review quality using AMSTAR-2, primary-study overlap using corrected covered area, and certainty using GRADE. Fifty reviews were included (25 systematic reviews and 25 meta-analyses; 387 primary studies). Twenty-one meta-analyses (269 primary studies) contributed to second-order meta-analysis, with slight overall overlap (4.31%). Pooled AI sensitivity was 0.897 (95% CI 0.882–0.911; 95% prediction interval 0.753–0.962) and specificity 0.904 (95% CI 0.891–0.916; prediction interval 0.824 to 0.950). Comparative evidence showed no consistent differences for AI, clinicians, and AI-assisted clinicians: however, this data was sparse and inconclusive. No review reported adverse events or other safety outcomes. Certainty was very low/low for almost all outcomes; all meta-analyses were rated critically low/low on AMSTAR-2. Although published estimates suggest high diagnostic accuracy, real-world and comparative performance remain uncertain. Prospective external validation, multi-reader-multi-case studies, and randomised trials are needed before broad clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: 骨折每年影响约1.78亿人，用于骨折检测的人工智能（AI）工具正越来越多地获得监管机构批准。我们开展了一项伞状综述和二阶荟萃分析（PROSPERO CRD42024516414），检索六个数据库至4/06/2025，纳入使用任何影像模态进行AI骨折检测的系统综述或荟萃分析。筛选、提取和质量评估均由两人重复进行。我们使用AMSTAR-2评估综述质量，使用校正覆盖面积评估原始研究重叠，并使用GRADE评估确定性。共纳入50篇综述（25篇系统综述和25篇荟萃分析；387项原始研究）。21项荟萃分析（269项原始研究）纳入二阶荟萃分析，总体重叠轻微（4.31%）。合并的AI敏感度为0.897（95% CI 0.882–0.911；95%预测区间0.753–0.962），特异度为0.904（95% CI 0.891–0.916；预测区间0.824至0.950）。比较证据显示AI、临床医生和AI辅助临床医生之间没有一致差异：然而，这些数据稀疏且不确定。没有综述报告不良事件或其他安全性结局。几乎所有结局的确定性为极低/低；所有荟萃分析在AMSTAR-2上被评为极低/低。尽管已发表的估计提示诊断准确性高，但真实世界性能和比较性能仍不确定。在广泛临床采用之前，需要前瞻性外部验证、多阅片者多病例研究和随机试验。

title: Scalable drift monitoring in medical imaging AI
zh_title: 医学影像AI的可扩展漂移监测框架MMC+
summary: npj Digital Medicine发表模块化漂移监测框架MMC+，用多模态数据一致性与基础模型嵌入实现连续性能监测，并在麻省总医院COVID期间数据上验证。
key_points: MMC+为模块化框架，支持多数据流统计检验或距离度量聚合
用基础模型嵌入免去站点专属编码器训练
量化不确定性以传达漂移显著性，并在麻省总医院疫情期间数据上验证
reason: 同行评审、真实机构数据验证，但单站点、无临床结局，属值得一看档。
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into clinical medical imaging has advanced diagnostics but also poses challenges in maintaining long-term reliability as input data change. To address this, we present MMC+, a modular framework for scalable drift monitoring that builds on our CheXstray framework for real-time drift detection using multi-modal data concordance (MMC). MMC+ provides a flexible architecture that enables cost-effective continuous performance monitoring in real-world healthcare settings. The framework’s capabilities include aggregating information from multiple data streams using statistical tests or distance metrics, leveraging foundation model embeddings to remove the need for site-specific encoder training, and quantifying uncertainty to better communicate drift significance. Validated with data from Massachusetts General Hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic, MMC+ effectively detects significant data shifts that correlate with performance changes and indicates when AI systems may deviate from acceptable performance bounds. The code for MMC+ is publicly available (Link: https://github.com/FJDorfner/MedImaging-ModelDriftMonitoring/tree/MMC_plus ), promoting broader adoption of AI solutions in clinical settings. Our framework significantly advances drift detection while promoting transparency and collaboration in clinical AI research.
zh_abstract: 将人工智能（AI）整合到临床医学影像中提升了诊断水平，但随着输入数据变化，也带来了维持长期可靠性的挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出 MMC+，一个用于可扩展漂移监测的模块化框架，它建立在我们用于利用多模态数据一致性（multi-modal data concordance, MMC）进行实时漂移检测的 CheXstray 框架之上。MMC+ 提供灵活架构，可在真实医疗环境中实现成本有效的连续性能监测。该框架的能力包括：使用统计检验或距离度量聚合来自多个数据流的信息；利用基础模型嵌入，从而无需进行站点特定编码器训练；以及量化不确定性，以更好地传达漂移显著性。MMC+ 使用 COVID-19 大流行期间马萨诸塞州总医院（Massachusetts General Hospital）的数据进行了验证，能够有效检测与性能变化相关的显著数据偏移，并指示 AI 系统何时可能偏离可接受的性能界限。MMC+ 的代码已公开（链接：https://github.com/FJDorfner/MedImaging-ModelDriftMonitoring/tree/MMC_plus ），以促进 AI 解决方案在临床环境中的更广泛采用。我们的框架显著推进了漂移检测，同时促进了临床 AI 研究的透明性和协作。

title: Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care
zh_title: 鼻咽癌全程诊疗大模型患者个体化量表评测基准
summary: 基于两家癌症中心405例纵向病历构建NPC-RubricBench，含941个患者-阶段单元与17688条个体化标准，评测30个大模型。
key_points: 两中心405例、六个诊疗阶段的纵向基准
诊断表现强不代表下游诊疗环节同样可靠
共评测30个通用与医学大模型
reason: 多中心大规模纵向基准、评测30个模型，属重要档预印本
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. We evaluated 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs, showing that high diagnostic performance did not translate into improved downstream care. Instead, the dominant failure modes reversed across phases. Explicit decision errors dominated anatomical staging at 48.2%, whereas decision omissions dominated initial work-up and post-treatment follow-up at 33.4% and 30.4%, respectively. In the evaluated model set, medically adapted models showed higher omission rates than general-purpose models. Moreover, varying query granularity exposes a critical specification trade-off: broad open-ended requests degrade Decision Quality across all 30 models, while more detailed, checklist-like prompts raise Decision Quality but reduce Evidence Faithfulness and Safety Adherence. Furthermore, NPC-RubricBench demonstrates that static diagnostic benchmarks are insufficient to ensure consistent clinical reliability over time, highlighting the importance of phase-adaptive safeguards in multistage medical AI.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在专科医学中显示出前景，但现有评估主要集中于孤立的临床诊疗场景，而不是追踪临床责任在纵向照护路径中如何演变。在此，我们介绍 NPC-RubricBench，一个阶段感知基准，用于评估癌症照护连续体中的多阶段临床推理，并以鼻咽癌作为明确的疾病背景。该基准基于两家癌症中心405例患者的纵向记录整理而成，包含六个连续诊疗阶段的941个患者-阶段单元，以及跨五个评价维度的17,688条患者特异性原子标准，每项评估严格限定于决策时点的临床证据。评估30个通用和医学LLMs发现，较强的诊断性能并不能延续到下游诊疗。我们评估了30个通用和医学LLMs，显示高诊断性能并未转化为下游诊疗改善。相反，主要失败模式在不同阶段发生反转。显性决策错误在解剖分期中占主导，为48.2%；而决策遗漏在初始检查和处理后随访中占主导，分别为33.4%和30.4%。在所评估的模型集合中，医学适配模型的遗漏率高于通用模型。此外，改变查询粒度暴露了一个关键的规范权衡：宽泛的开放式请求会降低所有30个模型的决策质量（Decision Quality），而更详细、清单式提示会提高决策质量，但降低证据忠实性（Evidence Faithfulness）和安全性依从性（Safety Adherence）。此外，NPC-RubricBench表明，静态诊断基准不足以确保随时间推移的一致临床可靠性，突出了在多阶段医学AI中采用阶段自适应保障措施的重要性。

title: Xenograft supervision and joint methylation-fragment-end encoding define a reusable molecular scoring layer for cell-free tumor DNA
zh_title: ctDNA-BERT：异种移植监督的游离DNA分子评分层
summary: 提出联合编码CpG甲基化、序列上下文与片段3′端的Transformer评分单条亚硫酸氢盐读段，在独立肝癌与泛癌血浆队列中验证。
key_points: 无需预设差异甲基化区域，逐分子打分
异种移植提供分子级肿瘤监督信号
1477例回顾队列区分I期癌症与健康对照
reason: 独立多癌种血浆队列外部验证、样本量较大，属重要档预印本
abstract: Circulating tumor DNA is often scarce in plasma, and regional methylation summaries can obscure informative differences between individual molecules. Here we present ctDNA-BERT, a Transformer that scores individual bisulfite reads without predefined differentially methylated regions by jointly encoding CpG methylation state, nucleotide context and the fragment 3' end. Xenografts provide molecule-level tumor supervision. The resulting frozen scorer supported tumor-fraction estimation in synthetic and patient-derived xenograft mixtures and enriched tumor-concordant methylation and chromatin-accessibility signals in independent hepatocellular carcinoma and stage III pan-cancer plasma without cohort-specific retraining. Features derived from selected reads discriminated stage I cancers from healthy controls in a retrospective cohort of 1,477 specimens, achieving an out-of-fold area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.884. By separating molecular scoring from sample-level inference, ctDNA-BERT provides a reusable read-level scoring layer for cell-free DNA methylation analysis.
zh_abstract: 血浆中循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）通常稀少，而区域性甲基化汇总可能掩盖单个分子之间的信息性差异。在此，我们提出 ctDNA-BERT，一种Transformer，可在无需预定义差异甲基化区域的情况下对单个亚硫酸氢盐读段（bisulfite reads）进行评分，通过联合编码CpG甲基化状态、核苷酸背景和片段3'端。异种移植提供了分子水平的肿瘤监督。所得冻结评分器在合成混合物和患者来源异种移植混合物中支持肿瘤分数估计，并在独立的肝细胞癌和III期泛癌血浆中富集了与肿瘤一致的甲基化和染色质可及性信号，且无需针对特定队列重新训练。从所选读段衍生的特征在一个包含1,477份标本的回顾性队列中区分了I期癌症与健康对照，达到0.884的折外受试者工作特征曲线下面积（out-of-fold AUROC）。通过将分子评分与样本水平推断分离，ctDNA-BERT为游离DNA（cell-free DNA）甲基化分析提供了一个可复用的读段水平评分层。

title: PRISM: Pathology Reliability In Scarce-label Medicine. A Tile-level Benchmark of Pathology Foundation Models
zh_title: PRISM：少标签医学场景下的病理基础模型基准
summary: 提出PRISM基准，评估病理基础模型在少标签、校准和跨机构迁移下的可靠性。
key_points: 覆盖8个病理基础模型与6个数据集
六种标签比例、三次重复共864次线性探针
五医院Camelyon17的20组定向迁移
reason: 大规模病理基础模型基准，含五医院外部迁移评测，属重要档预印本。
abstract: Pathology foundation models are typically benchmarked on classification performance at full label availability and on in-distribution test sets, while calibration, behavior at low label budgets, and robustness under cross-institutional shift are seldom evaluated jointly. We introduce PRISM, a tile-level benchmark that measures the reliability of pathology foundation models along four axes: model choice, label fraction, calibration, and out-of-distribution transfer. PRISM evaluates eight foundation models (CLIP, PLIP, CONCH, UNI, Virchow2, GigaPath, H-Optimus-0, Midnight) on six tile-level datasets at six label fractions (1% to 100%) with three seeds (864 linear probe runs), extended with a five-hospital Camelyon17 study of 20 directed transfer pairs. Four phenomena emerge. (i) Under full supervision, AUROC rank predicts post-temperature calibration rank consistently across datasets (Spearman rho = 0.52, I^2 = 0%), whereas at 1% labels the relationship becomes dataset-specific (rho = -0.24, I^2 = 67%). (ii) On harder datasets the linear probe collapses to a single predicted class below a dataset-specific label fraction. (iii) Whether additional source-domain labels help or harm target calibration tracks how well the probe transfers: below a transfer AUROC of roughly 0.85, more labels worsen target ECE in 86-88% of combinations. (iv) Temperature scaling fails to reduce ECE in 49 of 288 cells, miscalibration is predominantly under-confidence, and a source-fitted temperature is harmful under failing transfer. PRISM is released as a pip-installable package with reference results for all 288 cells. Code and data: https://github.com/alicemkyn/prism-benchmark
zh_abstract: 病理基础模型通常是在完整标签可用时的分类性能和分布内测试集上进行基准评估，而校准、低标签预算下的行为以及跨机构偏移下的稳健性很少被联合评估。我们提出 PRISM，一个图像块级基准，沿四个轴衡量病理基础模型的可靠性：模型选择、标签比例、校准和分布外迁移。PRISM 在六个图像块级数据集上，以六个标签比例（1% 至 100%）和三个随机种子评估八个基础模型（CLIP、PLIP、CONCH、UNI、Virchow2、GigaPath、H-Optimus-0、Midnight）（864 次线性探针运行），并扩展纳入五家医院的 Camelyon17 研究中的 20 个定向迁移对。出现四种现象。(i) 在完整监督下，AUROC 排名可一致地预测温度缩放后的校准排名（Spearman rho = 0.52，I^2 = 0%），而在 1% 标签时该关系因数据集而异（rho = -0.24，I^2 = 67%）。(ii) 在较难数据集上，当标签比例低于数据集特定阈值时，线性探针坍缩为单一预测类别。(iii) 额外源域标签是有助于还是损害目标域校准，与探针迁移效果相关：在迁移 AUROC 约低于 0.85 时，更多标签在 86-88% 的组合中使目标域 ECE 变差。(iv) 温度缩放在 288 个单元中的 49 个未能降低 ECE，校准不良主要表现为置信不足，且在迁移失败时源域拟合的温度参数有害。PRISM 以可通过 pip 安装的软件包形式发布，并包含全部 288 个单元的参考结果。代码和数据：https://github.com/alicemkyn/prism-benchmark

abstract: [Beilstein journal of nanotechnology] We reviewed artificial intelligence and machine learning in magnetic resonance imaging-visible magnetic nanoparticles, nanocarriers, and systems for imaging, drug delivery, hyperthermia, targeting, transport, and control. Using "preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses (PRISMA) 2020" methods, 2,283 records from seven databases yielded 65 studies. Predicted outcomes were colloidal stability, toxicity, uptake, magnetic descriptors, specific absorption rate, relaxivity, MRI signal, superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticle (SPION) quantification, drug release, biodistribution, and magnetic navigation. Evidence was strongest in bounded tasks: magnetic-property and relaxivity prediction, image-derived SPION mapping, hyperthermia modelling, and controlled magnetic transport. Most studies optimised isolated endpoints rather than integrating stability, MRI visibility, drug loading, release, tumour delivery, safety, and therapeutic response. External validation across datasets, laboratories, particle batches, biological models, scanners, and patient cohorts remains limited.
zh_abstract: [Beilstein journal of nanotechnology] 我们综述了人工智能和机器学习在磁共振成像可见的磁性纳米颗粒、纳米载体以及用于成像、药物递送、热疗、靶向、运输和控制的系统中的应用。采用“系统评价和荟萃分析首选报告项目（PRISMA）2020”方法，来自七个数据库的2,283条记录最终纳入65项研究。预测的结局包括胶体稳定性、毒性、摄取、磁性描述符、比吸收率、弛豫率、MRI信号、超顺磁性氧化铁纳米颗粒（SPION）定量、药物释放、生物分布和磁导航。证据在边界明确的任务中最强：磁性质和弛豫率预测、图像衍生的SPION映射、热疗建模以及受控磁运输。大多数研究优化的是孤立终点，而非整合稳定性、MRI可见性、载药量、释放、肿瘤递送、安全性和治疗反应。跨数据集、实验室、颗粒批次、生物模型、扫描仪和患者队列的外部验证仍然有限。

title: Mobile application-based digital therapeutics for frozen shoulder rehabilitation: a single-center, randomized controlled pilot study

summary: 单中心、评估者盲法随机预试验纳入18例冻结肩患者，比较AI数字疗法应用与视频居家训练。

abstract: Digital therapeutics offer promising solutions for frozen shoulder rehabilitation. This single-center, assessor-blinded, randomized controlled pilot trial compared an AI-based digital therapeutic application (ANAPA ME) with YouTube-based home exercises in 18 patients with frozen shoulder. Following baseline assessments, patients were allocated to the digital therapeutics (DTx) or conventional rehabilitation (CON) group, received a single ultrasound-guided intra-articular corticosteroid injection, and completed a 12-week exercise program. Assessments at weeks 0, 2, 4, 8, and 12 included passive range of motion (ROM), Visual Analog Scale (VAS), Constant Shoulder Score (CSS), Shoulder Pain and Disability Index (SPADI), and EuroQol-5 Dimension-5 Level (EQ-5D-5L). At 12 weeks, the DTx group achieved significantly greater side external rotation ROM ( p = 0.04) and improvement from baseline ( p = 0.042). EQ-5D-5L showed a significant group × time interaction ( p = 0.048), with greater improvement from baseline in the DTx group ( p = 0.013). No significant between-group differences were observed in VAS, SPADI, or CSS. These findings suggest that AI-based digital therapeutics may offer preliminary advantages in side external rotation ROM and health-related quality of life over conventional video-based exercises, though confirmation in larger trials is needed. This trial was registered with the Clinical Research Information Service, Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (registration number: PRE20250113-001) on January 13, 2025.
zh_abstract: 数字疗法为冻结肩康复提供了有前景的解决方案。这项单中心、评估者盲法、随机对照初步试验在18例冻结肩患者中比较了基于人工智能的数字治疗应用程序（ANAPA ME）与基于YouTube的家庭锻炼。在基线评估后，患者被分配至数字疗法（DTx）组或常规康复（CON）组，接受单次超声引导下关节内糖皮质激素注射，并完成12周锻炼计划。第0、2、4、8和12周的评估包括被动关节活动度（ROM）、视觉模拟量表（VAS）、Constant肩关节评分（CSS）、肩痛与功能障碍指数（SPADI）以及EuroQol-5维度-5水平（EQ-5D-5L）。在第12周，DTx组在侧方外旋ROM（p = 0.04）及较基线改善（p = 0.042）方面显著更优。EQ-5D-5L显示显著的组×时间交互作用（p = 0.048），DTx组较基线的改善更大（p = 0.013）。VAS、SPADI或CSS未观察到显著的组间差异。这些发现提示，基于人工智能的数字疗法可能在侧方外旋ROM和健康相关生活质量方面较传统视频锻炼具有初步优势，但仍需在更大规模试验中确认。该试验于2025年1月13日在韩国疾病管理厅临床研究信息服务注册（注册号：PRE20250113-001）。

title: When uncertainty quantification fails: structural vulnerabilities and corrections for selective prediction under clinical class imbalance
zh_title: 不确定度量化在临床类别不平衡下的失效
summary: 预印本指出选择性预测在严重类别不平衡时不确定度分数转为类别代理，并在三个神经疾病队列验证。
key_points: 不确定度分数系统性惩罚少数类患者
覆盖56种模拟条件与三个神经疾病队列
提出结构性漏洞的修正方案
reason: 多队列验证的安全性问题与新方法，但为未经同行评审预印本
abstract: Background. Selective prediction systems improve the safety of clinical artificial intelligence by deferring ambiguous cases to human experts while automating high-confidence decisions. However, this safety mechanism relies entirely on the premise that uncertainty scores accurately reflect clinical ambiguity. In prognostic tasks characterized by severe class imbalance, where the clinical outcome of interest is a minority, this assumption breaks down. Standard uncertainty measures cease to capture clinically aligned ambiguity; instead, they become a proxy for class membership, systematically penalizing minority patients regardless of their individual predictive clarity. Results. Across 56 synthetic conditions and three neurodegenerative cohorts spanning severe class imbalance to near-balanced conditions (multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Alzheimer's Disease), our framework consistently maintained bounded, balanced risk across trajectories. In contrast, global metrics either collapsed minority Sensitivity or protected the minority at the expense of majority patients. Applying CCR with standard entropy fails to protect the minority because it breaks within-class monotonicity when tau=0.5. Combining CCR with threshold-aware metrics restores strict monotonicity, correctly identifies ambiguous patients, and safely mitigates minority exclusion. Conclusions. Under clinical class imbalance, standard uncertainty quantification measures dataset sparsity rather than clinical ambiguity, creating a systemic illusion of safety. This bias is a correctable structural flaw. Clinical pipelines deploying selective prediction under imbalance should adopt threshold-aligned uncertainty measures and class-stratified evaluation. This reduces class-specific risk imbalance, supporting safer selective prediction under the evaluated conditions without silently excluding the most vulnerable patients.
zh_abstract: 【背景】选择性预测系统通过将模糊病例转交给人类专家，同时自动化高置信度决策，从而提高临床人工智能的安全性。然而，这种安全机制完全依赖于一个前提：不确定性评分能够准确反映临床模糊性。在以严重类别不平衡为特征、所关注的临床结局属于少数类的预后任务中，这一假设失效。标准不确定性度量不再捕捉与临床对齐的模糊性；相反，它们成为类别归属的代理指标，系统性地惩罚少数类患者，而不论其个体预测清晰度如何。【结果】在 56 种合成条件和三个神经退行性疾病队列（多发性硬化、帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病）中，涵盖从严重类别不平衡到接近平衡的条件，我们的框架在轨迹上始终维持有界且平衡的风险。相比之下，全局指标要么使少数类敏感性（Sensitivity）崩溃，要么以牺牲多数类患者为代价保护少数类。将 CCR 与标准熵结合使用无法保护少数类，因为当 tau=0.5 时它破坏了类内单调性。将 CCR 与阈值感知指标结合可恢复严格单调性，正确识别模糊患者，并安全地减轻少数类被排除。【结论】在临床类别不平衡下，标准不确定性量化度量的是数据集稀疏性，而非临床模糊性，从而制造了一种系统性的安全错觉。这种偏差是一种可纠正的结构性缺陷。在类别不平衡下部署选择性预测的临床流程应采用与阈值对齐的不确定性度量和按类别分层的评估。这在所评估的条件下降低了类别特异性风险不平衡，支持更安全的选择性预测，同时不会悄然排除最脆弱的患者。

title: Longitudinal retinal imaging and auxiliary tasks for discrete-time survival prediction of referable diabetic retinopathy and maculopathy: a retrospective cohort study
zh_title: 纵向视网膜影像预测糖尿病视网膜病变与黄斑病变
summary: 回顾性队列用多次视网膜影像与辅助任务预测可转诊糖尿病视网膜病变/黄斑病变。
key_points: 比较单次与最多三次随访影像输入
加入未来访视年龄等辅助监督目标
reason: 大样本回顾性队列，有独立测试集但同项目内验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Deep learning can predict progression to referable diabetic retinopathy (rDR) and referable maculopathy (rM) from screening photographs, but existing models ignore the prior images that screening programmes hold. We assessed whether multi-visit (MV) images and auxiliary objectives that model the future visit improve prognostic prediction. In this retrospective cohort study of macula-centred photographs from the South-East London Diabetic Eye Screening Programme (UK), eyes without referable disease at baseline and with a follow-up at 20-28 months were split into development (72,559 eyes, 36,648 patients) and test (17,917 eyes, 9,071 patients) sets. A time-aware discrete-time survival model predicted incident rDR (R2 or R3), rM (M1), or either (rDR/rM). We compared baseline-only input with up to three visits (MV), alone or with auxiliary supervision of future-visit age (MV+age) or future-visit latent prediction (MV+latent), using the AUROC of 28-month cumulative risk and paired DeLong tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction. In the test set, 308 eyes (1.7%) developed rDR/rM, 58 (0.3%) rDR, and 275 (1.5%) rM. MV images increased the AUROC for rDR/rM from 0.749 to 0.786 (+0.037, 95% CI 0.012-0.061; q=0.011) and for rM from 0.749 to 0.788 (+0.039, 0.013-0.065; q=0.010). Auxiliary objectives did not improve MV model performance. In eyes with two or three visits, prior visits accounted for 30-38% of positive Grad-CAM attributions. Prior screening images improved prediction of incident maculopathy and the composite rDR/rM outcome, with gains driven by longitudinal images, not auxiliary supervision. External validation and prospective studies are required before the deployment of models to individualise screening.
zh_abstract: 深度学习可从筛查照片预测进展为需转诊糖尿病视网膜病变（rDR）和需转诊黄斑病变（rM），但现有模型忽略了筛查项目所持有的既往图像。我们评估了多访视（MV）图像以及模拟未来访视的辅助目标能否改善预后预测。在这项回顾性队列研究中，使用来自英国东南伦敦糖尿病眼病筛查项目（South-East London Diabetic Eye Screening Programme）的黄斑中心照片，将基线时无需转诊疾病且有 20-28 个月随访的眼分为开发集（72,559 只眼，36,648 例患者）和测试集（17,917 只眼，9,071 例患者）。采用时间感知离散时间生存模型预测新发 rDR（R2 或 R3）、rM（M1）或任一者（rDR/rM）。我们比较了仅基线输入与最多三次访视（MV）输入，单独使用或结合未来访视年龄的辅助监督（MV+age）或未来访视潜在预测的辅助监督（MV+latent），使用 28 个月累积风险的 AUROC 以及经 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正的配对 DeLong 检验。在测试集中，308 只眼（1.7%）发生 rDR/rM，58 只眼（0.3%）发生 rDR，275 只眼（1.5%）发生 rM。MV 图像使 rDR/rM 的 AUROC 从 0.749 提高到 0.786（+0.037，95% CI 0.012-0.061；q=0.011），使 rM 的 AUROC 从 0.749 提高到 0.788（+0.039，0.013-0.065；q=0.010）。辅助目标未改善 MV 模型性能。在具有两次或三次访视的眼中，既往访视占阳性 Grad-CAM 归因的 30-38%。既往筛查图像改善了新发黄斑病变和复合 rDR/rM 结局的预测，其获益由纵向图像驱动，而非辅助监督。在将模型部署用于个体化筛查之前，尚需外部验证和前瞻性研究。

title: MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine
zh_title: MedJev：医学零样本System-One决策评测
summary: 在十个医学基准上评测可在笔记本本地运行的开放式System One模型MedJev，并与零样本LLM、GPT-4公布结果及监督模型对比。
key_points: MedQA 72.5%、USMLE 75.4%、NEJM 80.1%
置信度校准良好，ECE 0.028–0.063
院内死亡AUROC 0.926，略高于XGBoost 0.902
在急诊分诊等运营类结局上不及监督模型
reason: 多基准公开对比且模型可本地运行，但属预印本、无外部临床验证
abstract: System One decision models such as Jev answer structured questions in a single forward pass without generating text, offering fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support. We evaluate MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks spanning medical knowledge, diagnosis, and patient level prediction using MIMIC IV and MIMIC IV ED. We compare MedJev against zero shot LLM baselines, published GPT results, and supervised models. MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063). On patient level tasks, MedJev achieves an AUROC of 0.926 for In Hospital Mortality, exceeding XGBoost (0.902), but underperforms supervised models on operational outcomes such as ED Triage Admission (0.745 vs. 0.809). Patient level predictions also exhibit substantial miscalibration (In Hospital Mortality ECE 0.286). We introduce a lightweight, two parameter recalibration method that adapts predictions to local patient populations using 50 to 200 labeled examples, reducing ECE to 0.007. Our findings establish open System One models as a promising zero shot baseline for medical AI, combining competitive predictive performance with low computational cost and efficient local calibration. We release our code and evaluation harness to support future research.
zh_abstract: 诸如Jev之类的System One决策模型在单次前向传播中回答结构化问题，而无需生成文本，提供快速且计算高效的临床决策支持。我们评估了MedJev——一个可在笔记本电脑上本地运行的开源System One模型——在十个医学基准上的表现，涵盖医学知识、诊断以及使用MIMIC IV和MIMIC IV ED进行的患者层面预测。我们将MedJev与零样本LLM基线、已发表的GPT结果以及监督模型进行比较。MedJev在MedQA上达到72.5%的准确率，在USMLE上达到75.4%，在NEJM上达到80.1%，接近已发表的GPT-4性能，同时保持良好校准的置信度估计（ECE 0.028至0.063）。在患者层面任务上，MedJev在院内死亡率方面达到AUROC 0.926，超过XGBoost（0.902），但在急诊分诊入院（ED Triage Admission）等操作性结局上不如监督模型（0.745 vs. 0.809）。患者层面预测也表现出明显校准不良（院内死亡率ECE 0.286）。我们引入一种轻量级双参数重校准方法，使用50至200个有标签样本使预测适应本地患者人群，将ECE降至0.007。我们的研究结果确立了开源System One模型作为医学AI有前景的零样本基线，兼具具有竞争力的预测性能、低计算成本和高效的本地校准。我们发布代码和评估工具以支持未来研究。

title: Asking the Data: Conversational Interrogation of LC-MS/MS Proteomics Data Sets with an LLM Agent
zh_title: LLM智能体对话式审问LC-MS/MS蛋白质组数据
summary: 预印本提出用LLM智能体将研究者新问题转为可执行检验并留存记录，回溯四套LC-MS/MS数据暴露三组内部研究的数据问题。
key_points: 提出“数据集审问”对话框架，由LLM智能体生成可执行检验
要求对控制组核验答案并留存代码、输入与决策记录
回溯4套数据，3项内部研究解释因数据库缺失等被改变
reason: 预印本新方法，有真实数据集回溯应用，但无对照评测，属值得一看档
abstract: Proteomics workflows are designed to answer predefined questions, leaving analytical problems that emerge after first results difficult to investigate without additional bioinformatics work. We introduce data set interrogation, a conversational framework in which a researcher uses a large language model (LLM) agent to translate emerging questions into executable tests, check the answers against controls, and keep the code, inputs, and decisions in a dated record. Applied retrospectively to four LC-MS/MS data sets, the framework exposed problems that changed the interpretation of three in-house studies: a search database lacking one of two symbionts, a swapped pair of tandem mass tag (TMT) channels, statistics inflated by non-host proteins, and false deamidation assignments caused by selection of the 13C isotope peak as monoisotopic; the same question asked of every data set revealed failed or partial cysteine alkylation in all three. A public TMT data set was reanalyzed from raw files in 24 min, a feasibility measure without a human comparison; among spectra identified by both workflows, 99.2% received the same peptide assignment as in Proteome Discoverer, and protein fold changes correlated (r = 0.93). In seeded tests, a purpose built channel assignment check detected all 216 between strain channel swaps and none of 90 within-strain swaps. The framework couples natural language interaction with executable analyses, explicit controls, and traceable decisions, enabling researchers to investigate questions not anticipated by the original pipeline. These results establish feasibility in a limited retrospective setting with one researcher; broader evaluation across users, models, and data sets is required to determine general performance.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质组学工作流程旨在回答预先定义的问题，这使得首批结果出现后浮现的分析问题，若没有额外的生物信息学工作便难以研究。我们引入数据集质询（data set interrogation），一种对话式框架，其中研究者使用大语言模型（LLM）智能体将新出现的问题转化为可执行的检验，对照对照（controls）检查答案，并将代码、输入和决策保存在带日期的记录中。在回顾性应用于四个 LC-MS/MS 数据集时，该框架暴露出的问题改变了三项内部研究的解释：搜索数据库缺少两种共生体之一、一对串联质量标签（TMT）通道发生交换、统计量被非宿主蛋白夸大，以及因将 13C 同位素峰选为单同位素峰而导致的错误脱酰胺基指认；对每个数据集询问同一问题，揭示出在所有三个中均存在失败或部分半胱氨酸烷基化。一个公开 TMT 数据集在 24 分钟内从原始文件被重新分析，这是无人工比较的可行性指标；在两种工作流程均鉴定的谱图中，99.2% 获得了与 Proteome Discoverer 中相同的肽段归属，蛋白质倍数变化相关（r = 0.93）。在种子测试（seeded tests）中，一个专门构建的通道分配检查检测出全部 216 个菌株间通道交换，并且未检测出 90 个菌株内交换中的任何一个。该框架将自然语言交互与可执行分析、明确对照和可追踪决策相结合，使研究者能够研究原始流程未预见的问题。这些结果在仅有一名研究者的有限回顾性环境中确立了可行性；需要在不同用户、模型和数据集之间进行更广泛评估，以确定一般性能。

title: Evaluating Federated Vision-Language and Vision-Only Models for Privacy-Aware Breast Cancer Imaging
zh_title: 联邦视觉语言模型用于隐私保护乳腺影像评估
summary: 预印本在联邦学习加客户端差分隐私下比较CLIP、BiomedCLIP与ViT-B/16在乳腺影像上的表现。
key_points: 在兩个公开乳腺影像数据集上比较五模型
联邦设置下正常与异常判别ROC-AUC为0.940–0.990
报告采集年份等影响及通信成本与阈值敏感性
reason: 预印本方法对比充分且开源式评测，但仅公开数据集回顾分析，属值得一看档
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) shows promise for breast imaging, but limited labeled data, institutional data fragmentation, and privacy concerns hinder centralized training. We investigate a privacy-aware federated learning framework combining pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with client-level differential privacy. We compare general-purpose CLIP models, biomedical BiomedCLIP, and an ImageNet-pretrained ViT-B/16 baseline on two public breast imaging datasets, with and without differential privacy. We also evaluate a CLIP ViT-B/16 ablation that removes the text pathway. Evaluation includes patient-level ROC-AUC with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, baseline comparisons, threshold sensitivity, inter-model agreement, and communication cost. Under federated learning, all five models achieve high normal-versus-sick discrimination (ROC-AUC: 0.940-0.990). However, acquisition year alone achieves 0.974 on the same test partition, raising concerns about confounding rather than genuine pathology recognition. Benign-versus-malignant discrimination remains uncertain (ROC-AUC: 0.504-0.637), with all confidence intervals including 0.50. Removing the text pathway preserves classification accuracy while halving communication cost. Differential privacy reduces ROC-AUC by 0.375, attributable to perturbing the full model state rather than only trainable parameters. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating confounding, predictive reliability, privacy implementation, and deployment efficiency when developing federated AI systems for breast imaging.
zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）在乳腺影像中显示出前景，但标注数据有限、机构数据碎片化和隐私担忧阻碍了集中式训练。我们研究一个隐私感知的联邦学习框架，将预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）与客户端级差分隐私相结合。我们在两个公开乳腺影像数据集上，比较通用 CLIP 模型、生物医学 BiomedCLIP 和 ImageNet 预训练 ViT-B/16 基线，在有和无差分隐私的情况下。我们还评估了移除文本通路的 CLIP ViT-B/16 消融模型。评估包括患者级 ROC-AUC 及 bootstrap 95% 置信区间、基线比较、阈值敏感性、模型间一致性和通信成本。在联邦学习下，所有五个模型均实现较高的正常与患病判别能力（ROC-AUC：0.940-0.990）。然而，仅采集年份在同一测试划分上达到 0.974，引发了对混杂因素而非真正病理识别的担忧。良性 vs 恶性的判别仍不确定（ROC-AUC：0.504-0.637），所有置信区间均包含 0.50。移除文本通路在保持分类准确性的同时将通信成本减半。差分隐私使 ROC-AUC 降低 0.375，这可归因于扰动完整模型状态而非仅扰动可训练参数。这些发现凸显了在开发用于乳腺影像的联邦 AI 系统时，评估混杂、预测可靠性、隐私实现和部署效率的重要性。

title: ProtCell: a foundation model for single-cell proteomics
zh_title: ProtCell：单细胞蛋白质组基础模型
summary: 预印本发布基于98个数据集、约3.8亿细胞预训练的单细胞蛋白质组基础模型。
key_points: 融合蛋白身份与丰度嵌入做掩码建模
用于注释迁移、批次校正与丰度重建
推断未测蛋白程序并指导检测 panel 选择
reason: 大规模预训练与多数据集评测，但为未经同行评审预印本
abstract: Single-cell proteomics provides a direct functional readout of cellular states, but targeted assays measure limited and non-identical protein panels, fragmenting information across experiments. Here, we present ProtCell, a foundation model developed using approximately 380 million cells from 98 datasets for pretraining and evaluation. ProtCell combines protein-identity and continuous-abundance embeddings in a transformer encoder and learns cell- and protein-level representations through masked abundance modeling. ProtCell first connects fragmented profiles through transferable annotation and batch correction while preserving biological organization. It then extends limited profiles through abundance reconstruction and inference of an unmeasured cytotoxic protein program enriched in natural killer cells and memory CD8$^+$ T cells. The learned protein dependencies further guide the selection of compact panels that retain information for profile reconstruction and biological classification. ProtCell thus provides a framework for connecting fragmented proteomic profiles, extending information beyond measured panels and guiding more informative measurements.
zh_abstract: 单细胞蛋白质组学可提供细胞状态的直接功能读出，但靶向检测测量的是有限且不完全相同的蛋白质 panel，导致信息在不同实验之间碎片化。在此，我们提出 ProtCell，这是一个使用来自 98 个数据集的约 3.8 亿个细胞进行预训练和评估的基础模型。ProtCell 在 transformer 编码器（transformer encoder）中结合蛋白质身份嵌入和连续丰度嵌入，并通过掩码丰度建模学习细胞水平和蛋白质水平表征。ProtCell 首先通过可迁移注释和批次校正连接碎片化的 profile，同时保留生物组织架构。随后，它通过丰度重建以及对一个未测量的细胞毒性蛋白质程序的推断来扩展有限的 profile，该程序在自然杀伤细胞和记忆 CD8$^+$ T 细胞中富集。学习到的蛋白质依赖性进一步指导紧凑 panel 的选择，这些 panel 保留用于 profile 重建和生物学分类的信息。因此，ProtCell 提供了一个框架，用于连接碎片化的蛋白质组学 profile、将信息扩展到测量 panel 之外，并指导信息量更高的测量。

title: When Slides Met Scans: Cross-Attention for Renal Cancer Prognosis
zh_title: 肾癌预后中的病理与CT交叉注意力融合
summary: 在肾癌中融合组织病理与CT的双向交叉注意力模型，内部C-index 0.760，外部CT缺失时0.629。
key_points: 双向交叉注意力连接16个组织学原型与最多32个CT token
210例TCGA-KIRC、46例DSS事件，内部C-index 0.760
外部180例CPTAC-CCRCC，未用CT时C-index 0.629
reason: 预印本，有小样本外部验证且外部未用CT，属值得一看档
abstract: Histopathology and computed tomography (CT) provide complementary views of renal cancer. We connect these modalities through bidirectional cross-attention between 16 histology prototypes and up to 32 kidney-centered CT tokens from frozen foundation models. In 210 TCGA-KIRC patients with 46 disease-specific survival (DSS) events, 5-fold evaluation yielded a C-index of $0.760\pm0.081$ and 3-year AUROC of 0.773 (95\% CI 0.678--0.860), the highest averages among evaluated unimodal and fusion baselines. External testing in 180 CPTAC-CCRCC patients yielded DSS C-index of 0.629 with CT withheld. Attribution analysis linked predictions to image regions while exposing acquisition artifacts. These findings support further study of cross-scale fusion and independent multimodal validation.
zh_abstract: 组织病理学和计算机断层扫描（CT）提供肾癌的互补视图。我们通过双向交叉注意力，将16个组织学原型与来自冻结基础模型的最多32个以肾脏为中心的CT token连接起来。在210例TCGA-KIRC患者（46例疾病特异性生存（DSS）事件）中，5折评估得到C指数0.760±0.081和3年AUROC 0.773（95% CI 0.678–0.860），是所评估的单模态和融合基线中最高的平均值。在180例CPTAC-CCRCC患者中进行外部测试，在未使用CT的情况下得到DSS C指数0.629。归因分析将预测与图像区域联系起来，同时揭示了采集伪影。这些发现支持进一步研究跨尺度融合和独立多模态验证。

title: Artificial intelligence in modern medicine: a comprehensive review of technologies, applications, and future directions.
zh_title: 现代医学中人工智能技术、应用与未来方向综述
summary: 综述检索2016至2024年多个数据库，区分回顾性算法性能与前瞻性临床有效性，覆盖影像、皮肤科、病理及药物发现与多组学。
key_points: 深度学习、NLP与基础模型在回顾性队列中诊断准确性高
AI加速药物发现并支持多组学整合的个体化治疗规划
强调回顾性性能与前瞻性临床有效性需区别看待
reason: 综合性综述、主题宽泛，按规则综述上限档，属值得一看。
abstract: [Personalized medicine] We evaluated the transformative impact of AI modalities on clinical practice, distinguishing between retrospective algorithmic performance and prospective clinical effectiveness. Comprehensive searches were executed [databases searched: January 2016 to October 2024] across PubMed/Medline, Scopus, and Web of Science, identifying peer-reviewed original research and clinical trials. Non-peer-reviewed materials and commercial web sources were strictly excluded. AI technologies-particularly deep learning (DL), natural language processing (NLP), and foundation models-demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy in retrospective cohorts across radiology, dermatology, and pathology. In precision therapeutics, AI accelerates drug discovery and facilitates multi-omics integration for individualized treatment planning. Furthermore, autonomous AI systems have proven cost-effective in nationwide diabetic retinopathy screening programs. However, significant gaps remain between in-silico success and real-world clinical utility. Primary barriers include the lack of prospective randomized trials, pervasive risks of algorithmic bias threatening health equity, the "black box" nature of deep neural networks, and stringent interoperability challenges. AI serves as a potent computational catalyst for advancing personalized medicine. To transition from retrospective experimental success to standard-of-care clinical integration, future research endeavors must prioritize Explainable AI (XAI), federated learning frameworks for privacy preservation, and rigorous prospective clinical validation under standardized regulatory oversight.
zh_abstract: [个性化医疗] 我们评估了 AI 模式对临床实践的变革性影响，区分了回顾性算法性能与前瞻性临床有效性。我们在 PubMed/Medline、Scopus 和 Web of Science 中执行了全面检索[检索数据库时间：2016 年 1 月至 2024 年 10 月]，识别同行评审的原始研究和临床试验。严格排除非同行评审材料和商业网络来源。AI 技术——尤其是深度学习（DL）、自然语言处理（NLP）和基础模型——在放射学、皮肤病学和病理学的回顾性队列中显示出高诊断准确性。在精准治疗中，AI 加速药物发现，并促进多组学整合以用于个体化治疗规划。此外，自主 AI 系统已在全国性糖尿病视网膜病变筛查项目中证明具有成本效益。然而，计算机模拟成功与真实世界临床效用之间仍存在显著差距。主要障碍包括缺乏前瞻性随机试验、算法偏倚普遍存在并威胁健康公平、深度神经网络的“黑箱”性质，以及严格的互操作性挑战。AI 作为推进个性化医疗的强大计算催化剂。为从回顾性实验成功过渡到标准治疗临床整合，未来研究必须优先考虑可解释 AI（Explainable AI, XAI）、用于隐私保护的联邦学习框架，以及在标准化监管监督下进行严格的前瞻性临床验证。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Acute Coronary Syndromes: From Early Diagnosis to Culprit Lesion Characterization, Coronary Physiology, and Risk Stratification.
zh_title: 急性冠脉综合征中的人工智能：从早期诊断到罪犯病变与风险分层
summary: 同行评审综述梳理AI在急性冠脉综合征诊疗全路径的应用证据，涵盖AI心电图、冠脉影像与风险预测。
key_points: AI心电图或提升心梗与OMI检出
AI可量化斑块并辅助OCT/IVUS判读
指出仍需更高质量诊断验证证据
reason: 覆盖诊疗全路径的综合性综述，按规则综述上限6分，取5分
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is being investigated across the acute coronary syndrome (ACS) care pathway, including early diagnosis, coronary lesion characterization, procedural guidance, and risk prediction. This comprehensive review examines the current evidence across the entire ACS trajectory, with particular emphasis on clinically actionable and interventional applications. AI-enabled electrocardiography (ECG) may improve detection of myocardial infarction, including occlusion myocardial infarction (OMI) that does not meet conventional STEMI criteria. Models combining clinical data and high-sensitivity troponin may improve early rule-out and rule-in. In coronary imaging, AI can quantify plaque characteristics and assist with the interpretation of OCT and IVUS, while image-derived physiology may help assess non-culprit lesions. However, better diagnostic accuracy does not necessarily translate into better revascularization decisions. AI-based models can also estimate post-ACS ischemic, bleeding, and mortality risk, although evidence that their use improves treatment or outcomes remains limited. The next priority is prospective evaluation of whether these tools improve decisions, workflow, and patient outcomes across diverse clinical settings.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics（Basel, Switzerland）] 人工智能（AI）正被研究应用于急性冠脉综合征（ACS）诊疗全程，包括早期诊断、冠状动脉病变特征描述、操作引导和风险预测。这篇综合性综述考察了整个 ACS 病程中的当前证据，特别强调具有临床可操作性和介入应用价值的方向。AI 赋能的心电图（ECG）可能改善心肌梗死检出，包括不符合传统 STEMI 标准的闭塞性心肌梗死（OMI）。结合临床数据和高敏肌钙蛋白的模型可能改善早期排除和纳入诊断。在冠状动脉影像中，AI 可量化斑块特征并辅助解读 OCT 和 IVUS，而影像衍生生理学可能有助于评估非罪犯病变。然而，更高的诊断准确性未必转化为更好的血运重建决策。基于 AI 的模型还可估计 ACS 后缺血、出血和死亡风险，尽管其使用可改善治疗或结局的证据仍然有限。下一步优先事项是开展前瞻性评估，考察这些工具能否在不同临床环境中改善决策、工作流程和患者结局。

title: Patient-Specific Biomechanical Modeling of Incisional Hernias Using Artificial Intelligence and Finite Element Analysis
zh_title: AI与有限元建模构建切口疝患者个体化生物力学模型
summary: 法国斯特拉斯堡大学医院注册单中心回顾性观察研究，拟纳入800例，用CT与临床数据构建个体化腹壁数值模型。
key_points: 新注册观察性研究，尚无结果
拟纳入800例，单中心回顾性
AI识别CT腹壁形态特征结合有限元分析
reason: 仅研究注册无结果，单中心回顾性设计，属增量档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University Hospital, Strasbourg, France; conditions: Incisional Hernia; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 800; status: RECRUITING] Incisional hernias are defects in the continuity of the abdominal wall that impair its mechanical function. This retrospective, single-center, non-interventional study aims to develop a patient-specific biomechanical model of the abdominal wall using artificial intelligence and finite element analysis. Anonymized computed tomography (CT) data will be analyzed to automatically identify and quantify key morphological features of the abdominal wall and incisional hernia. These features will be combined with clinical data and previously obtained experimental data on tissue mechanics to create a numerical model tailored to each patient.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：法国斯特拉斯堡大学医院（University Hospital, Strasbourg, France）；疾病：切口疝（Incisional Hernia）；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：800；状态：招募中（RECRUITING）] 切口疝是腹壁连续性的缺损，损害其机械功能。这项回顾性、单中心、非干预性研究旨在利用人工智能和有限元分析（finite element analysis）开发患者特异性腹壁生物力学模型。将分析匿名化计算机断层扫描（CT）数据，以自动识别和量化腹壁及切口疝的关键形态学特征。这些特征将与临床数据以及先前获得的组织力学实验数据相结合，以创建为每名患者量身定制的数值模型。

title: Development and Prospective Validation of the AutoEIT Foundation Model for ARDS
zh_title: AutoEIT：ARDS 电阻抗成像基础模型的前瞻验证
summary: 瑞金医院发起的多中心双向队列研究（拟入组1200例），拟开发并验证基于连续EIT图像的AutoEIT基础模型，用于ARDS精准机械通气。
key_points: 观察性、多中心、双向队列设计，拟入组1200例
回顾阶段用2020–2025年1000例EIT数据训练
前瞻阶段验证ARDS呼吸支持相关模型表现
尚未开始招募，无结果数据
reason: 多中心前瞻验证设计但尚无结果，属方案注册档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: ARDS (Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome), Respiratory Failure, Mechanical Ventilation, Ventilator-induced Lung Injury (VILI); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1200; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) is a highly heterogeneous condition, making precision mechanical ventilation challenging. Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT) provides real-time monitoring of regional lung ventilation, but interpreting its complex spatiotemporal data relies on subjective clinical experience. This multicenter ambispective cohort study aims to develop and validate an all-in-one Artificial Intelligence Foundation Model (AutoEIT). The study consists of two phases: (1) A Retrospective Phase (data from 2020 to 2025, N=1000) to train the AutoEIT model using continuous EIT images and synchronous high-frequency ventilator waveforms; and (2) A Prospective Temporal Phase (January 2026 to December 2026, N=200) to rigorously test the model's performance in a real-world clinical setting. The AutoEIT model is a deep multi-task learning framework designed to simultaneously perform five core clinical tasks: (1) classify ARDS subphenotypes, (2) recommend individualized positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP), (3) detect occult patient-ventilator asynchrony, (4) predict ventilation/perfusion (V/Q) ratio, and (5) continuously estimate the non-invasive PaO₂/FiO₂ ratio. Ultimately, this system aims to reduce ventilator-induced lung injury (VILI) and improve precision respiratory care.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：瑞金医院（Ruijin Hospital）；疾病：ARDS（急性呼吸窘迫综合征）、呼吸衰竭、机械通气、呼吸机相关性肺损伤（VILI）；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：1200；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）是一种高度异质性的疾病，使精准机械通气具有挑战性。电阻抗断层成像（EIT）可实时监测区域肺通气，但解读其复杂的时空数据依赖主观临床经验。这项多中心双向性队列研究旨在开发并验证一体式人工智能基础模型（AutoEIT）。该研究包括两个阶段：（1）回顾性阶段（数据来自2020年至2025年，N=1000），使用连续EIT图像和同步高频呼吸机波形训练AutoEIT模型；（2）前瞻性时间阶段（2026年1月至2026年12月，N=200），在真实世界临床环境中严格测试模型性能。AutoEIT模型是一个深度多任务学习框架，旨在同时执行五项核心临床任务：（1）对ARDS亚表型进行分类；（2）推荐个体化呼气末正压（PEEP）；（3）检测隐匿性患者-呼吸机不同步；（4）预测通气/灌注（V/Q）比；（5）连续估算无创PaO₂/FiO₂比值。最终，该系统旨在减少呼吸机相关性肺损伤（VILI）并改善精准呼吸治疗。

title: AI-generated Treatment Recommendations in Precision Oncology

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Peroral Cholangioscopy for the Diagnosis and Management of Biliary Strictures: Current Evidence and Future Directions.

abstract: [Acta medica Okayama] Peroral cholangioscopy (POCS) enables direct intraductal visualization and targeted biopsies for indeterminate biliary strictures. However, its diagnostic performance remains operator-dependent and is limited by sampling error. As artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly advanced in gastrointestinal endoscopy, AI-assisted cholangioscopy has progressed from proof-of-concept image classification to multicenter validation, feature detection, and real-time application. Recent studies using digital single-operator cholangioscopy have reported diagnostic accuracy comparable to that of experts in differentiating malignant from benign strictures, and feature-based approaches can automatically detect tumor vessels and other key visual characteristics. Beyond classification, generative models may enhance mucosal and margin visualization through virtual chromoendoscopy, potentially improving lesion-margin assessment. Furthermore, new models compatible with multiple systems are emerging to address device heterogeneity, which is a key barrier to routine practice. This review summarizes the current evidence on AI-assisted POCS, discusses practical considerations for clinical translation, and highlights future directions, including real-time integration and multimodal decision support.
zh_abstract: [Acta medica Okayama] 经口胆道镜（POCS）可直接进行胆管内可视化，并对不明原因胆道狭窄进行靶向活检。然而，其诊断性能仍依赖操作者，并受采样误差限制。随着人工智能（AI）在胃肠内镜中的快速发展，AI 辅助胆道镜已从概念验证性图像分类进展到多中心验证、特征检测和实时应用。近期使用数字单人操作胆道镜的研究报告，其在区分恶性和良性狭窄方面的诊断准确性与专家相当，基于特征的方法可自动检测肿瘤血管和其他关键视觉特征。除分类外，生成模型可通过虚拟染色内镜增强黏膜和边缘可视化，可能改善病变边缘评估。此外，正在出现兼容多种系统的新模型，以应对设备异质性这一常规实践的关键障碍。这篇综述总结了 AI 辅助 POCS 的当前证据，讨论了临床转化的实际考虑，并强调了未来方向，包括实时集成和多模态决策支持。

title: Evaluation of Large Language Model Concordance With AAOS Clinical Practice Guidelines for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome.
zh_title: 大语言模型与AAOS腕管综合征指南一致性评估
summary: 用标准化提示测试四种LLM对252条腕管综合征建议与AAOS临床指南的一致性，72.6%一致。
key_points: 覆盖ChatGPT-4、Gemini、Claude-3、Mistral-7B
每模型每提示询问3次，双盲评审加共识裁决

abstract: [Hand (New York, N.Y.)] Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Mistral are increasingly used to obtain medical information, but their accuracy in carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) management is uncertain. This study evaluated whether LLM-generated recommendations align with American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS) clinical practice guidelines (CPGs). Four LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Gemini, Claude-3, Mistral-7B) were queried with standardized prompts derived from AAOS CTS CPGs. Each prompt was asked 3 times per model, and responses were synthesized. Two blinded reviewers graded outputs as concordant, discordant, or indeterminate, with disagreements resolved by consensus. Concordance distributions were compared using χ2 testing with Bonferroni correction. Inter-rater reliability was measured with Cohen's κ. Across 252 recommendations, 72.6% were concordant, 11.5% discordant, and 15.9% indeterminate. ChatGPT achieved the highest concordance (92.1%) and lowest discordance (1.6%), while Mistral performed poorest (52.4% concordance, 17.5% discordance). Reviewer agreement was excellent (κ = 0.91). Over 1 in 4 LLM-generated CTS recommendations were not concordant with AAOS CPGs. ChatGPT outperformed other models, though variable performance underscores the need for clinician oversight and careful validation before clinical use.
zh_abstract: [Hand (New York, N.Y.)] ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 和 Mistral 等大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于获取医学信息，但其在腕管综合征（CTS）管理中的准确性尚不确定。本研究评估了 LLM 生成的建议是否与美国骨科医师学会（AAOS）临床实践指南（CPG）一致。使用源自 AAOS CTS CPG 的标准化提示词查询四种 LLM（ChatGPT-4、Gemini、Claude-3、Mistral-7B）。每个提示词对每种模型询问3次，并对回答进行综合。两名设盲评审者将输出评为一致、不一致或不确定，分歧通过共识解决。一致性分布使用 χ2 检验并采用 Bonferroni 校正进行比较。评分者间信度使用 Cohen's κ 测量。在252条建议中，72.6%为一致，11.5%为不一致，15.9%为不确定。ChatGPT 获得最高一致性（92.1%）和最低不一致性（1.6%），而 Mistral 表现最差（52.4%一致，17.5%不一致）。评审者一致性极好（κ = 0.91）。超过四分之一由 LLM 生成的 CTS 建议未达到与 AAOS CPG 一致。ChatGPT 优于其他模型，但性能存在差异，这凸显了临床监督以及在临床使用前进行仔细验证的必要性。

title: An Integrated Artificial Intelligence Framework for Nanomedicine Engineering.
zh_title: 纳米药物工程的集成AI框架

评估从经典ML到PINN与强化学习的算法谱系

abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] The translation of nanomedicines is frequently bottlenecked by trial-and-error optimization. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) transforms this process into a closed-loop, experimentally grounded discovery ecosystem. This Review provides a roadmap for this paradigm, demonstrating how AI, high-throughput testing, and nanoscale design converge to generate clinically translatable nanotherapeutics. We emphasize the necessity of standardized multimodal data-spanning pharmacokinetic, biodistribution, and drug-release profiles-anchored strictly to validated biological phenomena. Furthermore, we evaluate an algorithmic spectrum, ranging from classical machine learning to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and reinforcement learning (RL), to align models with specific formulation objectives. To bridge computational design and empirical reality, we examine how high-throughput technologies, such as robotic laboratories and in vivo DNA-barcoding multiplexing, operationalize the "Design-Make-Test-Analyze" (DMTA) cycle for dynamic model recalibration. Ultimately, this review demonstrates how integrating AI, physical constraints, and automated validation accelerates the rational design of next-generation nanomedicines.
zh_abstract: [Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany)] 纳米药物的转化常常因试错式优化而遭遇瓶颈。整合人工智能（AI）将该过程转变为闭环的、以实验为依据的发现生态系统。本综述为这一范式提供了路线图，展示AI、高通量测试和纳米尺度设计如何汇聚以产生可临床转化的纳米治疗药物。我们强调标准化多模态数据的必要性——这些数据跨越药代动力学、生物分布和药物释放谱，并严格锚定于已验证的生物学现象。此外，我们评估从经典机器学习到物理信息神经网络（PINNs）和强化学习（RL）的算法谱系，以使模型与特定制剂目标相匹配。为连接计算设计与经验现实，我们考察机器人实验室和体内DNA条形码多重检测等高通量技术如何操作化“Design-Make-Test-Analyze”（DMTA）循环，以进行动态模型重校准。最终，本综述展示整合AI、物理约束和自动化验证如何加速下一代纳米药物的理性设计。

title: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
zh_title: TeamGym：分布式信息下的AI智能体团队决策环境
summary: 发布TeamGym环境，用法律、金融、医疗等语料评测语言模型智能体的团队决策与信息共享。
key_points: 提出“关键信息”最小事实集识别方法
8个语言模型、12个来源语料库
智能体常无法有效共享信息
reason: 多领域智能体基准预印本，含医疗语料但非医疗专用，属值得一看档。
abstract: Many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants. Yet AI agents are still primarily trained and benchmarked in isolation. We introduce TeamGym, an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora. TeamGym introduces a method to identify a minimal set of facts, each element of which is necessary and all of which are collectively sufficient for a correct final decision, which we call pivotal information. This enables TeamGym to both control the distribution of pivotal information and track how well agents identify and integrate pivotal information when making team decisions. Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distributing pivotal information across participants lowers success rate by 22.9 percentage points on average relative to giving the same information to a single model (a communication gap). We also document that participants do not effectively retrieve decision-relevant information on their own: A team's success rate is lowered by a further 19.9 points when participants must identify and extract pivotal information from source material rather than receiving it directly (a retrieval gap). To help remedy these deficits, we use TeamGym to train policies through reinforcement learning on team decision loss. Across two policy-training experiments, we find that training improves final-decision quality and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication, even though the reward evaluates only the final decision.
zh_abstract: 许多现实世界决策要求团队整合分布于参与者之间的信息。然而，AI智能体仍主要是在孤立环境中训练和基准测试的。我们提出TeamGym，一个用于在由真实世界法律、金融、医疗和软件工程语料库构建的团队决策问题上评估和训练基于语言模型的智能体的环境。TeamGym提出一种识别最小事实集合的方法，其中每个元素都是必要的，且所有元素共同足以形成正确的最终决策，我们称之为关键信息（pivotal information）。这使TeamGym既能控制关键信息的分布，也能追踪智能体在做出团队决策时识别和整合关键信息的效果。在12个源语料库上检查8个语言模型，我们发现当前AI智能体常常无法有效共享信息：与将相同信息给予单个模型相比，将关键信息分布于参与者之间会使成功率平均降低22.9个百分点（一种沟通差距）。我们还记录了参与者不能有效自行检索决策相关信息：当参与者必须从源材料中识别并提取关键信息而不是直接接收这些信息时，团队的成功率进一步降低19.9个百分点（一种检索差距）。为帮助弥补这些缺陷，我们使用TeamGym通过基于团队决策损失的强化学习来训练策略。在两个策略训练实验中，我们发现训练提高了最终决策质量，并在参与、发言者选择和沟通中诱发了涌现式协调，尽管奖励仅评估最终决策。

title: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
zh_title: CellTrack-Bench：视觉语言模型细胞追踪基准
summary: 构建涵盖15个细胞追踪数据集、1537个问题的基准，评估视觉语言模型相对专用追踪器的表现。
key_points: 整合15个细胞追踪数据集
覆盖四种成像模态、1537个问题
含9041个细胞连接决策
reason: 新基准覆盖多数据集，但为预印本且证据有限
abstract: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. However, in these scenarios, their general-purpose accuracy compared with specialized algorithms remains in question. One such domain is cell tracking, which requires spatiotemporal awareness of cell dynamics. To evaluate this, we created a new benchmark, CellTrack-Bench, which assesses Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) cell-tracking-related performance against specialized trackers. The full benchmark draws from 15 standard cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities and comprises 1,537 problems corresponding to 9,041 cell-linking decisions. We selected a hard subset requiring greater reasoning effort by identifying failures shared across distinct algorithmic trackers. With this proposed dataset, we: (i) evaluated different environment harnesses for VLMs; (ii) benchmarked 9 frontier closed-source models and 13 open-weight models; and (iii) provided a detailed analysis of their failure modes. Code, the stored model outputs, and a pipeline that regenerates the benchmark from the source datasets are available at https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型在代码、数学和写作等以文本为先的任务上表现出色。近期工作正将模型训练转向纳入科学问题，而这些问题往往位于文本之外的高度专业化领域，如蛋白质结构和生物图像。然而，在这些场景中，与专用算法相比，其通用准确性仍存疑问。细胞追踪就是这样一个领域，它要求对细胞动态具有时空意识。为评估这一点，我们创建了一个新基准 CellTrack-Bench，用于评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）在细胞追踪相关任务上相对于专用追踪器的表现。完整基准来自四种成像模态的15个标准细胞追踪数据集，包含1,537个问题，对应9,041个细胞连接决策。我们通过识别不同算法追踪器共同出现的失败，选取了一个需要更多推理努力的困难子集。利用该数据集，我们：(i) 评估了用于 VLM 的不同环境测试框架（environment harnesses）；(ii) 对9个前沿闭源模型和13个开放权重模型进行了基准评测；(iii) 对其失败模式进行了详细分析。代码、保存的模型输出以及从源数据集重新生成该基准的流水线可在 https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench 获取。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Nanobody Engineering for Pathogen Recognition: From Functional Epitope Prioritization to Multimodal Foundation Models.
zh_title: AI驱动的纳米抗体工程：从功能表位到多模态基础模型
summary: 综述AI驱动的纳米抗体工程，从功能表位优先到多模态基础模型。
key_points: 组织为结构-功能-转化连续体
功能表位优先指导病原体靶向设计
预测结合不等于生物活性或成功转化
reason: 同行评审综述，聚焦AI纳米抗体设计，信息整合有价值但无新数据，给5分。
abstract: [Biomolecules] Nanobodies are compact and stable proteins derived from the variable domain of camelid heavy-chain-only antibodies (VHH). Advances in structural biology, molecular modeling, and artificial intelligence (AI) are shifting VHH discovery from empirical selection toward data-driven design. However, predicted binding alone does not ensure biological activity or successful translation, particularly for antigenically variable pathogens. Complementing recent reviews that broadly survey computational VHH modeling and optimization, this review focuses on how antigen biology and functional epitope prioritization can guide the design of pathogen-targeting VHHs. We organize the field along a structure-function-translation continuum, connecting the structural basis of VHH recognition and available data resources with conventional discovery, antigen-guided de novo design, and sequence-structure learning. We further examine how developability, recombinant production, multispecificity, humanization, structural dynamics, and antigenic variation shape the progression from predicted binders to functional VHHs. Finally, we discuss how multimodal foundation models could integrate these dimensions to support the design of functional, manufacturable, and escape-resilient VHHs.
zh_abstract: 【Biomolecules】纳米抗体（nanobodies）是源自骆驼科仅重链抗体可变域（VHH）的紧凑且稳定的蛋白质。结构生物学、分子建模和人工智能（AI）的进展正在使 VHH 发现从经验性筛选转向数据驱动设计。然而，仅凭预测的结合并不能保证生物学活性或成功转化，尤其是对于抗原易变的病原体。近期综述广泛梳理了计算 VHH 建模与优化，本综述作为补充，聚焦抗原生物学和功能性表位优先级如何指导靶向病原体的 VHH 设计。我们沿结构-功能-转化连续体组织该领域，将 VHH 识别的结构基础与可用数据资源，同传统发现、抗原指导的从头设计以及序列-结构学习联系起来。我们进一步考察可开发性、重组生产、多特异性、人源化、结构动力学和抗原变异如何影响从预测结合物到功能性 VHH 的进展。最后，我们讨论多模态基础模型如何整合这些维度，以支持设计功能性强、可制造且具有抗逃逸能力的 VHH。

title: M4Bench: Evaluating Procedural Specification for Clinical EHR Derivation Agents
