abstract: Clinical research over electronic health records depends on derived variables whose definitions sit outside the schema, in item codes, time windows, missingness rules, and output-grain choices that change cohorts and downstream conclusions. We introduce M4Bench, 28 clinical derivation tasks across 15 task families on MIMIC-IV and eICU, to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce such derivations and how clinician-reviewed agent skills change their results. Its controls decompose the value of skills into specification completeness, delivery format, and schema familiarity. In a Docker-isolated Codex campaign (GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5), skills raise reward by 0.136 over the no-skill baseline, with 26 of 28 tasks improving. Specification completeness accounts for most of this gain: on an eight-task control subset, an operational spec alone raises reward by 0.162, and skills add only 0.024 on top, indistinguishable from zero. On a ten-task subset, decoy skills score like no skill and raw reference SQL nearly matches targeted skills, arguing against generic context or the skill format as the explanation. Schema obfuscation and restructuring preserve 86% and 70% of the skill gain (GPT 5.4 Mini, 26 MIMIC-IV tasks), a descriptive robustness check rather than a bound on memorization. A descriptive Claude Code replication on all 28 tasks (Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6, 560 runs) is directionally consistent (+0.120, 21 of 28 tasks improving). These gains are partial agreement with the reference, not completed tasks: only 25 of 280 with-skill and 13 of 280 no-skill Codex runs pass every strict check, and skills barely change which rows agents return (key F1 +0.003). Skills are released as a versioned, clinician-reviewable markdown delivery format, with a family-level reference-validity audit. M4Bench releases tasks, skills, evaluation code, and sanitized per-run evidence as an open-source benchmark.
zh_abstract: 基于电子健康记录的临床研究依赖于派生变量，其定义位于模式（schema）之外，涉及条目代码、时间窗口、缺失规则和输出粒度选择，这些会改变队列和下游结论。我们推出 M4Bench，在 MIMIC-IV 和 eICU 上涵盖15个任务家族的28个临床派生任务，用以检验 AI 编程智能体能否复现此类派生，以及经临床医生审核的智能体技能如何改变其结果。其对照将技能的价值分解为规范完整性、交付格式和模式熟悉度。在 Docker 隔离的 Codex 实验中（GPT 5.4 Mini 和 GPT 5.5），技能相较无技能基线将奖励提高0.136，28个任务中有26个得到改善。规范完整性贡献了大部分增益：在一个八任务对照子集上，仅可操作规范即使奖励提高0.162，而技能在此之上仅增加0.024，与零无法区分。在一个十任务子集上，诱饵技能得分与无技能相当，原始参考 SQL 几乎匹敌针对性技能，这反驳了通用上下文或技能格式是解释的说法。模式混淆和重构分别保留了技能增益的86%和70%（GPT 5.4 Mini，26个 MIMIC-IV 任务），这是一项描述性稳健性检查，而非对记忆的界限。在全部28个任务上进行的描述性 Claude Code 复现（Opus 4.7 和 Sonnet 4.6，560次运行）方向一致（+0.120，28个任务中有21个改善）。这些增益是与参考的部分一致，而非完成任务：在280次带技能和280次无技能的 Codex 运行中，分别只有25次和13次通过全部严格检查，且技能几乎不改变智能体返回哪些行（关键 F1 +0.003）。技能以版本化、可供临床医生审核的 markdown 交付格式发布，并附有家族级参考有效性审计。M4Bench 以开源基准形式发布任务、技能、评估代码和经净化的每次运行证据。

title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
zh_title: 本体引导多智能体可解释鉴别诊断
summary: 预印本提出本体引导的多智能体框架，模拟医生迭代推理以生成可解释的鉴别诊断。
key_points: 使用本体约束提升证据支撑
多智能体复现迭代推理过程
针对LLM推理不透明的缺陷
reason: 方法有新意但为预印本，摘要未见外部验证，属值得一看。
abstract: Effective differential diagnosis depends on well structured and unambiguous patient case descriptions, since incomplete or ambiguous clinical information readily leads to diagnostic errors and inconsistent reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promising capabilities in medical question answering and clinical reasoning; however, even when achieving competitive performance on medical benchmarks, they often rely on pattern recognition learned from training data rather than grounded clinical evidence, and can generate plausible yet unsupported diagnostic conclusions. Their reasoning remains largely opaque, making it difficult for clinicians to assess the evidence and rationale behind a given recommendation. To address this gap, we propose an ontology-guided, multiagent differential diagnosis framework that replicates the iterative reasoning process of physicians. The framework grounds diagnostic inference in a structured, expert-curated medical knowledge base, enabling interpretation of symptoms, clinical findings, or disease relationships, while decomposing diagnosis into explicit, auditable reasoning steps. This ontology-based grounding constrains inference to evidence-backed associations, reducing hallucination and improving diagnostic transparency, traceability, and consistency. The system then identifies the most discriminative missing symptoms and generates targeted follow-up questions to reduce uncertainty through a process that mirrors to clinical inquiry. Together, these components improve the reliability, explainability, and diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted differential diagnosis. The source code is publicly available.
zh_abstract: 有效的鉴别诊断依赖于结构良好且明确无歧义的患者病例描述，因为不完整或含糊的临床信息很容易导致诊断错误和推理不一致。大语言模型（LLMs）近期在医学问答和临床推理方面显示出有前景的能力；然而，即使在医学基准测试中取得有竞争力的表现，它们往往依赖从训练数据中学到的模式识别，而非有依据的临床证据，并且可能生成看似合理但缺乏支持的诊断结论。其推理在很大程度上仍不透明，使临床医生难以评估某一推荐背后的证据和理由。为解决这一差距，我们提出一个本体引导的多智能体鉴别诊断框架，该框架复现医生的迭代推理过程。该框架将诊断推理建立在结构化、由专家策划的医学知识库之上，能够解释症状、临床发现或疾病关系，同时将诊断分解为明确、可审计的推理步骤。这种基于本体的接地（grounding）将推理约束为有证据支持的关联，减少幻觉并提高诊断的透明性、可追溯性和一致性。然后，系统识别最具鉴别力的缺失症状，并生成有针对性的随访问题，通过一个模拟临床询问的过程来降低不确定性。总之，这些组件提高了AI辅助鉴别诊断的可靠性、可解释性和诊断准确性。源代码已公开。

title: Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies
zh_title: 可解释多模态AI减少不必要乳腺活检
summary: 预印本用ViT加DeBERTa融合图像与报告文本，在1632例院内数据预测BI-RADS 4/5病灶良性并配Grad-CAM。
key_points: ViT提取影像特征、DeBERTa编码报告文本后晚期融合
院内1632例、每例四视角钼靶加对应报告
目标为预测活检良性以辅助减少不必要活检
reason: 方法有新意但仅院内数据内部验证，属预印本中等档
abstract: Recently, there has been rise in multimodal vision-language models for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD), yet their application in breast diagnosis, particularly for predicting biopsy outcomes remains limited. This study presents a multimodal vision-language approach, incorporating Grad-CAM as an Explainable AI (XAI) technique, to predict benign tumors in patients recommended for biopsy, especially those classified as BI-RADS 4 and 5. A novel multimodal framework was devel- oped using Vision Transformer (ViT) for imaging feature extraction and DeBERTa-V3-Large for textual embeddings. The model was trained and evaluated on a comprehensive in-house dataset comprising 1,632 patients, each with four mammography views and a corresponding radiology report. The features of both modalities were extracted independently and fused by late fusion before classification. Grad-CAM was used to generate visual explanations highlighting key regions influencing model predictions. The proposed model demonstrated high sensitivity 90%, 95%, 99%, and 100% with corresponding specificities of 40%, 36%, 18%, and 11%, respectively. The best AUC achieved was 0.72 by multimodal approach on the test set, outperforming the image only (0.66) and text-only (0.68) baselines. The proposed multimodal architecture, enhanced with Grad-CAM, demonstrates a strong potential to identify benign tumors among high-risk patients, offering interpretable insights and thereby helping reduce unnecessary biopsies, patient anxiety, and healthcare costs.
zh_abstract: 近年来，用于计算机辅助诊断（CAD）的多模态视觉-语言模型有所增加，但其在乳腺诊断中的应用，尤其是预测活检结局方面仍然有限。本研究提出一种多模态视觉-语言方法，纳入Grad-CAM作为可解释人工智能（XAI）技术，用于预测被建议活检患者中的良性肿瘤，尤其是被分类为BI-RADS 4和5的患者。开发了一种新型多模态框架，使用视觉Transformer（ViT）提取影像特征，并使用DeBERTa-V3-Large进行文本嵌入。该模型在一个包含1,632名患者的综合内部数据集上训练和评估，每名患者均有四个乳腺摄影视图和相应的放射学报告。两种模态的特征独立提取，并在分类前通过晚期融合进行整合。Grad-CAM用于生成视觉解释，突出影响模型预测的关键区域。所提出的模型表现出高灵敏度90%、95%、99%和100%，相应的特异度分别为40%、36%、18%和11%。多模态方法在测试集上达到的最佳AUC为0.72，优于仅影像（0.66）和仅文本（0.68）基线。所提出的多模态架构结合Grad-CAM增强，在识别高危患者中的良性肿瘤方面显示出强大潜力，提供可解释的见解，从而有助于减少不必要的活检、患者焦虑和医疗成本。

title: Mimic: A Unified Neural Network Architecture for Modelling Genomic Sequences and Module-level Comparison
zh_title: Mimic：统一神经网络架构用于基因组序列建模与模块级比较
summary: bioRxiv 预印本提出统一架构 Mimic，用于系统比较基因组序列神经网络各组件，并在蛋白-DNA 等数据集上建模。
key_points: 归纳现有基因组神经网络的三段式架构
提出统一架构 Mimic 以便公平比较组件
在两类基因组数据集上完成建模测试
reason: 有新方法且做基线对比的预印本，证据限于内部实验，属值得一看档
abstract: There exist a wide range of Neural Networks (NNs) that have modelled genomic sequences well. The architectures of these NNs consist of three steps: k-mer embedding, sequence embedding, and output mapping. The NNs are primarily differentiated from one another by their sequence embedding components. Although different NNs have been compared before, these comparisons are often either limited or involve drastically different NNs. Another issue is that some NNs are configured for a specific sequence length, and different length sequences require manual modification of the architectures. This study examines the architectures of established NNs for genomics sequences. Based on these architectures, a novel NN called Mimic is developed that provides a unified architecture for the principled comparison of NN components. Mimic was used to model two different types of genomic datasets: protein-DNA interactions and enhancer activity. Along with other architecture components, different sequence embedding strategies were tried such as recurrent layers and convolutional layers. It was found that there exist specific NN components that yield significantly better performing models. Furthermore, Mimic significantly outperformed prevailing standard NNs, Bichrom and DeepSTARR, in modelling protein-DNA interactions and enhancer activity, respectively. This study provides a framework for more extensive studies toward a general prescription of NN architecture for modelling genomics data.
zh_abstract: 已有多种神经网络（NNs）能够很好地建模基因组序列。这些神经网络的架构包括三个步骤：k-mer嵌入、序列嵌入和输出映射。这些神经网络之间的主要区别在于其序列嵌入组件。尽管此前已对不同神经网络进行比较，但这些比较往往有限，或涉及差异极大的神经网络。另一个问题是，一些神经网络针对特定序列长度进行配置，不同长度的序列需要手动修改架构。本研究考察了用于基因组序列的已有神经网络架构。基于这些架构，开发了一种名为Mimic的新型神经网络，为神经网络组件的原则性比较提供了统一架构。Mimic被用于建模两种不同类型的基因组数据集：蛋白质-DNA相互作用和增强子活性。除其他架构组件外，还尝试了不同的序列嵌入策略，如循环层和卷积层。研究发现，存在特定的神经网络组件可使模型性能显著更优。此外，Mimic在建模蛋白质-DNA相互作用和增强子活性方面分别显著优于现有的标准神经网络Bichrom和DeepSTARR。本研究为更广泛的研究提供了框架，以推动形成用于建模基因组数据的神经网络架构的一般性规范。

title: Retrospective macromolecular pool fraction mapping from conventional clinical MRI: a physics-guided self-supervised deep learning framework
zh_title: 从常规临床MRI回顾性估计大分子池分数的自监督框架
summary: 预印本提出物理引导的自监督深度学习框架，无需配对定量扫描，直接从T1、T2与FLAIR脑MRI估计大分子池分数。
key_points: 嵌入双池磁化传递解析信号模型
以自适应实例归一化适配不同采集协议
在多站点数据上训练与评估
reason: 方法有新意且用多站点数据，但为预印本无临床验证
abstract: Macromolecular pool fraction (MPF) is a quantitative imaging biomarker sensitive to myelin integrity and other changes in tissue macromolecular content, but specialized acquisitions and reconstruction methods limit its use in large-scale studies. We present a physics-guided, self-supervised deep learning framework for retrospectively estimating MPF directly from conventional clinical brain MRI ($T_1$-weighted, $T_2$-weighted, and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery [FLAIR]) without paired quantitative reference scans. The framework embeds an analytical two-pool magnetization transfer signal model that related sequence-averaged radiofrequency transmit power to apparent longitudinal relaxation. To accommodate heterogeneous clinical protocols, the network conditions intermediate features on acquisition parameters via adaptive instance normalization. It was trained and evaluated on a multisite, multivendor, multiprotocol dataset of 7,705 MRI sessions (3 T). Across 1,237 test sessions, mean MPF was $0.182 \pm 0.007$ in white matter and $0.144 \pm 0.009$ in gray matter, with limited variation across vendor-by-protocol groups (between-group coefficient of variation: 2.65% and 5.63%, respectively). In 70 sessions with demyelinating-disease labels, MPF was 35.6% lower in segmented lesions than in normal-appearing white matter. MPF maps from two different clinical protocols acquired in a healthy volunteer showed a mean voxel-wise absolute percentage difference of 7.7% and a concordance correlation coefficient of $0.888$, indicating good cross-protocol consistency. These results suggest that magnetization transfer-informed self-supervised learning enables stable MPF mapping from conventional clinical MRI, providing a scalable approach to investigate demyelinating pathology in both existing imaging archives and prospectively acquired conventional clinical scans without dedicated qMT acquisitions.
zh_abstract: 大分子池分数（MPF）是一种定量影像生物标志物，对髓鞘完整性以及组织大分子含量的其他变化敏感，但专门的采集和重建方法限制了其在大规模研究中的应用。我们提出了一种物理引导的自监督深度学习框架，可在无需配对的定量参考扫描的情况下，直接从常规临床脑MRI（T1加权、T2加权和液体衰减反转恢复[FLAIR]）回顾性估计MPF。该框架嵌入了一个解析的双池磁化转移信号模型，该模型将序列平均的射频发射功率与表观纵向弛豫相关联。为适应异质性临床协议，网络通过自适应实例归一化使中间特征以采集参数为条件。该框架在一个由7,705次MRI检查（3 T）组成的多中心、多厂商、多协议数据集上进行了训练和评估。在1,237次测试检查中，白质中平均MPF为0.182 ± 0.007，灰质中为0.144 ± 0.009，各厂商×协议分组之间变异有限（组间变异系数分别为2.65%和5.63%）。在70次带有脱髓鞘疾病标签的检查中，分割病灶中的MPF比表现正常白质低35.6%。在一名健康志愿者中采集的两种不同临床协议所得MPF图显示，平均体素级绝对百分比差异为7.7%，一致性相关系数为0.888，表明跨协议一致性良好。这些结果提示，磁化转移信息引导的自监督学习能够从常规临床MRI实现稳定的MPF映射，为在现有影像档案和前瞻性采集的常规临床扫描中研究脱髓鞘病理提供了一种可扩展的方法，而无需专门的qMT采集。

title: How Much Can AI Virtual Cells Gain from Unified Perturbational Modeling?
zh_title: 统一扰动建模能为AI虚拟细胞带来多少增益
summary: 预印本在VAE虚拟细胞预测器中引入基因通道对齐、共享扰动编码与联合嵌入三个模块，系统性评估统一建模异质Perturb-seq数据的效果。
key_points: 针对基因集、扰动类型与细胞背景异质性
在VAE预测器中加入三个统一化模块
系统性评估统一扰动建模范式收益
reason: 新方法有系统评估但为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Predicting how individual cells respond to perturbations is a central task in artificial intelligence virtual cell (AIVC) modeling. However, integrating perturbation datasets is challenging because they differ in measured gene sets, perturbation types and cellular contexts. Existing AIVC predictors are typically developed for specific settings, limiting their applicability across heterogeneous datasets. Here, we investigate the extent to which AIVC predictors can benefit from unified perturbational modeling (UPM), a novel paradigm designed to integrate heterogeneous Perturb-seq datasets into a single predictive model. To this end, we introduce three unification modules into a variational autoencoder (VAE)-based AIVC predictor to address these sources of heterogeneity: gene-channel alignment, shared perturbation encoding, and joint embedding of gene expression and identity. We systematically evaluate and validate the individual contributions of these modules. Building on UPM, we assemble a dataset of 110 million cells spanning over 22,000 genes, four perturbation types and 76 cellular contexts, and use 89.7 million cells from 71 contexts to train a unified AIVC predictor with more than one billion parameters. Across genetic perturbation benchmarks, UPM achieves the highest PES and gene-wise response correlation among the evaluated models. It also improves all four evaluation metrics over State on the five held-out Tahoe-100M cell lines and over Stack on the cytokine benchmark. UPM also improves combinatorial perturbation prediction relative to specialized predictors. In the HSC application, our model achieves a 40.0% improvement in accuracy on a downstream task involving the recapitulation of effects induced by the knockdown of hepatic stellate cell (HSC)-related targets. Our implementation is openly available at https://github.com/youlab2025/UPM.
zh_abstract: 预测单个细胞如何响应扰动是人工智能虚拟细胞（AIVC）建模的核心任务。然而，整合扰动数据集具有挑战性，因为它们在所测基因集、扰动类型和细胞背景方面存在差异。现有AIVC预测器通常针对特定设置开发，限制了其跨异质性数据集的适用性。在此，我们研究AIVC预测器能在多大程度上受益于统一扰动建模（UPM），这是一种旨在将异质性Perturb-seq数据集整合到单一预测模型中的新范式。为此，我们在基于变分自编码器（VAE）的AIVC预测器中引入三个统一模块以处理这些异质性来源：基因通道对齐、共享扰动编码，以及基因表达与身份的联合嵌入。我们系统评估并验证了这些模块各自的贡献。基于UPM，我们构建了一个包含1.1亿个细胞、涵盖超过22,000个基因、四种扰动类型和76种细胞背景的数据集，并使用来自71种背景的8,970万个细胞训练了一个参数超过十亿的统一AIVC预测器。在遗传扰动基准上，UPM在所评估模型中取得了最高的PES和基因水平响应相关性。在五个留出的Tahoe-100M细胞系上相较于State、以及在细胞因子基准上相较于Stack，它还提升了全部四项评价指标。相对于专门化预测器，UPM还改进了组合扰动预测。在HSC应用中，我们的模型在一项下游任务上实现了40.0%的准确率提升，该任务涉及重现肝星状细胞（HSC）相关靶点敲低所诱导的效应。我们的实现已在https://github.com/youlab2025/UPM公开可用。

title: Identification of gene kinetics patterns improves RNA velocity and cell fate prediction using JuloVelo
zh_title: JuloVelo：利用基因动力学模式提升RNA速率与细胞命运预测
summary: 预印本提出JuloVelo深度学习框架，先判定每个基因的动力学模式以预训练权重初始化网络，改进RNA速率建模。
key_points: 按Circle、完全诱导、完全抑制三类模式预判基因动力学
用模式匹配的预训练权重初始化，规避非生理参数区间
可处理多组学（multiome）数据集并建模
reason: 新方法预印本，有方法创新但仅有摘要信息，属值得一看档
abstract: Single-cell RNA velocity has transformed our capacity to predict future cell states from sequencing snapshots, but existing methods rely on constant or binary kinetic assumptions that fail to capture the heterogeneous splicing dynamics of cellular differentiation. Here we present JuloVelo, a deep learning framework that demonstrates that identifying gene kinetics patterns to initialize neural network training dramatically improves RNA velocity model performance. By pre-determining whether each gene follows a Circle, Complete induction, or Complete repression pattern across cellular differentiation, JuloVelo initializes training with pattern-matched, pre-trained network weights, effectively guiding the cell-specific kinetics optimization away from biologically implausible parameter regimes. Additionally, JuloVelo demonstrates that multiome datasets can also be processed and modeled by utilizing promoter chromatin accessibility to guide kinetics pre-determination, and integrates an in silico perturbation framework to simulate transcription factor modulation on cell fate. Validated across eight datasets spanning erythrogenesis, neurogenesis, and endocrinogenesis, JuloVelo consistently outperformed constant-rate and cell-specific models, resolving the entire five-lineage differentiation program in hippocampal neurogenesis. Multiome processing improved both intrinsic and extrinsic velocity stability, and JuloVelo reduced computational execution time by approximately 70% compared to cellDancer. JuloVelo is available as an open-source package at https://github.com/jhlabtw/JuloVelo.jl.
zh_abstract: 单细胞 RNA 速率（RNA velocity）改变了我们根据测序快照预测未来细胞状态的能力，但现有方法依赖恒定或二值动力学假设，这些假设无法捕捉细胞分化中异质的剪接动态。在此，我们提出 JuloVelo，这是一个深度学习框架，它表明识别基因动力学模式以初始化神经网络训练可显著提高 RNA 速率模型的性能。通过预先确定每个基因在细胞分化过程中遵循 Circle、Complete induction 还是 Complete repression 模式，JuloVelo 使用模式匹配的预训练网络权重初始化训练，从而有效地引导细胞特异性动力学优化远离生物学上不合理的参数范围。此外，JuloVelo 表明，多组学（multiome）数据集也可通过利用启动子染色质可及性来指导动力学预确定而得到处理和建模，并集成了一个计算机模拟（in silico）扰动框架，以模拟转录因子对细胞命运的调控。在涵盖红细胞生成（erythrogenesis）、神经发生（neurogenesis）和内分泌发生（endocrinogenesis）的八个数据集上验证，JuloVelo 始终优于恒定速率模型和细胞特异性模型，解析了海马神经发生中完整的五谱系分化程序。多组学处理提高了内在和外在速率稳定性，并且与 cellDancer 相比，JuloVelo 将计算执行时间减少了约 70%。JuloVelo 作为开源软件包可在 https://github.com/jhlabtw/JuloVelo.jl 获取。

title: OpenGray: a benchmark for evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents
zh_title: OpenGray：放疗计划智能体决策评测基准
summary: 预印本发布OpenGray基准，在头颈数据集上加入已知正确答案的计划任务以评测LLM放疗计划智能体的决策。
key_points: 任务含两组与剂量目标不可兼容的矛盾条件及可行对照
评测4类系统、30例患者，含商用与本地LLM
同时从39次临床智能体SAGE放疗运行日志读取决策
reason: 新基准且具已知答案设计，但样本30例、为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Background and purpose: Radiotherapy planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) decide when to submit a plan or request review but are evaluated mainly by dose. This study developed OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions. Materials and methods: OpenGray adds tasks with known answers to the OpenKBP-Opt head-and-neck dataset, including two contradictions with dose goals proven incompatible and a feasible control with a stored plan meeting every hard goal. Four systems, from a rule-based planning script to a full LLM agent, were evaluated on 30 patients, the LLM-based ones with a commercial (Terra) and a local (Ministral 3 8B) LLM. Decisions, achieved dose, problem recognition, and technical failures were recorded and also read from logs of 39 stereotactic radiosurgery runs of SAGE, a clinical LLM agent. Results: With Terra, the script preceded by an LLM review and the full agent had decision accuracies of 95.4% and 92.1%, respectively, yet escalated only 50% (95% confidence interval, 25-75%) and 25% (10-40%) of overlap contradictions, which required arithmetic on the anatomy. All four systems submitted every feasible control, but 24% of these plans missed a hard goal that the stored plan had met. In four SAGE runs, one goal failed at every attempt; the agent identified it in every reply but had no action for stopping. Conclusions: Favorable aggregate scores concealed specific decision failures. Planning agents should be evaluated on their decisions as well as their dose and given an explicit action for stopping and requesting review.
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】基于大语言模型（LLM）的放疗计划智能体决定何时提交计划或请求审核，但主要按剂量进行评估。本研究开发了 OpenGray，这是一个具有已知正确决策的计划任务基准。【材料与方法】OpenGray 在 OpenKBP-Opt 头颈数据集上增加了具有已知答案的任务，包括两个与剂量目标相矛盾且被证明不可兼得的任务，以及一个可行性对照，其存储计划满足每一项硬性目标。四种系统，从基于规则的计划脚本到完整 LLM 智能体，在 30 名患者上进行了评估；基于 LLM 的系统分别使用商用（Terra）和本地（Ministral 3 8B）LLM。记录了决策、实际达到的剂量、问题识别和技术故障，并且也从临床 LLM 智能体 SAGE 的 39 次立体定向放射外科运行日志中读取了这些信息。【结果】使用 Terra 时，先由 LLM 审核的脚本和完整智能体的决策准确率分别为 95.4% 和 92.1%，但它们仅上报了 50%（95% 置信区间，25-75%）和 25%（10-40%）需要基于解剖结构进行算术计算的重叠矛盾（overlap contradictions）。所有四种系统都提交了每一个可行对照，但这些计划中有 24% 未达到存储计划已满足的一项硬性目标。在四次 SAGE 运行中，有一个目标在每次尝试时都失败；智能体在每次回复中都识别出了它，但没有用于停止的动作。【结论】良好的总体评分掩盖了具体的决策失败。计划智能体应同时根据其决策和剂量进行评估，并被赋予明确的停止和请求审核动作。

title: BLOOM: Biologically Informed Flow Matching for Transcriptomic Virtual Embryo Modeling
zh_title: BLOOM：面向转录组虚拟胚胎的生物启发流匹配模型
summary: 预印本提出条件流匹配框架BLOOM，结合发育与调控先验，生成指定发育阶段的小鼠细胞表达分布。
key_points: 整合时间群体背景与发育、调控先验
在三个小鼠单细胞图谱上与22个时序基线比较
基因与细胞表达相关性在三套数据上均排名第一
reason: 方法新颖且有大量基线对比，但为预印本且仅小鼠数据，属值得一看档
abstract: Constructing a virtual embryo requires a generative representation of how heterogeneous cell populations change across developmental time. Here we introduce BLOOM, a biologically informed framework for conditional generation of developmental cell populations. BLOOM integrates temporal population context with developmental and regulatory priors through conditional flow matching to generate cell-expression distributions at queried stages in either temporal direction. Evaluation spans three mouse single-cell atlases covering prenatal development, visual-cortex maturation and multi-organ endothelial specialization. In comparisons with 22 time-series forecasting baselines, BLOOM ranks first for gene- and cell-expression correlations across all three datasets. Measured-stage evaluations support recovery of developmental expression patterns, population organization and marker-specific temporal relationships. Biological analyses connect these predictions to cell-state identities, gene programmes and regulatory associations. At unmeasured stages, interpolation and autoregressive history and future rollouts extend simulated expression dynamics between and beyond measured timepoints. Analyses of marker genes and temporal descriptors identify candidate differences in the timing of muscle-associated, neural and vascular-specialization programmes. Input-based gene perturbations further probe predicted responses of edited genes and associated molecular programmes across time. Together, BLOOM supports transcriptomic virtual embryo modeling by bridging temporal sampling gaps, exploring extended developmental trajectories and prioritizing gene-dependent hypotheses for experimental investigation.
zh_abstract: 构建虚拟胚胎需要一种生成式表征，用以描述异质性细胞群体如何在发育时间中变化。在此我们介绍 BLOOM，一种用于条件性生成发育细胞群体的生物学信息引导框架。BLOOM 通过条件流匹配将时间群体背景与发育及调控先验整合，以在任一时间方向上生成查询阶段的细胞表达分布。评估涵盖三个小鼠单细胞图谱，覆盖产前发育、视觉皮层成熟和多器官内皮特化。在与 22 个时间序列预测基线比较中，BLOOM 在全部三个数据集上的基因表达相关性和细胞表达相关性均排名第一。对已测量阶段的评估支持恢复发育表达模式、群体组织和标志物特异性时间关系。生物学分析将这些预测与细胞状态身份、基因程序和调控关联联系起来。在未测量阶段，插值以及自回归的历史和未来推演将模拟表达动态扩展到已测量时间点之间及之外。对标志基因和时间描述符的分析识别出肌肉相关、神经和血管特化程序在时间安排上的候选差异。基于输入的基因扰动进一步探究编辑基因及相关分子程序随时间的预测响应。总之，BLOOM 通过弥合时间采样缺口、探索扩展的发育轨迹并优先考虑用于实验研究的基因依赖性假说，支持转录组虚拟胚胎建模。

title: Systematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding for Representation Learning in Neurodegenerative Diseases
zh_title: SYMBA：面向神经退行性疾病的结构脑MRI自监督预训练
summary: 预印本提出SYMBA自监督预训练框架，通过解剖约束掩码与多尺度结构相似重建学习脑MRI表征。
key_points: 针对结构T1 MRI设计，而非直接沿用自然图像范式
融合解剖约束掩码、MS-SSIM重建目标与渐进式课程
动机为标注有限与扫描仪导致的分布偏移
reason: 方法有针对性设计，但摘要未见外部验证结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Early identification of neurodegenerative disorders using structural T1-weighted MRI is essential for timely clinical intervention, yet supervised deep learning models often struggle to generalize due to limited annotations and scanner-induced distribution shift. Self-supervised learning offers a promising alternative; however, existing approaches are largely adapted from natural image paradigms, relying on contrastive objectives or generic masked reconstruction with voxel-wise losses, which may not fully capture the distributed morphometric patterns associated with neurodegeneration. We introduce SYMBA (SYstematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding), a self-supervised pretraining framework specifically designed for structural brain MRI. SYMBA integrates anatomically constrained masking, a multi-scale structural similarity (MS-SSIM) reconstruction objective, and a progressive curriculum that transitions from local anatomical detail to global brain morphology. These components explicitly incorporate neuroanatomical structure into the self-supervised objective rather than relying on generic image priors. Pretrained on 6,953 T1-weighted MRI scans from nine heterogeneous cohorts, SYMBA is evaluated using frozen linear probing on two independent unseen datasets, enabling a strict assessment of out-of-distribution generalization. Across multiple clinical tasks, SYMBA consistently outperforms recent neuroimaging foundation models, achieving 0.930 AUROC for Alzheimer's disease classification, 0.772 for mild cognitive impairment conversion prediction, and strong performance in amyloid status prediction. In low-label regimes, SYMBA demonstrates high sample efficiency, reaching approximately 0.90 AUROC for AD/CN classification using only six labeled subjects.
zh_abstract: 使用结构T1加权MRI早期识别神经退行性疾病对于及时临床干预至关重要，但监督式深度学习模型常因标注有限和扫描仪引起的分布偏移而难以泛化。自监督学习提供了一种有前景的替代方案；然而，现有方法大多改编自自然图像范式，依赖对比目标或带有逐体素损失的通用掩蔽重建，可能无法充分捕捉与神经退行性变相关的分布式形态学模式。我们介绍SYMBA（SYstematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding），一种专门为结构性脑MRI设计的自监督预训练框架。SYMBA整合了解剖学约束掩蔽、多尺度结构相似性（MS-SSIM）重建目标，以及从局部解剖细节过渡到全局脑形态的渐进式课程。这些组成部分将神经解剖结构明确纳入自监督目标，而不是依赖通用图像先验。SYMBA在来自九个异质队列的6,953份T1加权MRI扫描上进行预训练，并在两个独立的未见数据集上使用冻结线性探测进行评估，从而能够严格评估分布外泛化。在多项临床任务中，SYMBA持续优于近期神经影像基础模型，在阿尔茨海默病分类中达到0.930 AUROC，在轻度认知障碍转化预测中达到0.772，并在淀粉样蛋白状态预测中表现良好。在低标注情景下，SYMBA表现出高样本效率，仅使用六名有标注受试者即可在AD/CN分类中达到约0.90 AUROC。

title: OA-RAG: Ontology-based Agentic RAG for Faithful LLM Reasoning
zh_title: OA-RAG：基于本体的智能体RAG
summary: 提出OA-RAG智能体，将本体形式推理与LLM推理结合，并报告证据接地等级。
key_points: 整合本体逻辑结构与非形式注释
为每个答案报告所用本体证据
给出entailed等四级接地强度
reason: 预印本方法有新意，有本体基准但未见临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) perform well across many real-world tasks but remain prone to hallucination, limiting their reliability in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare, where answers must be grounded in established knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this problem by incorporating external information, but often overlooks logical relationships and relies heavily on the LLM's own reasoning, which can compromise answer faithfulness. We propose OA-RAG, an agent that integrates formal reasoning with LLM reasoning, drawing on both the logical structure and informal annotations of domain ontologies. For each answer, OA-RAG reports the ontology observations used as evidence and a model-assessed grounding level (entailed, supported, related, or unrelated) that characterises the strength of that evidence. Across benchmarks derived from three large-scale ontologies and six real-world medical question-answering tasks, OA-RAG achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated ontology-fine-tuned and popular RAG methods, with particularly strong results on reasoning-intensive tasks. The reported grounding levels also offer a useful indication of answer reliability, with stronger grounding generally associated with higher accuracy. Finally, our results demonstrate the value of ontologies as knowledge sources: OA-RAG is competitive with, and sometimes outperforms, domain-specific RAG systems that draw on sources such as textbooks.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在许多现实世界任务中表现良好，但仍易产生幻觉，限制了其在生物医学和医疗保健等领域的可靠性，因为这些领域的答案必须基于已确立的知识。检索增强生成（RAG）通过纳入外部信息缓解这一问题，但往往忽视逻辑关系，并严重依赖LLM自身的推理，这可能损害答案的忠实性。我们提出OA-RAG，一种将形式推理与LLM推理相结合的智能体，利用领域本体的逻辑结构和非正式注释。对于每个答案，OA-RAG报告用作证据的本体观察结果以及模型评估的接地水平（蕴含、支持、相关或不相关；entailed、supported、related、unrelated），以刻画该证据的强度。在源自三个大规模本体的基准和六个真实世界医学问答任务上，OA-RAG在所评估的经本体微调的方法和常用RAG方法中取得最佳总体性能，在推理密集型任务上结果尤其强。所报告的接地水平也为答案可靠性提供了有用指示，通常更强的接地与更高的准确率相关。最后，我们的结果证明了本体作为知识来源的价值：OA-RAG与借鉴教科书等来源的领域特定RAG系统具有竞争力，有时甚至优于后者。

title: Reliability-Aware Short-Term Glycemic Risk Prediction Using an Anchor-Based Comparative Framework of Sequence, Multimodal, and State-Updating Digital-Twin Models
zh_title: 基于锚点对比框架的血糖风险短期预测
summary: 在T1DiabetesGranada上构建550万预测锚点，统一比较序列、多模态与状态更新数字孪生模型的血糖风险预测。
key_points: 736名1型糖尿病患者，550万标准化预测锚点
预测30/60/120分钟高低血糖风险
三种架构在相同患者级验证协议下对比，兼评可靠性
reason: 样本与评测框架较规范，但为预印本且仅内部验证，值得一看档
abstract: Anticipating short-term hypoglycemic and hyperglycemic risk is essential for proactive diabetes management. However, existing machine learning approaches often use inconsistent evaluation protocols and emphasize predictive performance over reliability. This study introduces an anchor-based benchmarking framework integrating longitudinal glucose sequences and multimodal patient information. Using the T1DiabetesGranada dataset, 5,503,441 standardized prediction anchors were constructed from 736 individuals with type 1 diabetes to evaluate hypoglycemia and hyperglycemia prediction at 30-, 60-, and 120-minute horizons. Three neural architectures, a Hybrid LSTM-Transformer, a Multimodal Digital Twin, and a State-Updating Digital Twin with gap-aware longitudinal state progression, were compared under identical patient-level validation protocols. Beyond predictive performance, the evaluation examined calibration, classification thresholds, explanation reliability, cross-model disagreement, and robustness to controlled perturbations. No statistically significant predictive differences were observed after Holm correction, although the models exhibited complementary reliability characteristics. The Multimodal Digital Twin achieved the lowest mean Brier score, while the State-Updating Digital Twin demonstrated the lowest mean expected calibration error (ECE-10). The Hybrid LSTM-Transformer showed strong explanation faithfulness and stability under its temporal attribution protocol. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating digital-twin models beyond predictive accuracy and emphasize the need for reliability assessment and external validation before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 预测短期低血糖和高血糖风险对于主动糖尿病管理至关重要。然而，现有机器学习方法常使用不一致的评估协议，并强调预测性能而非可靠性。本研究引入一个基于锚点的基准测试框架，整合纵向血糖序列和多模态患者信息。使用 T1DiabetesGranada 数据集，从 736 名 1 型糖尿病患者构建了 5,503,441 个标准化预测锚点，以评估 30、60 和 120 分钟时间范围内的低血糖和高血糖预测。三种神经架构——混合 LSTM-Transformer、多模态数字孪生（Multimodal Digital Twin）和具有间隙感知纵向状态进展的状态更新数字孪生（State-Updating Digital Twin）——在相同的患者水平验证协议下进行比较。除预测性能外，评估还考察了校准、分类阈值、解释可靠性、跨模型分歧以及对受控扰动的稳健性。经 Holm 校正后，未观察到统计学显著的预测差异，尽管这些模型表现出互补的可靠性特征。多模态数字孪生获得最低的平均 Brier 分数，而状态更新数字孪生表现出最低的平均期望校准误差（ECE-10）。混合 LSTM-Transformer 在其时间归因协议下表现出较强的解释忠实性和稳定性。这些发现强调了在预测准确性之外评估数字孪生模型的重要性，并强调在临床部署前进行可靠性评估和外部验证的必要性。

title: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
zh_title: CohortFlow：可局部语义修正的临床队列构建智能体
summary: 提出可操控的队列筛选智能体，将自然语言修正转为结构化更新，减少重算与延迟。
key_points: 基于临床试验入排标准构建100个场景、126次修正
局部修正F1 77.0%，与全量重生成差异不显著
修正延迟降低约45%–65%，模型调用减少38.1%
reason: 有新意的智能体方法并有对照评测，但效果提升不显著，预印本
abstract: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). It reduces mean correction latency by 64.8% after completion and 44.3% during execution, with 38.1% fewer model calls. In a separate proof-of-concept evaluation over MIMIC, all 13 cohort states execute successfully, while correction trajectories demonstrate selective preservation of unaffected computations and recomputation of changed or dependent nodes. Together, these results show that localized semantic steering can substantially reduce correction latency and model calls while maintaining strong requirement-level accuracy.
zh_abstract: 用于临床队列整理的语言模型智能体应能适应不断变化的入排标准，而无需重复处理未改变的要求。我们引入 CohortFlow，一种可引导智能体，其将自然语言纠正表示为对结构化队列规范的局部更新，并将其与持久化执行图协调一致。显式记录的语义依赖使受影响的计算能够被选择性失效，同时保留有效的先前结果。在源自临床试验入排标准的 100 个场景（包含 126 个纠正轮次）上，局部引导达到 77.0% 的需求 micro-F1，而使用相同 8B 模型进行完全重新生成时为 76.4%，这一数值优势较小且无统计学显著性（p=0.493）。在完成后将平均纠正延迟降低 64.8%，在执行期间降低 44.3%，模型调用次数减少 38.1%。在 MIMIC 上的单独概念验证评估中，全部 13 个队列状态均成功执行，同时纠正轨迹显示未受影响计算被选择性保留，而已更改或依赖节点被重新计算。总之，这些结果表明，局部语义引导可以在保持较强需求级准确性的同时，大幅降低纠正延迟和模型调用。

title: Beyond Physical Illness: Can Clinical Narratives Reveal Emerging Mental Health Risks in Chronically Ill Patients?
zh_title: 从临床叙事推断慢性病患者的潜在心理风险
summary: 基于MIMIC-III约4000名患者，用层次状态空间模型从每日病程记录推断住院期间心理健康风险。
key_points: 弱监督方式从出院小结提取心理健康证据
构建约4000人慢性病住院队列
建模叙事表征的时间演化以估计风险
reason: 单库回顾性研究，结果标注为初步，仅内部评估，值得一看档
abstract: Mental-health risks such as depression, dementia, and suicidal ideation can emerge during hospitalization among chronically ill patients and may worsen without timely recognition and intervention. However, most existing mental health studies focus on patients with established psychiatric conditions rather than patients hospitalized primarily for physical illness. In this work, we investigate whether latent mental-health risk in chronically ill patients can be inferred from longitudinal clinical narratives. We construct a weakly supervised cohort around 4,000 patients from MIMIC-III using mental-health evidence extracted from discharge summaries. A hierarchical state-space framework derives mental-health representations from day-wise clinical narratives and models their temporal evolution for risk estimation throughout hospitalization. Preliminary results demonstrate improved binary risk prediction using the proposed representations and show distinct model derived risk trajectories between risk and no-risk cohorts, providing a foundation for studying emerging mental-health risks in chronically ill patients.
zh_abstract: 抑郁、痴呆和自杀意念等精神健康风险可在慢性病患者的住院期间出现，并且若未及时识别和干预可能加重。然而，现有大多数精神健康研究关注已确诊精神疾病的患者，而非主要因躯体疾病住院的患者。在本工作中，我们研究慢性病患者的潜在精神健康风险能否从纵向临床叙事中推断。我们利用从出院小结中提取的精神健康证据，基于MIMIC-III构建了一个约4,000名患者的弱监督队列。一个分层状态空间框架从逐日临床叙事中导出精神健康表征，并对其时间演变进行建模，以用于整个住院期间的风险估计。初步结果表明，使用所提出的表征改善了二分类风险预测，并显示有风险与无风险队列之间模型导出的风险轨迹存在差异，为研究慢性病患者中新出现的精神健康风险提供了基础。

title: TCM-DiagCommit: A TCM-SD-Derived Benchmark for Evidence-Conditioned Syndrome Selection and Commitment
zh_title: TCM-DiagCommit：证据条件下的证候选择基准
summary: 预印本发布源自TCM-SD的中医证候基准，将1,834例转为23,842条任务，含候选阶梯与分阶段证据，评估承诺、追问、延后与弃答。
key_points: 1,834例源病例转为23,842条任务行
覆盖148个证候与三类候选阶梯
定义承诺、获取、延后、弃答动作评分
reason: 公开可用的新型中医诊断基准，规模中等但缺模型评测结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) syndrome differentiation is usually evaluated as static final-label selection over complete clinical records. This setting hides three diagnostic behaviors: whether a model distinguishes semantic-neighbor syndrome labels from easy random distractors, whether it updates predictions as evidence fields are revealed, and whether it should commit under uncertainty. We introduce TCM-DiagCommit, a benchmark derived from the public TCM-SD/ZY-BERT resource while retaining its source syndrome labels; it converts 1,834 source cases into 23,842 task rows over 148 syndrome labels. The benchmark combines random, profile-neighbor, and full-vocabulary candidate ladders with staged t1/t2/t3 evidence. It also includes fixed-label tongue/pulse perturbations and insufficient-evidence variants. A benchmark-defined action contract scores commit, acquire, defer, and abstain. Across five zero-shot DirectLLM calibrations, random10 top-1 accuracy is 63.2% to 66.4%, but hard20 falls to 24.7% to 30.3% and full148 to 14.8% to 22.3%; on hard20, WT(all) wrong-terminal commits remain 62.2% to 74.3%. These results show that final-answer accuracy alone is insufficient for diagnostic benchmark evaluation: answer selection, evidence use, and benchmark commitment scoring should be measured separately.
zh_abstract: 中医（Traditional Chinese Medicine, TCM）辨证通常被评估为在完整临床记录上的静态最终标签选择。这种设置掩盖了三种诊断行为：模型是否将语义近邻证候标签与简单随机干扰项区分开，模型是否随着证据字段被揭示而更新预测，以及模型是否应在不确定性下作出承诺。我们引入 TCM-DiagCommit，这是一个源自公开 TCM-SD/ZY-BERT 资源并保留其来源证候标签的基准；它将 1,834 个源病例转换为覆盖 148 个证候标签的 23,842 个任务行。该基准将随机、画像近邻和全词表候选阶梯与分阶段 t1/t2/t3 证据相结合。它还包括固定标签舌象/脉象扰动和证据不足变体。基准定义的动作契约对承诺（commit）、获取（acquire）、推迟（defer）和弃权（abstain）进行评分。在五次零样本 DirectLLM 校准中，random10 top-1 准确率为 63.2% 至 66.4%，但 hard20 降至 24.7% 至 30.3%，full148 降至 14.8% 至 22.3%；在 hard20 上，WT(all) 错误终端承诺仍为 62.2% 至 74.3%。这些结果表明，仅凭最终答案准确率不足以进行诊断基准评估：答案选择、证据使用和基准承诺评分应分别衡量。

title: Dense Representation Learning and Differentiable Shape Modeling for Spine Landmark Detection
zh_title: 稠密表示学习与可微形状建模用于脊柱关键点检测
summary: 预印本将脊柱X线关键点检测重构为像素级对比表示学习，并结合可学习形状先验消除关键点定位歧义。
key_points: 把关键点检测转为像素级对比表示学习
匹配稠密像素嵌入与关键点原型生成热图
叠加全局形状先验消除定位歧义
reason: 方法有新意且面向术前规划，但为预印本、缺外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Spine landmark detection from spinal X-ray is a key step for estimating spine deformation severity, for building biomechanical models, and for pre-operative planning. We reframe anatomical landmark detection as a pixel-level contrastive representation learning problem, matching dense pixel embeddings with landmark prototypes. Surprisingly, even with a generic U-Net backbone, this formulation results in more discriminative heatmaps compared to the traditional heatmap regression paradigm, leading to improved discrimination between vertebral corners on distinct vertebra. Furthermore, we combine the resulting heatmaps with learnable shape priors over the global configuration of spinal landmarks to resolve ambiguities in landmark locations, yielding a simple and practical approach to spinal landmark detection. Our approach is competitive, in terms of landmark accuracy and clinical parameter estimation, with the state-of-the-art on the public AASCE dataset and on two private spinal X-ray datasets. Our code and pre-trained weights are available at https://github.com/BioMedTP/Pix2Point.
zh_abstract: 从脊柱 X 射线中检测脊柱标志点是估计脊柱变形严重程度、构建生物力学模型以及进行术前规划的关键步骤。我们将解剖标志点检测重新表述为像素级对比表示学习问题，将稠密像素嵌入与标志点原型进行匹配。令人惊讶的是，即使使用通用的 U-Net 主干网络，与传统的热图回归范式相比，这种表述也能产生更具判别性的热图，从而改善对不同椎骨上椎骨角点的区分。此外，我们将所得热图与关于脊柱标志点全局配置的可学习形状先验相结合，以解决标志点位置中的歧义，形成一种简单且实用的脊柱标志点检测方法。在标志点准确性和临床参数估计方面，我们的方法在公开 AASCE 数据集和两个私有脊柱 X 射线数据集上与最先进方法具有竞争力。我们的代码和预训练权重可在 https://github.com/BioMedTP/Pix2Point 获取。

title: MM-Net: A Multimodal Multi-Task Network for Sleep Staging and Sleep Apnea Assessment After Ischemic Stroke
zh_title: MM-Net：缺血性卒中后睡眠分期与呼吸暂停评估
summary: 预印本提出多模态多任务框架，融合睡眠脑电眼电与心肺特征，同步进行卒中后睡眠分期与呼吸事件检测。
key_points: 多模态多任务同步做睡眠分期与呼吸事件检测
用交叉拟合与岭回归嵌入对齐缓解表示不一致
融合EEG-EOG表征与学习到的心肺特征
reason: 面向卒中后多导睡眠分析的新方法预印本，证据限于摘要、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Automated polysomnography after ischemic stroke is challenging because of altered sleep-related neural activity and concurrent respiratory disturbances. Existing stroke-specific approaches mainly address sleep-stage classification, leaving joint analysis of sleep architecture and respiratory events underexplored. Moreover, adapting pretrained EEG encoders introduces a representation inconsistency when downstream models are trained on embeddings from previously seen patients but evaluated on unseen individuals. We propose MM-Net, a multimodal multi-task framework that resolves this inconsistency through cross-fitting and ridge-based embedding alignment. Sleep-adapted EEG-EOG representations and engineered neural descriptors are fused with learned cardiorespiratory features through cross-attention and shared temporal modeling for simultaneous sleep staging and respiratory-event detection. On iSLEEPS (99 patients with subacute ischemic stroke), ten-fold patient-independent evaluation achieved 76.3% staging accuracy (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.656) and 0.825 respiratory-event AUC, outperforming the evaluated baselines under matched protocols. The sleep-adapted encoder improved the downstream model when its embeddings were aligned, raising staging accuracy by 1.4 percentage points over the frozen encoder ($p$ = 0.020) versus 0.2 points without alignment. MM-Net also achieved 86.4% staging accuracy on Sleep-EDF, above every single-EEG architecture reimplemented on the same recordings, and 80.3% staging accuracy with 0.889 respiratory AUC on ISRUC-I, exceeding its retrained staging baselines. Without retraining, the iSLEEPS-trained model retained respiratory AUCs of 0.833 on ISRUC-I and 0.841 on UCD. These findings support representation-consistent neural adaptation and joint physiological modeling across stroke, healthy-sleep, and sleep-disorder cohorts.
zh_abstract: 缺血性卒中后的自动多导睡眠图分析具有挑战性，原因是睡眠相关神经活动发生改变并伴有呼吸紊乱。现有的卒中特异性方法主要解决睡眠分期分类问题，而对睡眠结构和呼吸事件的联合分析仍探索不足。此外，调整预训练脑电（EEG）编码器会引入表征不一致性：当下游模型在既往已见患者的嵌入上训练、却在未见个体上评估时，这种不一致性就会出现。我们提出 MM-Net，一种多模态多任务框架，通过交叉拟合和基于岭回归的嵌入对齐来解决这一不一致性。睡眠适配的 EEG-EOG 表征与工程化神经描述符，通过交叉注意力和共享时序建模与学习到的心肺特征融合，用于同时进行睡眠分期和呼吸事件检测。在 iSLEEPS（99 例亚急性缺血性卒中患者）上，十折患者独立评估达到 76.3% 的分期准确率（Cohen's κ = 0.656）和 0.825 的呼吸事件 AUC，在匹配方案下优于所评估的基线。当睡眠适配编码器的嵌入经过对齐时，它提升了下游模型，较冻结编码器将分期准确率提高 1.4 个百分点（p = 0.020），而未对齐时仅提高 0.2 个百分点。MM-Net 在 Sleep-EDF 上也达到 86.4% 的分期准确率，高于在同一记录上重新实现的每一种单 EEG 架构；在 ISRUC-I 上达到 80.3% 的分期准确率和 0.889 的呼吸 AUC，超过其重新训练的分期基线。未经重新训练，iSLEEPS 训练的模型在 ISRUC-I 和 UCD 上分别保持 0.833 和 0.841 的呼吸 AUC。这些发现支持在卒中、健康睡眠和睡眠障碍队列中实现表征一致的神经适应和联合生理建模。

title: MedConstBench: Benchmarking How Constitutions Steer LLMs in Medical Ethics
zh_title: MedConstBench：伦理宪法如何影响医疗大模型
summary: 预印本发布医疗伦理基准，将部署宪法作为受控变量，围绕比彻姆四原则由人机校准的多模型互评打分。
key_points: 把部署宪法作为受控变量系统考察
围绕比彻姆四原则组织评测
含自建临床困境数据集MedDilemma
reason: 医疗伦理评测新基准且设计有新意，但为预印本、结果未详，属值得一看档
abstract: As large language models advance rapidly, they are increasingly used to answer medical questions, and many such models are now deployed locally. Once a model is deployed, its behavior is governed mainly by the ethical policy written into its constitution. However, most existing work focuses on factual correctness rather than the trade-off between competing ethical values. Even benchmarks that do evaluate ethics treat it as a fixed property of the model rather than as a variable, so how a constitution reshapes medical-ethics behavior remains largely unexplored. We introduce MedConstBench, a medical-ethics benchmark that treats the deployment constitution as a controlled variable, is organized around Beauchamp's four principles, and is scored by human-calibrated multi-model peer review. It includes MedDilemma, our own dataset of clinical dilemmas, and supports a systematic analysis of how constitutions steer LLMs. Evaluating ten open-source LLMs under four constitutions, we find that the effect of a constitution is dimension-selective and model-dependent, and that no constitution is universally optimal. Motivated by these findings, we propose a do-no-harm adaptive selector that chooses a constitution per model, matching the per-model oracle while guaranteeing a worst-case floor and generalizing to unseen models at low cost.
zh_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）快速发展，它们越来越多地被用于回答医学问题，许多此类模型现在已在本地部署。模型一旦部署，其行为主要由写入其行为准则（constitution）的伦理政策所支配。然而，大多数现有工作关注事实正确性，而非相互竞争的伦理价值之间的权衡。即便确实评估伦理的基准也将伦理视为模型的固定属性而非变量，因此行为准则如何重塑医学伦理行为在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们提出 MedConstBench，这是一个医学伦理基准，将部署行为准则作为受控变量，围绕 Beauchamp 的四项原则组织，并由经人工校准的多模型同行评审评分。它包括我们自建的临床困境数据集 MedDilemma，并支持系统分析行为准则如何引导 LLMs。在四种行为准则下评估十个开源 LLM，我们发现行为准则的影响具有维度选择性和模型依赖性，且没有一种行为准则是普遍最优的。受这些发现启发，我们提出一种不伤害自适应选择器，为每个模型选择行为准则，达到逐模型 oracle 的水平，同时保证最坏情况下限，并以低成本泛化到未见模型。

title: Identity or Evidence? Auditing Evidence Dependence in Agentic Life-Science Benchmarks
zh_title: 身份还是证据？审视生命科学智能体基准的证据依赖性
summary: 通过在临床结局基准与Biomni、LAB-Bench任务上分别变动实体名称与证据，作者发现提示中缺乏决定性证据时，模型答案高度依赖名称而非证据。
key_points: 提示含决定性序列或段落时，遮蔽名称影响很小
提示仅为名称加候选列表时，命名0.742、遮蔽0.082（随机0.093）
96道LAB-Bench LitQA2题在固定删段方案下差距增大
reason: 对智能体基准效度提出方法学质疑并给出量化证据，属有新意预印本，但规模有限、无外部验证
abstract: Agentic life-science benchmarks give an agent evidence about a named entity and score an answer against a recorded outcome. That score tests reasoning over evidence only if the evidence, rather than the name, determines the answer. We examine this distinction by varying identity and evidence independently on a clinical-outcome benchmark and published tasks from Biomni and LAB-Bench. Blinding identity matters little when a prompt contains a decisive sequence or passage. It matters a great deal when the prompt is mostly a name and candidate list (0.742 named versus 0.082 blinded; chance 0.093). Across 96 LAB-Bench LitQA2 questions, the gap increases under one fixed passage-redaction scheme (+0.000 to +0.135; per-instance slope +0.147, p= 0.004). On the clinical benchmark, a no-evidence recall probe matches prediction accuracy and recovers a database-specific programme count. So, we argue that benchmarks intended to measure evidence-dependent reasoning should report identity-blinded results, retrieval telemetry, and positive controls.
zh_abstract: 智能体式生命科学基准向智能体提供关于某个命名实体的证据，并依据记录的结局对答案评分。只有当证据而非名称决定答案时，该评分才检验基于证据的推理。我们通过在临床结局基准以及来自 Biomni 和 LAB-Bench 的已发表任务上独立变化身份和证据，来考察这一区别。当提示包含决定性序列或段落时，盲化身份影响很小。当提示主要是名称和候选列表时，影响很大（命名 0.742 对盲化 0.082；随机水平 0.093）。在 96 个 LAB-Bench LitQA2 问题中，在一种固定段落脱敏方案下差距增大（+0.000 至 +0.135；逐实例斜率 +0.147，p = 0.004）。在临床基准上，无证据回忆探针达到与预测准确率相当的水平，并恢复出数据库特定的项目计数。因此，我们认为旨在测量证据依赖推理的基准应报告身份盲化结果、检索遥测和阳性对照。

title: Can JEV Support Clinical Trial Criteria Assessment?
zh_title: JEV能否支持临床试验入排标准评估？
summary: 在2,048个患者-条件对上回顾性比较非生成式决策模型JEV与模式约束的Qwen Flash评估试验入排条件的表现。
key_points: 数据来自TrialGPT及MIMIC-III/IV衍生问答数据集
批处理模式下JEV与Qwen在TrialGPT、MIMIC-IV上macro-F1相近
MIMIC-III上JEV为0.768，Qwen为0.534
全过程在零数据留存策略下评测
reason: 回顾性、仅用公开数据内部评测，无独立医院外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical trial prescreening requires distinguishing unmet conditions from insufficient evidence in patient records. Given patient records, criterion questions, and predefined answer options, we retrospectively compared JEV, a non-generative decision model returning native option probabilities, with schema-constrained Qwen Flash across 2,048 test patient-condition pairs from TrialGPT and question-answer datasets derived from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, all evaluated under strict Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policies to ensure clinical data privacy. Both models assessed conditions individually or in batches sharing the same patient context, with performance measured against reference labels. In batch mode, JEV and Qwen achieved similar macro-F1 scores on TrialGPT (0.652 vs. 0.660) and MIMIC-IV (0.807 vs. 0.814), whereas JEV substantially outperformed Qwen on MIMIC-III (0.768 vs. 0.534; $Δ$ = +0.234, 95% CI: 0.187-0.281). This advantage largely reflected higher recall for conditions labeled as having insufficient information (56.3% vs. 9.9%). Across all three datasets, JEV also had lower observed median job latency (1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90 s) and 53%-74% lower estimated cost per condition. These findings position JEV as an initial assessment component that provides criterion-level judgments and flags potential information gaps for review. JEV's observed errors in interpreting clinical evidence underscore the need to verify its outputs against patient records before they inform eligibility decisions.
zh_abstract: 临床试验预筛需要区分患者记录中未满足的条件与证据不足。给定患者记录、标准问题和预定义答案选项，我们回顾性比较了 JEV（一种返回原生选项概率的非生成式决策模型）与受 schema 约束的 Qwen Flash，在来自 TrialGPT 的 2,048 个测试患者-条件对以及源自 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 的问答数据集上进行；所有评估均在严格的零数据保留（Zero Data Retention, ZDR）政策下进行，以确保临床数据隐私。两种模型均以单独或共享同一患者上下文的批量方式评估条件，性能以参考标签衡量。在批量模式下，JEV 和 Qwen 在 TrialGPT（0.652 vs. 0.660）和 MIMIC-IV（0.807 vs. 0.814）上取得相似的宏 F1 分数，而 JEV 在 MIMIC-III 上显著优于 Qwen（0.768 vs. 0.534；Δ = +0.234，95% CI：0.187-0.281）。这一优势很大程度上反映在对被标记为信息不足的条件的更高召回率（56.3% vs. 9.9%）。在所有三个数据集中，JEV 观察到的中位作业延迟也更低（1.18-1.40 对 2.80-8.90 秒），并且每个条件的估计成本低 53%-74%。这些发现将 JEV 定位为初始评估组件，可提供标准层面的判断并标记潜在信息缺口以供审查。JEV 在解释临床证据方面观察到的错误凸显了在其输出用于影响合格性决定之前，需对照患者记录验证其输出。

title: From image biomarkers to treatment decisions: multimodal AI and clinical translation in gynecologic oncology.
zh_title: 妇科肿瘤多模态 AI：从影像标志物到治疗决策
summary: 综述梳理妇科肿瘤 AI 从影像标志物走向融合影像、病理、分子与临床信息的多模态决策支持。
key_points: 多数应用仍停留于图像解读与回顾性预测
多模态有望优于单一数据源模型
临床转化仍受数据与验证限制
reason: 同行评审综述，框架清晰但无原始数据，按综述档取中位
abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly expanding across gynecologic oncology, but most applications remain focused on image interpretation and retrospective prediction rather than direct support of treatment decisions. This review examines how AI is progressing from imaging biomarkers toward multimodal decision-support systems that integrate radiologic, pathologic, molecular, and clinical information. We summarize current applications in ovarian, endometrial, and cervical cancers, with particular attention to preoperative risk stratification, surgical planning, radiotherapy, systemic treatment selection, treatment-response prediction, and multidisciplinary decision-making. Multimodal approaches are especially promising because they reflect the way clinical decisions are made and may provide greater value than models based on a single data source. However, the current evidence remains dominated by retrospective and often single-center studies, with limited external and prospective validation. Data heterogeneity, domain shift, incomplete multimodal datasets, bias, workflow integration, regulatory requirements, and model monitoring remain important barriers to routine implementation. We therefore outline a stepwise pathway for clinical translation, from robust multicenter validation and prospective human-AI evaluation to clinical-impact studies and post-deployment monitoring. The next phase of AI in gynecologic oncology should prioritize clinically meaningful decisions and measurable patient or workflow benefit rather than incremental gains in predictive performance alone.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Oncology] 人工智能（AI）在妇科肿瘤学中迅速扩展，但大多数应用仍集中于图像解读和回顾性预测，而非直接支持治疗决策。本综述探讨AI如何从影像生物标志物向整合影像学、病理学、分子和临床信息的多模态决策支持系统推进。我们总结了其在卵巢癌、子宫内膜癌和宫颈癌中的当前应用，特别关注术前风险分层、手术规划、放疗、全身治疗选择、治疗反应预测和多学科决策。多模态方法尤其有前景，因为它们反映了临床决策的制定方式，并可能比基于单一数据源的模型提供更大价值。然而，当前证据仍以回顾性研究为主，且常为单中心研究，外部验证和前前瞻性验证有限。数据异质性、域偏移、不完整的多模态数据集、偏倚、工作流程整合、监管要求和模型监测仍是常规实施的重要障碍。因此，我们概述了一条临床转化的分步路径，从稳健的多中心验证和前瞻性人-AI评估，到临床影响研究和部署后监测。妇科肿瘤学中AI的下一阶段应优先关注具有临床意义的决策以及可测量的患者或工作流程获益，而非仅追求预测性能的增量提升。

title: From task-specific AI to multimodal foundation models in PET/CT: a readiness framework for clinical translation.
zh_title: PET/CT 多模态基础模型临床转化就绪框架
summary: 叙述性综述梳理 PET/CT 从任务专用模型到多模态基础模型与智能体工作流的转化就绪度。
key_points: 区分任务专用、预训练表征、视觉语言与智能体系统
涵盖重建、衰减校正、分割与预后建模
强调保留定量分子信息与报告文本整合
属叙述性综述，非系统综述或元分析
reason: 同行评审叙述性综述，框架有信息量但无新数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Frontiers in nuclear medicine] Artificial intelligence in PET/CT is evolving from narrowly optimized systems toward reusable pretrained representations and multimodal models. PET/CT is a demanding test case because clinically meaningful interpretation must preserve quantitative molecular information while integrating anatomic CT, acquisition metadata, longitudinal examinations, and free-text imaging reports. This focused narrative review synthesizes literature reported from January 2021 through July 2026, spanning PET reconstruction and enhancement, attenuation correction, segmentation, outcome modeling, pretrained representations, vision-language systems, and agentic workflows. We distinguish task-specific models, reusable pretrained representations, promptable models, vision-language systems, generalist foundation-model candidates, and agentic systems according to demonstrated capabilities, while separately considering evaluation benchmarks. Task-specific deep learning has demonstrated promising technical performance in low-count imaging and whole-body tumor analysis, but most evidence remains retrospective and restricted by radiotracer, disease, scanner, institution, or endpoint. Emerging PET-native studies demonstrate label-efficient segmentation, image-text grounding, report generation, and modular tool orchestration; however, they do not yet establish broad cross-tracer generalization or prospective clinical benefit. We therefore propose MOSAIC-PET, an author-developed heuristic six-domain evaluation framework for PET/CT foundation models encompassing Molecular fidelity, Organ and anatomic grounding, Semantic faithfulness, Adaptability, Integration and clinical impact, and Continuous governance. MOSAIC-PET has not undergone Delphi consensus or formal validation and is intended to organize PET-specific evidence requirements rather than function as a validated clinical-readiness tool. The near-term translational priority is the development of modular, auditable systems in which validated quantitative tools and evidence-linked language outputs remain under specialist oversight, with progression from external testing to silent evaluation, assisted-use studies, clinical-impact assessment, and continuous lifecycle monitoring.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in nuclear medicine] PET/CT 中的人工智能正从狭窄优化的系统，演变为可复用的预训练表征和多模态模型。PET/CT 是一个要求很高的测试案例，因为具有临床意义的解读必须在整合解剖 CT、采集元数据、纵向检查和自由文本影像报告的同时，保留定量分子信息。本聚焦式叙述性综述综合了 2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 7 月报道的文献，涵盖 PET 重建与增强、衰减校正、分割、结局建模、预训练表征、视觉-语言系统和智能体工作流。我们根据已展示的能力区分任务特定模型、可复用预训练表征、可提示模型、视觉-语言系统、通用基础模型候选和智能体系统，同时单独考虑评估基准。任务特定深度学习在低计数成像和全身肿瘤分析中已展示出有前景的技术性能，但大多数证据仍为回顾性，并受放射性示踪剂、疾病、扫描仪、机构或终点限制。新兴的 PET 原生研究展示了标签高效分割、图像-文本 grounding、报告生成和模块化工具编排；然而，它们尚未确立广泛的跨示踪剂泛化或前瞻性临床获益。因此，我们提出 MOSAIC-PET，这是一个由作者提出的启发式六域评估框架，用于 PET/CT 基础模型，涵盖分子保真度（Molecular fidelity）、器官与解剖 grounding（Organ and anatomic grounding）、语义忠实性（Semantic faithfulness）、适应性（Adaptability）、整合与临床影响（Integration and clinical impact）以及持续治理（Continuous governance）。MOSAIC-PET 尚未经过德尔菲共识或正式验证，旨在组织 PET 特定的证据要求，而不是作为经过验证的临床就绪工具。近期的转化优先事项是开发模块化、可审计的系统，其中经过验证的定量工具和与证据关联的语言输出仍处于专科医生监督之下，并从外部测试推进到静默评估、辅助使用研究、临床影响评估和持续生命周期监测。

title: Predicting pandemics, predicting people: the ethical limits of AI-powered public health surveillance.
zh_title: AI公共卫生监测的伦理边界
summary: 同行评审小型综述讨论AI公共卫生监测从群体疫情预测转向个体层面推断时的隐私、自主与公平等伦理限度。
key_points: 关注从群体预测向个体行为推断与画像的转变
数据整合、算法偏倚与不等预测误差削弱公平性
模型不透明、问责缺失与任务漂移损害公众信任
reason: 同行评审综述，伦理议题有信息量但无新数据，综述上限档
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming public health surveillance by enabling the integration of epidemiological, clinical, environmental, mobility, genomic, and digital data to detect emerging threats and anticipate disease transmission. However, the expansion from detecting outbreaks to predicting individual or group-level behaviors raises important ethical concerns related to privacy, autonomy, discrimination, transparency, accountability, and public trust. This mini-review examines the ethical limits of AI-powered public health surveillance, with particular attention to the transition from population-level epidemic prediction toward individual-level inference and profiling. It highlights how extensive data integration, algorithmic bias, unequal predictive errors, opaque models, and mission creep can undermine both equity and the legitimacy of surveillance systems. The review argues that predictive capability alone cannot establish ethical legitimacy. Instead, AI surveillance should be governed by necessity, proportionality, purpose limitation, data minimization, equity, transparency, meaningful human oversight, and mechanisms for accountability and redress. A lifecycle governance approach is further required to ensure continuous assessment of data quality, subgroup performance, model drift, unintended harms, and changing public-health needs. Ultimately, the ethical boundary of AI surveillance should be defined not by what can technically be predicted, but by what can be predicted and acted upon without compromising fundamental rights, equity, and public trust.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 人工智能（AI）正在改变公共卫生监测，使流行病学、临床、环境、移动性、基因组和数字数据的整合成为可能，以检测新发威胁并预测疾病传播。然而，从检测暴发扩展到预测个体或群体层面行为，引发了与隐私、自主性、歧视、透明度、问责制和公众信任相关的重要伦理关切。本小型综述考察 AI 驱动的公共卫生监测的伦理界限，特别关注从人群层面流行病预测向个体层面推断和画像的转变。它强调广泛的数据整合、算法偏倚、不平等的预测错误、不透明的模型和使命蔓延如何削弱公平性和监测系统的合法性。该综述认为，仅有预测能力不能确立伦理合法性。相反，AI 监测应受必要性、相称性、目的限制、数据最小化、公平性、透明度、有意义的人类监督以及问责和补救机制约束。还需要生命周期治理方法，以确保持续评估数据质量、亚组性能、模型漂移、意外伤害和不断变化的公共卫生需求。最终，AI 监测的伦理边界不应由技术上可以预测什么来界定，而应由在不损害基本权利、公平性和公众信任的前提下可以预测并采取行动的内容来界定。

title: Machine learning classification of fibromyalgia from blood transcriptomes: confounder benchmarking and implications for endometriosis-associated pain
zh_title: 血液转录组机器学习识别纤维肌痛及混杂因素基准
summary: bioRxiv预印本以无泄漏嵌套交叉验证重分析96例纤维肌痛与93例对照的PBMC转录组，AUC约0.82，但性别等简单基线接近同等性能。
key_points: 逻辑回归AUC 0.821、XGBoost 0.825，通过置换检验
仅性别即可达AUC 0.727，细胞组成代理达0.71–0.76
仅女性亚组AUC 0.783，剔除性染色体基因后性能不降
reason: 混杂因素基准方法有新意，但样本小、预印本，属值得一看档。
abstract: Fibromyalgia (FM) lacks an objective biomarker, and blood transcriptomic signatures have been proposed to fill this gap. Here, the largest public peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) RNA-seq cohort of FM reporting expression subtypes (96 patients, 93 controls) was reanalysed using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection and scaling confined strictly to training folds. Gene expression discriminated patients from controls (ROC-AUC 0.821 for logistic regression and 0.825 for XGBoost), clearing a 100-repetition permutation-label null (p= 0.0099). Two simple, disease-agnostic baselines, however, reach nearly the same performance: sex alone reaches AUC 0.727, and a four-score PBMC cell-composition proxy reaches AUC 0.71-0.76. Restricting to females alone gives AUC 0.783 (0.705-0.858), and excluding X/Y-linked genes does not reduce performance, so the signal is not purely a sex-composition artifact; but the female-only expression model does not significantly exceed the composition-only proxy in the same females (0.783 vs. 0.712, paired 95% CI -0.025 to 0.175), so a composition contribution cannot be excluded. Preranked gene set enrichment analysis finds curated CLEAR/lysosomal and interferon/JAK-STAT gene sets, proxies for two subtype signatures of the original study, enriched among genes expressed lower in FM, also in females alone, but this enrichment disappears after adjusting for the composition proxies. Gynecological comorbidity, hormonal status, and medication are absent from the public metadata and remain plausible, untested contributors to the female-only estimate. These findings are hypothesis-generating, not a basis for clinical diagnosis: a single-cohort, correlational result consistent with, but not sufficient to establish, an FM-specific signal distinct from demographic, hormonal, and cell-composition confounds, pending independent replication. Future blood-based biomarker studies for FM, and for related nociplastic pain conditions such as endometriosis, should report performance relative to sex- and composition-based baselines as standard practice.
zh_abstract: 纤维肌痛（FM）缺乏客观生物标志物，血液转录组特征曾被提出用于填补这一空白。本研究使用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证，重新分析了目前最大的、报告表达亚型的FM公共外周血单个核细胞（PBMC）RNA-seq队列（96例患者、93例对照），特征选择和缩放严格限制在训练折内。基因表达可将患者与对照区分开（逻辑回归的ROC-AUC为0.821，XGBoost为0.825），超过了100次重复的置换标签零分布（p= 0.0099）。然而，两个简单的、与疾病无关的基线模型达到几乎相同的性能：仅性别一项的AUC达到0.727，一个四评分PBMC细胞组成代理指标的AUC达到0.71-0.76。仅限女性的分析得到AUC 0.783（0.705-0.858），并且排除X/Y连锁基因并未降低性能，因此该信号并非纯粹的性别组成伪影；但仅女性表达模型在同一女性人群中并未显著超过仅组成代理指标（0.783 vs. 0.712，配对95% CI -0.025至0.175），因此不能排除细胞组成的贡献。预排序基因集富集分析发现，精选的CLEAR/溶酶体和干扰素/JAK-STAT基因集——原研究两种亚型特征的代理指标——在FM中表达较低的基因中富集，在仅女性分析中也是如此，但在校正组成代理指标后该富集消失。妇科合并症、激素状态和用药在公共元数据中缺失，仍是仅女性估计值可能但未经检验的混杂因素。这些发现具有假设生成性质，并非临床诊断依据：这是单队列相关性结果，与FM特异性信号一致，但不足以确立该信号独立于人口学、激素和细胞组成混杂因素，尚待独立重复。未来针对FM以及子宫内膜异位症等相关伤害可塑性疼痛状况的血液生物标志物研究，应作为标准实践报告相对于性别和组成基线的性能。

title: Evaluating Bayesian deep learning for robust biomedical time-series classification under distribution shift: A sleep scoring case study
zh_title: 贝叶斯深度学习应对生物医学时序分布偏移
summary: 以鼠睡眠评分为例，系统评估贝叶斯深度学习的分布偏移鲁棒性。
key_points: 比较9种近似推断方法与两种神经网络骨干
多盆地方法在分布外数据上表现最佳
贝叶斯模型平均改善分布外准确率与校准
reason: 预印本系统比较贝叶斯方法，动物数据非临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: In biomedical time-series classification, machine learning models often suffer from deteriorating accuracy and calibration due to distribution shift. We investigate to what degree Bayesian-inspired deep learning improves robustness through Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Using rodent sleep scoring as a case study, we evaluate BMA under distribution shifts in genotype, laboratory, and species. We systematically compare nine approximate inference methods spanning single- and multi-basin approaches across two neural network backbones on in-distribution (ID) data and five out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. In our results, multi-basin methods perform best, outperforming baselines and single-basin methods. Compared with point estimates, BMA generally improves OOD accuracy and calibration across both architectures, while yielding only modest ID gains. It also often improves selective prediction and OOD and artifact detection, but, interestingly, not inter-rater disagreement detection.
zh_abstract: 在生物医学时间序列分类中，机器学习模型常因分布偏移而出现准确性和校准恶化。我们研究贝叶斯启发的深度学习通过贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）在多大程度上提高稳健性。以啮齿动物睡眠评分为案例研究，我们评估BMA在基因型、实验室和物种分布偏移下的表现。我们在分布内（ID）数据和五个分布外（OOD）数据集上，系统比较了跨越单盆地（single-basin）和多盆地（multi-basin）方法的九种近似推断方法在两种神经网络主干上的表现。在我们的结果中，多盆地方法表现最佳，优于基线和单盆地方法。与点估计相比，BMA通常在两种架构上改善OOD准确性和校准，而在ID上仅带来适度提升。它还通常改善选择性预测以及OOD和伪影检测，但有趣的是，并不改善评分者间分歧检测。

title: OneEEG: A Unified Signal-Visual Multimodal Language Model with Task-Aware Mixture of Projectors for Multi-Task EEG Understanding
zh_title: OneEEG：信号-视觉多模态EEG大模型与基准
summary: 提出统一EEG多任务理解的多模态大模型，联合建模数值与视觉表征并发布指令数据集与基准。
key_points: 构建OneEEG-Instruct多任务EEG指令微调数据集
任务感知多投影器对齐异构EEG特征
提出OneEEG-Bench评测多任务EEG理解
reason: 新模型加公开数据集与基准，但为预印本、外部验证有限
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive-state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a promising interface for flexible multimodal reasoning, but their ability to understand EEG inputs remains limited. In this work, we propose OneEEG, a unified EEG-MLLM framework for multi-task EEG understanding. By training on our curated OneEEG-Instruct, a multi-task EEG instruction-tuning dataset, OneEEG jointly models numerical EEG representations and visual EEG representations, and introduces a task-aware Mixture of Projectors (MoP) to align heterogeneous EEG features across different task families with the LLM embedding space. We further establish OneEEG-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating current MLLMs and our method on multi-task EEG understanding. Experiments show that existing MLLMs have limited ability to interpret EEG inputs, while OneEEG achieves stronger performance by integrating numerical and visual EEG representations with task-aware EEG-to-LLM projection. Extensive ablations and analyses further reveal the effects of visual EEG renderings, MoP variants, router behavior, and feature dispersion across EEG tasks.
zh_abstract: 脑电图（Electroencephalography, EEG）广泛用于临床评估、脑机接口和认知状态分析，然而EEG建模在不同任务范式之间仍呈碎片化。近期的多模态大语言模型（multimodal large language models, MLLMs）为灵活的多模态推理提供了有前景的接口，但其理解EEG输入的能力仍然有限。在本工作中，我们提出OneEEG，一个用于多任务EEG理解的统一EEG-MLLM框架。通过在我们整理的多任务EEG指令微调数据集OneEEG-Instruct上训练，OneEEG联合建模数值EEG表征和视觉EEG表征，并引入任务感知投影器混合（task-aware Mixture of Projectors, MoP），以将不同任务族中的异质EEG特征与LLM嵌入空间对齐。我们进一步建立OneEEG-Bench，一个用于评估当前MLLMs和我们方法在多任务EEG理解上的基准。实验表明，现有MLLMs解释EEG输入的能力有限，而OneEEG通过整合数值和视觉EEG表征以及任务感知的EEG到LLM投影，取得了更强的性能。广泛的消融和分析进一步揭示了视觉EEG渲染图、MoP变体、路由器行为以及跨EEG任务的特征离散度的影响。

title: Targeted Deep Regression - Initial Applications in Whole-Body Water-Fat MRI in UK Biobank
zh_title: 靶向深度回归：UK Biobank全身水脂MRI应用
summary: 在UK Biobank颈至膝水脂MRI上用ResNet50风格网络做靶向子区域图像回归，估计数值属性。
key_points: 将手工定义子区域传播至逾3万例扫描
以2D多通道拼图表示解剖子区域
面向大规模影像衍生表型自动化提取
reason: 样本量超3万例且流程可扩展，但为预印本方法学研究，未见外部验证
abstract: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact while retaining high-resolution, for example by providing multiple slices of kidney tissue for a kidney volume regression network. This approach also enables group-wise saliency analysis that highlight image and anatomical regions used by the network for the pre- dictions. The method was applied for the regression endpoints of kidney volume, heart volume, and age. Predictive performance was found between R2 = 0.731-0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions. We con- clude that the method can be used to standardize and restrict the information presented to a deep regression analysis pipeline, increasing information density and opening up a wide range of future medical inference studies.
zh_abstract: UK Biobank是一项英国临床研究，除已收集的大量医学数据外，还计划纳入来自100,000名参与者的详细磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging, MRI）检查。图像数据可例如通过神经网络进行图像分割或分类的自动化分析，以扩展用于医学研究的影像衍生表型集合。在本工作中，我们提出、呈现并评估一种方法学，其使用基于图像的回归，从所收集的颈至膝水脂MRI扫描中估计数值属性。它将一个ResNet50风格网络应用于二维多通道拼图，这些拼图表示MRI扫描中目标性和研究特异性的解剖子区域。目标性子区域采样通过使用图像配准将手动定义的子区域从参考扫描传播到其他>30,000例被分析扫描来实现。所得拼图可以紧凑同时保持高分辨率，例如为肾脏体积回归网络提供多个肾脏组织切片。该方法还使组级显著性分析成为可能，突出网络用于预测的图像和解剖区域。该方法应用于肾脏体积、心脏体积和年龄这些回归终点。预测性能发现介于R2 = 0.731-0.984之间，并且发现组级显著性图突出医学相关区域。我们得出结论，该方法可用于标准化并限制呈现给深度回归分析流程的信息，提高信息密度，并开辟广泛的未来医学推断研究。

title: Low-rank MERA Decomposition of 3D OCT Image Volume for Compression, Denoising, Feature Extraction and Diagnosis of Retinal Diseases
zh_title: 低秩 MERA 分解用于三维 OCT 压缩去噪与视网膜诊断
summary: 预印本提出用低秩 MERA 张量网络近似三维 OCT 体数据，联合实现压缩、去噪与特征提取并用于视网膜疾病诊断。
key_points: 以低秩多尺度张量网络表示三维 OCT 体数据
全局核心因子与低秩因子建模 B-scan 相关性
同一表示兼顾压缩、去噪、特征提取与诊断
reason: 预印本新方法有原理创新，但缺外部验证与临床对照，属值得一看档
abstract: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive imaging modality used for visualization of retinal tissue. However, OCT volumes are affected by speckle noise, which degrades image contrast and obscures fine structural details. Furthermore, modern clinical practice requires large field-of-view, high-resolution OCT volumes, whose storage and transmission are demanding for archiving and teleophthalmology applications. To address aforementioned challenges, we propose a low-rank multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) tensor network approximation of 3D OCT image volume, where the image volume is represented as contractions of a top core factor encoding global features and multiple interacting low-rank orthogonal or semi-orthogonal factors modeling inter- and intra-B scan correlations. This representation jointly enables compression, denoising, and feature extraction. Unlike deep learning approaches, the proposed approach is training-free and processes each OCT volume independently. We evaluate the proposed framework on OCT image volumes acquired by two different scanners and demonstrate improved visual quality and reduced retinal layer segmentation errors in comparison with several competing methods. We also extract MERA features from two clinical OCT volume datasets. They are subsequently classified using a Grassmann-manifold nearest-subspace classifier. With the subspace dimension as its only hyperparameter, the classifier is theoretically shown to be robust in small-sample clinical scenario. We demonstrate competitive accuracy of classification of retinal diseases in these small-sample settings, where deep learning methods are often limited by the scarcity of labeled data. The proposed structure-aware model-driven representation learning for high-dimensional data under limited supervision provides good generalization performance while maintaining high interpretability.
zh_abstract: 光学相干断层扫描（Optical Coherence Tomography, OCT）是一种用于可视化视网膜组织的无创成像模态。然而，OCT体数据受散斑噪声影响，这会降低图像对比度并遮蔽精细结构细节。此外，现代临床实践需要大视野、高分辨率OCT体数据，其存储和传输对归档和远程眼科应用要求很高。为应对上述挑战，我们提出一种对三维OCT图像体的低秩多尺度纠缠重整化拟设（multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz, MERA）张量网络近似，其中图像体被表示为编码全局特征的顶层核心因子与多个相互作用的低秩正交或半正交因子的收缩，这些因子建模B扫描间和B扫描内相关性。这种表示联合实现压缩、去噪和特征提取。与深度学习方法不同，所提出的方法无需训练，并独立处理每个OCT体。我们在由两种不同扫描仪获取的OCT图像体上评估所提出的框架，并证明与几种竞争方法相比，视觉质量得到改善且视网膜层分割误差降低。我们还从两个临床OCT体数据集中提取MERA特征。随后使用Grassmann流形最近子空间分类器对它们进行分类。以子空间维度作为其唯一超参数，该分类器在理论上被证明在小样本临床场景中具有鲁棒性。我们在这些小样本设置中展示了具有竞争力的视网膜疾病分类准确率，而深度学习方法在这些设置中常受标注数据稀缺的限制。所提出的针对有限监督下高维数据的结构感知、模型驱动表征学习提供了良好的泛化性能，同时保持高可解释性。

title: Domain-Adapted Latent Diffusion Models for CT-to-PET Image Translation
zh_title: 域自适应潜扩散模型实现 CT 到 PET 图像转换
summary: 预印本提出域自适应潜扩散框架，用21,930对CT/PET切片迁移自然图像先验，在像素重建与局部肿瘤保真上优于CPDM。
key_points: 用21,930对配对的CT/PET切片训练
带符号幂变换处理PET强度极度稀疏
像素重建与局部肿瘤保真度优于CPDM基线
reason: 有明确基线与较大配对数据量，但为预印本且无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) provides important metabolic information for tumor detection and staging but remains significantly less accessible than Computed Tomography (CT) due to its high cost, infrastructure requirements, and reliance on injected radioactive tracers. CT-to-PET image translation using generative models aims to address this disparity, yet state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods are limited by the scarcity of paired training data. To overcome this, we propose a domain-adapted latent diffusion framework that transfers natural-image priors using a relatively small dataset of 21,930 paired CT/PET slices, incorporating a signed power transform to resolve extreme intensity sparsity in PET data. Compared to CPDM, a state-ofthe-art baseline for CT-to-PET image translation, our approach yields superior performance in pixel-wise reconstruction and localized tumor fidelity, demonstrating effective transfer of natural-image priors to the medical domain. We further provide a systematic analysis of evaluation metric reliability for sparse PET data, showing that standard full-image metrics can be misleading indicators of translated image quality, and propose background-filtered and mask-restricted metrics as more clinically meaningful alternatives.
zh_abstract: 正电子发射断层成像（Positron Emission Tomography, PET）为肿瘤检测和分期提供重要的代谢信息，但由于成本高、基础设施要求高以及依赖注射放射性示踪剂，其可及性仍显著低于计算机断层成像（Computed Tomography, CT）。使用生成模型进行 CT 到 PET 的图像转换旨在解决这一差距，然而最先进的基于扩散的方法受限于配对训练数据的稀缺。为克服这一点，我们提出一种域适应潜在扩散框架，该框架使用相对较小的 21,930 个配对 CT/PET 切片数据集迁移自然图像先验，并纳入带符号幂变换以解决 PET 数据中极端强度稀疏性。与 CPDM——CT 到 PET 图像转换的最先进基线——相比，我们的方法在逐像素重建和局部肿瘤保真度方面取得更优性能，证明自然图像先验可有效迁移到医学领域。我们进一步对稀疏 PET 数据的评估指标可靠性进行系统分析，表明标准的全图像指标可能是转换图像质量的有误导性的指标，并提出背景滤波和掩膜限制指标作为更具临床意义的替代方案。

title: EXCISE: Locating and Excising Distracting Sentences in Medical Question Answering
zh_title: EXCISE：定位并切除医学问答中的干扰句
summary: 提出推理时方法EXCISE，利用隐藏状态判断并屏蔽最影响答案且与病例不一致的句子，以提升医学问答对无关信息的鲁棒性。
key_points: 屏蔽已知干扰句的注意力可恢复正确答案
头掩码反而可能抑制正确答案
隐藏状态可将干扰句标记为最不符病例的句子
无需事先知道哪句是干扰句即可削弱其影响
reason: 针对医学问答鲁棒性的新推理时方法，有机制分析与基线对比，但证据限于预印本
abstract: Language models are increasingly considered for clinical decision support, where their answers should be grounded in clinical evidence and remain robust to irrelevant information. Prior work shows that a single irrelevant sentence can lower the accuracy of medical models, but not where inside the model its effect can be removed, or how to do so without knowing which sentence it is. We find that blocking attention to a known distractor restores the answer, whereas head masking can suppress correct answers. We also show that the model's hidden states mark the distractor as the sentence that least fits the case even when the model follows it. To remove a distractor's effect without knowing which sentence it is, we propose EXCISE, an inference-time method that blocks the sentence most influencing the answer, but only if the model's hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the case. On MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), a benchmark we construct in which each distractor targets a specific wrong option, EXCISE gains 16.7-22.8 accuracy points at a 1.5-2.1-point cost on the same questions without distractors, outperforming prompting, rewriting, and steering baselines for all three models. Its gains extend to MedDistractQA and BiasMedQA, as well as chain-of-thought generation.
zh_abstract: 语言模型正越来越多地被考虑用于临床决策支持，其中其答案应基于临床证据，并对无关信息保持稳健。先前工作表明，单个无关句子可以降低医学模型的准确率，但未说明在模型内部何处可以去除其影响，也未说明在不知道是哪一句的情况下如何做到。我们发现，阻断对已知干扰项的注意力可恢复答案，而头掩码（head masking）可能抑制正确答案。我们还表明，即使模型遵循干扰项，其隐藏状态也会将该干扰项标记为最不符合病例的句子。为了在不知道是哪一句的情况下去除干扰项的影响，我们提出 EXCISE，一种推理时方法，它阻断对答案影响最大的句子，但仅当模型的隐藏状态将其标记为与病例不一致时。在 MedQA-TD（带定向干扰项的 MedQA）——我们构建的一个基准，其中每个干扰项都针对一个特定的错误选项——上，EXCISE 在无干扰项的相同问题上以 1.5-2.1 个百分点的代价获得 16.7-22.8 个准确率百分点，且在全部三个模型上优于提示、重写和引导（steering）基线。其增益扩展到 MedDistractQA 和 BiasMedQA，以及思维链生成。

title: TransECG-SSL: Hybrid Self-Supervised Representation Learning for ECG Arrhythmia Classification
zh_title: TransECG-SSL：心电心律失常分类的混合自监督表征学习
summary: 提出结合掩码信号重建与对比学习的自监督框架，用无标注心电数据预训练Transformer编码器以提升跨数据集泛化。
key_points: 混合自监督目标预训练后冻结编码器做线性探测
采用患者不重叠的评估划分
三个公开心电数据库、七种源-目标设置

reason: 跨库多设置评估提升可信度，但均为公开数据集、仅线性探测，属预印本中档
abstract: Cross-dataset generalisation remains a major challenge for automated electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia classification because of differences in patient populations, acquisition protocols, annotation practices, and class distributions. Learning representations that remain informative across independent datasets could reduce reliance on dataset-specific labelled data. We propose TransECG-SSL, a self-supervised framework for transferable heartbeat representation learning from unlabelled ECG data. A Transformer encoder is pretrained using a hybrid objective combining masked signal reconstruction and contrastive learning, then frozen and evaluated by linear probing under patient-disjoint evaluation. Experiments across three public ECG databases and seven source--target settings show that Hybrid SSL consistently outperforms randomly initialised Transformers and achieves higher balanced accuracy than architecture-matched source-supervised pretraining. Reconstruction-only SSL remains competitive with Hybrid SSL, whereas contrastive-only pretraining performs substantially worse, highlighting the importance of masked reconstruction for transferability. Cross-dataset transfer nevertheless reduces balanced accuracy relative to target-specific self-supervised pretraining, while minority arrhythmia classes remain challenging under severe class imbalance. These findings demonstrate the potential of label-efficient self-supervised learning for cross-dataset ECG representation transfer while highlighting persistent limitations from domain shift and class imbalance.
zh_abstract: 跨数据集泛化仍然是自动心电图（ECG）心律失常分类的主要挑战，原因包括患者人群、采集方案、标注实践和类别分布的差异。学习在独立数据集之间仍具信息量的表示，可减少对数据集特定标注数据的依赖。我们提出 TransECG-SSL，一种从无标注 ECG 数据学习可迁移心跳表示的自监督框架。使用结合掩码信号重建和对比学习的混合目标对 Transformer 编码器进行预训练，然后冻结，并在患者不重叠评估下通过线性探测进行评估。在三个公开 ECG 数据库和七种源—目标设置上的实验表明，Hybrid SSL 一致优于随机初始化的 Transformer，并比架构匹配的源监督预训练获得更高的平衡准确率。仅重建 SSL 与 Hybrid SSL 相比仍具竞争力，而仅对比预训练表现显著更差，突显了掩码重建对可迁移性的重要性。然而，相对于目标特定的自监督预训练，跨数据集迁移降低了平衡准确率，而在严重类别不平衡下，少数心律失常类别仍然具有挑战性。这些发现证明了标签高效的自监督学习在跨数据集 ECG 表示迁移中的潜力，同时突显了域偏移和类别不平衡带来的持续限制。

title: Fusion of Deep Learning Radiomics and Clinical Features for Individualized Prediction of Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Response in Osteosarcoma.
zh_title: 深度学习影像组学预测骨肉瘤新辅助化疗反应
summary: 回顾性纳入198例，联合MRI深度学习影像组学评分与临床变量构建多模态模型预测化疗反应。
key_points: 比较12种CNN架构，DenseNet121交叉验证AUC最高（0.775）
影像组学评分与核心临床变量经逻辑回归融合

reason: 单中心回顾性、样本不足千例且仅内部交叉验证，属增量档
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Stage IIB conventional osteosarcoma exhibits highly heterogeneous responses to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, necessitating reliable, noninvasive pre-treatment evaluation systems. Methods: This retrospective study of 198 patients utilized pre-treatment T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and baseline clinical data. Twelve classical convolutional neural network architectures were benchmarked to identify the optimal imaging backbone. This selected radiomics score was then integrated with core clinical variables using logistic regression to construct a multimodal model. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping++ (Grad-CAM++) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) algorithms provided image- and feature-level interpretability. Results: DenseNet121 achieved the highest mean cross-validated area under the curve (AUC; 0.775) and was selected, with AUCs of 0.797 (95% CI: 0.716-0.877) and 0.701 (95% CI: 0.513-0.877) in the training and test cohorts. Adding the clinical variables improved discrimination, yielding a test-cohort AUC of 0.827 (95% CI: 0.661-0.992) with significant reclassification gain over the radiomics-only model (NRI = 1.28, IDI = 0.177; DeLong p = 0.011). Grad-CAM++ activation concentrated on the solid medullary and extraosseous soft-tissue components, and SHAP ranked the radiomics score as the strongest contributor. Conclusions: Integrating deep learning radiomics with key clinical features provides a noninvasive tool for the individualized prediction of neoadjuvant chemosensitivity in osteosarcoma.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景】IIB期经典型骨肉瘤对新辅助化疗的反应高度异质，因此需要可靠的、无创的治疗前评估系统。【方法】这项纳入198例患者的回顾性研究使用了治疗前T2加权磁共振成像（MRI）和基线临床数据。对12种经典卷积神经网络架构进行基准测试，以确定最佳成像骨干网络。随后使用逻辑回归将该选定的影像组学评分与核心临床变量整合，构建多模态模型。梯度加权类激活映射++（Grad-CAM++）和SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）算法提供了图像层面和特征层面的可解释性。【结果】DenseNet121获得最高的平均交叉验证曲线下面积（AUC；0.775）并被选中，其在训练队列和测试队列中的AUC分别为0.797（95% CI：0.716-0.877）和0.701（95% CI：0.513-0.877）。加入临床变量改善了区分能力，使测试队列AUC达到0.827（95% CI：0.661-0.992），并且相较于仅影像组学模型具有显著的重分类改善（NRI = 1.28，IDI = 0.177；DeLong p = 0.011）。Grad-CAM++激活集中在实性髓内和骨外软组织成分，SHAP将影像组学评分列为最强贡献因素。【结论】将深度学习影像组学与关键临床特征整合，为骨肉瘤新辅助化疗敏感性的个体化预测提供了一种无创工具。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Northwestern University; conditions: Lung Carcinoma, Lung Non-Small Cell Carcinoma, Metastatic Malignant Neoplasm in the Lung; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 34; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This clinical trial studies whether an artificial intelligence (AI) software tool called iSeg can be safely and effectively used during routine radiation treatment planning for patients with lung tumors. Typical radiation treatment planning involves physicians manually outlining the tumors to plan where the radiation therapy will be delivered. This process can be time consuming and may vary between physicians. iSeg uses AI to analyze computed tomography (CT) images and generate a proposed tumor outline that can then be reviewed and modified by the treating physician during radiation treatment planning which may help improve accuracy and provide more consistent results and better planning. iSeg may be safe and effective to use during radiation treatment planning for patients with lung tumors.
