abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Tri-Service General Hospital (TSGH); conditions: Intubation, Intratracheal, Medical Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 200; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The goal of this educational study is to learn whether AI smart glasses can score and give feedback on endotracheal intubation performed by medical students on a manikin, and when this AI feedback is most useful during anesthesia training. The main questions it aims to answer are: * Do AI scores of the intubation OSCE (Objective Structured Clinical Examination) agree with scores given by faculty examiners? * Does practicing with AI smart-glasses feedback before or after the airway lecture lead to better intubation OSCE performance, self-efficacy, and cognitive load? Medical interns rotating through the Department of Anesthesiology at Tri-Service General Hospital (Taiwan) for 2 weeks will be randomized by rotation group to practice intubation once with the AI smart glasses either before the airway lecture (week 1) or after it (week 2). At the end of the rotation, all participants will take an intubation OSCE while wearing the AI glasses, scored independently by a faculty examiner and by the AI. Yet, the public is circumspect with continual exposure to news about cybersecurity threats or attacks, identity theft, violations of privacy, and challenges of establishing trust in their daily encounters with technology amidst prevalence of deep fakes, voice cloning, and AI-generated images or videos of people. A meta-synthesis of AI-related literature inclusive of expert panels is examined as an exploratory search for AI applicability and use in the health care landscape. abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] Viral infections continue to pose a significant global health challenge. Antiviral peptides (AVPs) have emerged as promising therapeutic agents owing to their high specificity, favorable safety profiles, and broad-spectrum antiviral activity. However, experimental AVP identification is time-consuming and costly, while existing computational predictors often have limitations in predictive accuracy and feature representation. Here, we propose DeepAVPred, a deep learning-based framework for AVP identification. DeepAVPred integrates complementary sequence descriptors to capture physicochemical properties and pairwise residue interactions. We present a novel feature representation, the Residue Energy Content Matrix augmented with a Discrete Wavelet Transform (RECM-DWT). RECM-DWT characterizes multi-scale patterns in residue-energy information and complements conventional sequence descriptors by providing wavelet-derived features across multiple resolution levels. The integrated features are then modeled using an attention-based Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) network to learn contextual dependencies and informative sequence patterns. On the AVPtrain dataset, DeepAVPred achieved strong performance in 10-fold cross-validation, with an accuracy of 0.990, a Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) of 0.980, and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.993. On the independent test dataset, AVPtest, DeepAVPred achieved an accuracy of 0.942, an MCC of 0.886, and an AUC of 0.949. These results demonstrate the predictive performance of DeepAVPred and support its potential as a computational framework for prioritizing candidate antiviral peptides for further experimental validation.
zh_abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] 病毒感染持续构成重大的全球健康挑战。抗病毒肽（AVPs）因其高特异性、良好的安全性特征和广谱抗病毒活性而成为有前景的治疗药物。然而，实验性AVP鉴定耗时且成本高昂，而现有计算预测器在预测准确性和特征表示方面常存在局限。在此，我们提出DeepAVPred，一个基于深度学习的AVP鉴定框架。DeepAVPred整合互补的序列描述符，以捕获理化性质和成对残基相互作用。我们提出一种新的特征表示——残基能量内容矩阵结合离散小波变换（RECM-DWT）。RECM-DWT表征残基能量信息中的多尺度模式，并通过提供跨多个分辨率水平的小波衍生特征来补充传统序列描述符。随后，整合特征使用基于注意力的双向门控循环单元（BiGRU）网络建模，以学习上下文依赖性和信息性序列模式。在AVPtrain数据集上，DeepAVPred在10折交叉验证中取得强劲性能，准确率为0.990，马修斯相关系数（MCC）为0.980，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.993。在独立测试数据集AVPtest上，DeepAVPred达到准确率0.942、MCC 0.886和AUC 0.949。这些结果证明了DeepAVPred的预测性能，并支持其作为计算框架的潜力，用于优先选择候选抗病毒肽以进一步实验验证。

title: A Lightweight Attention-Based CNN with Saliency-Map Interpretability for Skin Cancer Detection

abstract: Skin cancer is among the most prevalent and life threatening forms of cancer worldwide. Early and accurate diagnosis significantly improves patient survival rates. However, manual dermoscopic assessment remains challenging due to visual similarity. This study proposes an Explainable AI-driven framework for automated binary classification of skin lesions using a lightweight attention-based convolutional neural network (CNN-Attention). The model integrates channel attention to focus on informative regions of dermoscopic images while maintaining low computational complexity. A publicly available dataset comprising 2,637 training and 660 test images was used, with balanced class weights. The proposed model achieved 87 percent accuracy with 1.95 million parameters and 7.45 MB of storage, matching the best baseline (MobileNet) while using approximately half as many parameters and half as much storage. ROC AUC and PR AUC scores reached 0.9475 and 0.9430, respectively. Additionally, saliency maps were incorporated as an explainability technique to visualize regions that influence model decisions. Comparative analysis with VGG16,VGG19,ResNet101,and MobileNet demonstrates the proposed models effectiveness in balancing classification results, computational efficiency, and interpretability.
zh_abstract: 皮肤癌是全球最常见且危及生命的癌症类型之一。早期、准确诊断可显著提高患者生存率。然而，由于视觉相似性，人工皮肤镜评估仍具挑战性。本研究提出一个可解释 AI 驱动框架，使用轻量级基于注意力的卷积神经网络（CNN-Attention）对皮肤病变进行自动二分类。该模型整合通道注意力以聚焦皮肤镜图像中的信息区域，同时保持较低计算复杂度。使用一个公开数据集，包含 2,637 张训练图像和 660 张测试图像，并采用平衡类别权重。所提模型在 195 万（1.95 million）个参数和 7.45 MB 存储下达到 87% 准确率，与最佳基线（MobileNet）相当，而参数数量和存储约减半。ROC AUC 和 PR AUC 分别达到 0.9475 和 0.9430。此外，纳入显著性图作为一种可解释性技术，以可视化影响模型决策的区域。与 VGG16、VGG19、ResNet101 和 MobileNet 的比较分析表明，所提模型在平衡分类结果、计算效率和可解释性方面具有有效性。

summary: 无需训练将CT体渲染转为3D高斯泼溅，便于在低算力设备实时显示。

abstract: Photorealistic volume rendering of computed tomography (CT) may convey anatomy intuitively, but it needs the CT data, dedicated software and a powerful graphics processor. Three-dimensional Gaussian splatting (3DGS) displays photorealistic scenes in real time on less powerful devices, but existing medical approaches train each scene for minutes to hours. We aimed to convert a CT volume rendering directly into a 3DGS model without training. Splats were placed on an adaptive octree of millimetre-sized cells. Their colour and opacity were computed on the graphics processor with the renderer's lighting, cell opacity was converted analytically into splat opacity, and faint splats were retained stochastically above the 1/255 opacity floor of standard 3DGS rasterisers. Six public CT scans (1.5-mm voxels) were converted with three transfer functions and compared with converged references by peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity and a learned perceptual metric. Two-million-splat models reached a PSNR of 32.6 +/- 0.9 dB for bone, 30.1 +/- 1.0 dB for contrast-enhanced vessels and 32.3 +/- 1.5 dB for skin and bone. A conversion pass (usually two or three per model) took 4-30 s on a current laptop and 9-60 s on a desktop with a 4-GB graphics card. On the laptop, the models rendered at 68 frames per second at 800 x 800 pixels. Training-free conversion produced real-time 3DGS models of photorealistic CT renderings in about a minute or less per conversion pass on ordinary computers, with fidelity that we consider sufficient for interactive viewing.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）的真实感体绘制可直观呈现解剖结构，但需要 CT 数据、专用软件和强大的图形处理器。三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）可在性能较弱的设备上实时显示真实感场景，但现有医学方法对每个场景训练数分钟至数小时。我们旨在将 CT 体绘制直接转换为无需训练的 3DGS 模型。泼溅点被放置在毫米级单元的自适应八叉树上。其颜色和不透明度在图形处理器上结合渲染器的光照计算，单元不透明度经解析转换为泼溅点不透明度，微弱泼溅点在标准 3DGS 光栅化器 1/255 不透明度下限之上以随机方式保留。六份公开 CT 扫描（1.5-mm 体素）以三种传递函数转换，并通过峰值信噪比（PSNR）、结构相似性和一种学习感知指标与收敛参考进行比较。两百万泼溅点模型在骨达到 32.6 +/- 0.9 dB 的 PSNR，在对比增强血管达到 30.1 +/- 1.0 dB，在皮肤和骨达到 32.3 +/- 1.5 dB。一次转换遍历（每个模型通常两到三次）在当前笔记本电脑上耗时 4-30 s，在配备 4-GB 显卡的台式机上耗时 9-60 s。在笔记本电脑上，模型以 800 x 800 像素、68 帧/秒渲染。免训练转换在普通计算机上每次转换遍历约一分钟或更短时间内，生成真实感 CT 渲染的实时 3DGS 模型，其保真度我们认为足以用于交互式查看。

title: FORESEE-MS: Toward Prospective Spatial Forecasting of Future Multiple Sclerosis Lesions from Baseline FLAIR MRI
zh_title: FORESEE-MS：基于基线FLAIR预测未来多发性硬化病灶
summary: 提出评估框架，用人群先验图谱作基线，比较五种深度学习模型预测MS新病灶的能力。
key_points: 39例MSSEG-2受试者，5折交叉验证
评估指标含AUROC、AUPRC与患者内Recall@Top-K%
图谱基线pooled指标最高，深度学习模型未可靠超越
reason: 单数据集39例回顾性小样本，无模型超越基线，属增量档
abstract: Traditional multiple sclerosis (MS) image analysis has primarily focused on retrospectively detecting and segmenting lesions. This study investigates whether baseline FLAIR MRI can identify regions at risk for future lesion formation beyond population-level spatial patterns. We introduce FORESEE-MS, an evaluation protocol that uses a fold-specific population-prior atlas as a baseline and assesses predictions using pooled voxel-level discrimination (AUROC and AUPRC) and within-patient lesion localization (Recall@Top-K%), with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals. We evaluated five deep learning models (3D U-Net, Attn+ResBlock+VAE, ViT, and two SwinUNETR variants) using 5-fold cross-validation on 39 subjects from the MSSEG-2 dataset. The atlas achieved the highest pooled voxel-level AUROC and AUPRC, with no deep learning model reliably outperforming it on either metric. However, the 3D U-Net and Attn+ResBlock+VAE achieved higher mean voxel-level within-patient Recall@Top-K% than the atlas at all evaluated thresholds, although most paired confidence intervals for the differences included zero. These findings suggest that baseline FLAIR may contain patient-specific predictive information, but in this small cohort, it remains uncertain whether this information improves lesion forecasting beyond a population-prior atlas.
zh_abstract: 传统多发性硬化（MS）图像分析主要集中于回顾性检测和分割病灶。本研究探讨基线 FLAIR MRI 是否能够识别未来病灶形成风险区域，而不仅限于人群水平的空间模式。我们提出 FORESEE-MS，一种评估协议，其使用折叠特异性（fold-specific）人群先验图谱作为基线，并通过合并的体素水平判别能力（AUROC 和 AUPRC）以及患者内病灶定位（Recall@Top-K%）评估预测，采用患者水平 bootstrap 置信区间。我们在来自 MSSEG-2 数据集的 39 名受试者上使用 5 折交叉验证评估了五种深度学习模型（3D U-Net、Attn+ResBlock+VAE、ViT 和两种 SwinUNETR 变体）。该图谱获得了最高的合并体素水平 AUROC 和 AUPRC，且没有深度学习模型在任一指标上能够可靠地优于它。然而，3D U-Net 和 Attn+ResBlock+VAE 在所有评估阈值下均获得了高于图谱的平均体素水平患者内 Recall@Top-K%，尽管大多数差异的配对置信区间包含零。这些发现提示，基线 FLAIR 可能包含患者特异性预测信息，但在这个小队列中，尚不确定该信息是否能比人群先验图谱更好地改善病灶预测。

title: Enhancing Clinical Classifier Robustness with Deep Representation Learning Based OOD Detection on DNA Methylation Data
zh_title: DNA甲基化数据深度表征学习OOD检测
summary: 针对DNA甲基化阵列肿瘤分类，提出深度表征学习框架，用于识别训练分布外的肿瘤类型。

abstract: DNA methylation (DNAM) array-based tumor classification is a powerful clinical diagnostic tool, but models trained on fixed reference cohorts can produce faulty predictions for tumor types not represented in the training distribution. We propose an end-to-end deep representation learning-based out-of-distribution (OOD) detection framework for DNAm array data. Deep neural network (DNN) classifiers were trained on public sarcoma (SARC) (GSE140686) and brain tumor (BT) (GSE90496) cohorts, and feature vectors were extracted from bottleneck layers. Five OOD methods, including 1dimension (1D)-Subspace Analysis (1D-SSA), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Ridge Regression, Mahalanobis Distance (MD), and Sum of Squared Distances (SSD), were explored with 200 and 500-dimensional embeddings. Spectral discrepancy was used to discriminate in-distribution (IND) from OOD samples. Performance was measured via cross-validation, holdout samples, and an independent clinical dataset. 1D-SSA was the most effective approach. In the sarcoma-IND/brain tumor-OOD setting, the framework achieved an AUROC of 0.975 and True Negative Rate (TNR)@95TPR of 0.930, and an AUROC of 0.9569 and TNR@95TPR of 0.8660 for the brain tumor-IND/sarcoma-OOD setting. On the independent clinical test set, the method yielded a mean AUROC of 0.976, a DE of 0.032, an FPR@95TPR of 0.065, and a TNR@95TPR of 0.935. These results show deep representation-based OOD detection as a practical quality-control layer for clinical-grade methylation-based tumor classification systems.
zh_abstract: 基于 DNA 甲基化（DNAM）芯片的肿瘤分类是一种强大的临床诊断工具，但在固定参考队列上训练的模型可能对训练分布中未代表的肿瘤类型产生错误预测。我们提出一种用于 DNAm 芯片数据的端到端、基于深度表示学习的分布外（OOD）检测框架。深度神经网络（DNN）分类器在公开肉瘤（SARC）（GSE140686）和脑肿瘤（BT）（GSE90496）队列上训练，并从瓶颈层提取特征向量。探索了五种 OOD 方法，包括一维（1D）子空间分析（1D-SSA）、K 近邻（KNN）、岭回归、马氏距离（MD）和距离平方和（SSD），使用 200 维和 500 维嵌入。谱差异用于区分分布内（IND）和 OOD 样本。性能通过交叉验证、留出样本和一个独立临床数据集进行测量。1D-SSA 是最有效的方法。在肉瘤-IND/脑肿瘤-OOD 设置中，该框架达到 AUROC 0.975 和 True Negative Rate（TNR）@95TPR 0.930；在脑肿瘤-IND/肉瘤-OOD 设置中，AUROC 为 0.9569，TNR@95TPR 为 0.8660。在独立临床测试集上，该方法产生平均 AUROC 0.976、DE 0.032、FPR@95TPR 0.065 和 TNR@95TPR 0.935。这些结果表明，基于深度表示的 OOD 检测可作为临床级基于甲基化的肿瘤分类系统的实用质量控制层。

title: Segmentation Confidence for Arbitrary CNNs

abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) are widely used for medical image segmentation. However, they lack an inherent measure of confidence. Existing methods for estimating prediction uncertainty often require a custom network architecture and/or dedicated training setups and need to be trained from scratch. In addition, the deduction of a single confidence score per input from the uncertainty maps is not always straightforward. In this study, we explore voxel-based uncertainty estimation methods that can be added to existing segmentation pipelines without training from scratch. We also propose a novel method to estimate a single confidence score from the uncertainty maps. Our evaluations on different ROIs and modalities suggest that our confidence score can predict segmentation performance in unseen data.
zh_abstract: 卷积神经网络（CNN）广泛用于医学图像分割。然而，它们缺乏一种内在的置信度度量。现有估计预测不确定性的方法通常需要自定义网络架构和/或专用训练设置，并且需要从头训练。此外，从不确定性图推导每个输入的单一置信度分数并不总是直接明了。在本研究中，我们探索可添加到现有分割流程而无需从头训练的基于体素的不确定性估计方法。我们还提出一种从不确定性图估计单一置信度分数的新方法。我们在不同 ROI 和模态上的评估表明，我们的置信度分数可以预测未见数据上的分割性能。

title: Evaluating a Large Language Model for Emergency Triage Using Synthetic Clinical Dialogues: Toward a Multimodal Clinical Safety Framework.
zh_title: 大语言模型用于急诊分诊的合成对话评估
summary: 研究用合成临床对话评估GPT-5.2急诊分诊表现，提出连接电子病历与分诊对话的概念框架。

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Prioritizing patient safety through accurate emergency triage is critical during mass-gathering events such as Hajj and Umrah, where high patient volumes can significantly increase the risk of clinical errors. Although the Emergency Severity Index (ESI) provides a standardized triage protocol, it remains dependent on human judgment, while traditional artificial intelligence (AI) models often struggle to capture the nuanced clinical context embedded in patient narratives. To address this gap, this study evaluates GPT-5.2 using synthetically generated dialogues as a step toward a conceptual clinical decision-support framework that bridges structured electronic health records (EHRs) with triage interactions through clinical dialogues. By combining narrative inputs with structured physiological indicators, it explores the potential to support more informed clinical decision-making under controlled simulation conditions. Methods: To evaluate this contribution, we systematically assessed the role of clinical dialogues in triage performance using a balanced and stratified dataset of 1000 simulated Hajj-context scenarios. Results: The results demonstrate that incorporating clinical dialogues can significantly improve triage performance, with a 79.7% relative reduction in under-triage across all ESI levels. A more noticeable improvement was observed in high-acuity cases, with a 91.9% relative reduction in under-triage. In addition, the model achieved a high-acuity recall of 94.5%, highlighting its ability to identify critical "red-flag" symptoms that are often not captured in structured data. These findings suggest that narrative context may contribute to more accurate triage assessment and improved identification of high-acuity cases. Conclusions: Consequently, when evaluated within a controlled decision-support setting, this study suggests that large language model (LLM)-based systems may improve triage reliability and may contribute to safer triage decision-making in high-demand clinical environments.
zh_abstract: 《Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)》【背景/目的】通过准确的急诊分诊优先保障患者安全，在朝觐（Hajj）和副朝（Umrah）等大规模集会活动中至关重要，因为大量患者可能显著增加临床错误风险。尽管急诊严重度指数（ESI）提供了标准化分诊方案，但它仍依赖人工判断，而传统人工智能（AI）模型往往难以捕捉患者叙述中蕴含的细微临床背景。为弥补这一空白，本研究使用合成生成的对话评估GPT-5.2，作为迈向概念性临床决策支持框架的一步，该框架通过临床对话将结构化电子健康记录（EHR）与分诊交互连接起来。通过将叙述性输入与结构化生理指标相结合，它探索在受控模拟条件下支持更明智临床决策的潜力。【方法】为评估这一贡献，我们使用包含1000个模拟朝觐情境场景的平衡分层数据集，系统评估临床对话在分诊表现中的作用。【结果】结果表明，纳入临床对话可显著改善分诊表现，在所有ESI级别中，分诊不足（under-triage）相对减少79.7%。在高急症病例中观察到更明显改善，分诊不足相对减少91.9%。此外，该模型在高急症病例中达到94.5%的召回率，突出其识别结构化数据中常未捕捉到的关键“红旗”症状的能力。这些发现提示，叙述性背景可能有助于更准确的分诊评估和更好地识别高急症病例。【结论】因此，在受控决策支持环境中评估时，本研究表明基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统可能提高分诊可靠性，并可能有助于在高需求临床环境中实现更安全的分诊决策。

abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] Toxicogenomics integrates high-throughput genomic technologies with toxicology to evaluate molecular responses to chemical and pharmaceutical exposures. The increasing volume and complexity of multi-omics data necessitate advanced computational approaches capable of extracting meaningful and predictive insights. In this context, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) techniques-including support vector machines, random forests, and deep learning architectures-are increasingly employed for early toxicity prediction and risk assessment, with reported improvements in predictive accuracy and sensitivity relative to conventional toxicological approaches. This paper explores the role of AI-driven toxicogenomics in enhancing predictive environmental and pharmaceutical safety. It highlights the application of ML-based and data-driven models for the integrative analysis of transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic datasets to identify toxicity-associated biomarkers, elucidate mechanisms of action, and predict adverse drug and environmental effects prior to clinical manifestation. Notably, AI-driven models have demonstrated significant improvements in prediction accuracy, sensitivity, and scalability compared to traditional toxicological approaches, reducing reliance on animal testing and accelerating decision-making processes. Furthermore, the paper discusses the significance of AI-based toxicogenomics in drug development, environmental contaminant screening, and regulatory toxicology, while addressing key challenges such as data heterogeneity, model interpretability, and regulatory acceptance. The convergence of computer science and toxicogenomics represents a robust framework for next-generation predictive toxicology, facilitating safer pharmaceutical development, more precise environmental risk assessment, and evidence-based public health and regulatory decision-making.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] 毒理基因组学（toxicogenomics）整合高通量基因组技术与毒理学，以评估对化学和药物暴露的分子反应。多组学数据数量和复杂性的不断增加，需要先进的计算方法能够提取有意义且具有预测性的见解。在此背景下，人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）技术——包括支持向量机（support vector machines）、随机森林（random forests）和深度学习架构（deep learning architectures）——越来越多地用于早期毒性预测和风险评估，据报道，相对于传统毒理学方法，其预测准确性和敏感性有所提高。本文探讨AI驱动的毒理基因组学在增强预测性环境和药物安全性方面的作用。文章重点介绍基于ML和数据驱动模型在转录组、蛋白质组和代谢组数据集整合分析中的应用，以识别毒性相关生物标志物、阐明作用机制，并在临床表现出现之前预测药物和环境不良效应。值得注意的是，与传统毒理学方法相比，AI驱动模型在预测准确性、敏感性和可扩展性方面已显示出显著改善，减少了对动物试验的依赖并加速了决策过程。此外，本文讨论了基于AI的毒理基因组学在药物开发、环境污染物筛查和监管毒理学中的意义，同时讨论了数据异质性、模型可解释性和监管接受度等关键挑战。计算机科学与毒理基因组学的融合代表了下一代预测毒理学的一个稳健框架，有助于更安全的药物开发、更精确的环境风险评估以及基于证据的公共卫生和监管决策。

title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence

summary: 预印本观点文章提出以共享推理轨迹替代数据或参数聚合的去中心化智能体框架。
key_points: 主张从数据聚合转向经验聚合

reason: 观点性预印本，无实验验证，按观点档上限内取中低
abstract: Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated. In this Perspective, we argue for a fundamental shift from data aggregation to experience aggregation. We propose Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework in which distributed AI agents operating across healthcare institutions synthesize collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters. Unlike federated learning, which averages numerical gradients across homogeneous model architectures, DAS exchanges structured records of clinical reasoning, specifically the sequence of observations, hypotheses, tool invocations, and outcome feedback that constitute diagnostic experience. We examine the architectural principles, deployment considerations, governance requirements, and critical open challenges of this framework, laying the groundwork for a collaborative medical AI ecosystem where distributed expertise autonomously adapts to the complexities of longitudinal patient care.
zh_abstract: 临床专业知识本质上是分布式的：它并不存在于任何单一数据集或机构中，而是存在于成千上万名临床医生在应对多样化患者人群、资源约束和不断演变的治疗方案过程中所积累的推理经验之中。然而，当前用于扩展医学人工智能的方法，从集中式大语言模型到联邦学习，仍然锚定于以数据为中心的范式，该范式将知识视为待聚合的静态参数。在本 Perspective（观点）文章中，我们主张从数据聚合向经验聚合的根本性转变。我们提出去中心化智能体系统（Decentralized Agentic Systems, DAS），这一框架中，跨医疗机构运行的分布式 AI 智能体通过共享抽象化的推理轨迹，而非原始数据或模型参数，来综合集体临床智能。与在同质模型架构之间对数值梯度进行平均的联邦学习不同，DAS 交换结构化的临床推理记录，具体而言是构成诊断经验的观察、假设、工具调用和结果反馈序列。我们考察该框架的架构原则、部署考量、治理要求以及关键开放挑战，为一种协作式医学 AI 生态系统奠定基础，在该生态系统中，分布式专业知识能够自主适应纵向患者照护的复杂性。

title: Sequential versus fully conditional specification for tree-based synthesis of health data
zh_title: 健康数据树模型合成：顺序式与全条件式比较
summary: 预印本比较两种基于决策树条件分布的健康数据合成规范，用多项风险与效用指标评估合成数据质量。

以多项风险与效用指标衡量合成质量

abstract: Disseminating synthetic data in place of original ones is a promising way to enforce privacy while complying with open science principles, especially in the healthcare domain. To keep pace with the rate at which researchers collect such data, there is a need for fast and flexible synthesis procedures. A popular class of such procedures is based on models of conditional distributions induced by decision trees. Such models can be combined into a synthetic distribution following two main approaches: sequential specification and fully conditional specification. However, there is currently no recommendation on which specification to use to optimize the risk-utility tradeoffs. In this work, we use both specifications to synthesize medical datasets by combining tree-based models of conditional distributions. We compare the quality of the resulting synthetic data using several metrics of risk and utility. Our results indicate no general superiority of either specification over the other. Sequential synthesis seems sensitive to the ordering of the variables, while the fully conditional specification involves more hyperparameters and incurs higher computational costs, which may limit its suitability for off-the-shelf synthesis procedures.
zh_abstract: 以合成数据代替原始数据进行发布，是在遵守开放科学原则的同时强化隐私保护的一种有前景的方法，尤其是在医疗健康领域。为跟上研究人员收集此类数据的速度，需要快速且灵活的合成流程。一类流行的此类流程基于由决策树诱导的条件分布模型。这类模型可以按照两种主要方法组合成合成分布：序贯设定（sequential specification）和全条件设定（fully conditional specification）。然而，目前尚无关于应使用哪种设定来优化风险-效用权衡的建议。在本工作中，我们使用这两种设定，通过组合基于树的条件分布模型来合成医学数据集。我们使用若干风险和效用指标比较所得合成数据的质量。我们的结果表明，两种设定均不存在普遍优于另一种的情况。序贯合成似乎对变量的排序敏感，而全条件设定涉及更多超参数并产生更高的计算成本，这可能限制其适用于现成的合成流程。

title: SAP-ViT: A Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer for Medical Image Classification

summary: 提出以末层图块嵌入直接聚合替代CLS令牌分类的视觉Transformer，使预测可分解为图块级贡献并加稀疏约束。

abstract: Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers commonly rely on a global classification (CLS) token for image-level prediction, which is poorly aligned with local interpretability requirements in medical imaging. We propose SAP-ViT, a Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer that replaces CLS-based classification with direct aggregation of last-layer patch embeddings. This design makes class predictions decomposable into patch-level contributions as part of the forward pass. To encourage concise and readable evidence, SAP-ViT applies sparsity regularization to the patch-weight distribution. Since self-attention mixes information across patch tokens, we further introduce an input-space back-mapping mechanism to estimate which input patches contribute to influential output patch embeddings. We evaluate SAP-ViT qualitatively and quantitatively on multiple medical image classification datasets spanning different imaging modalities. The results show that SAP-ViT maintains strong classification performance while providing consistent and interpretable patch-level explanations across datasets. Ablation results further show that both sparsity regularization and the alignment component of input-space back-mapping contribute to the final explanation quality. Overall, SAP-ViT provides a favorable trade-off between predictive accuracy and interpretability for ViT-based medical image classification.
zh_abstract: Vision Transformer（ViT）分类器通常依赖全局分类（CLS）令牌进行图像级预测，这与医学影像中对局部可解释性的要求匹配不佳。我们提出 SAP-ViT，一种自归因块（Self-Attributing Patch）Vision Transformer，它用最后一层块嵌入的直接聚合替代基于 CLS 的分类。该设计使类别预测作为前向传播的一部分可分解为块级贡献。为鼓励简洁且可读的证据，SAP-ViT 对块权重分布施加稀疏正则化。由于自注意力会在块令牌之间混合信息，我们进一步引入输入空间反向映射机制，以估计哪些输入块对有影响力的输出块嵌入有贡献。我们在跨不同成像模态的多个医学图像分类数据集上对 SAP-ViT 进行定性和定量评估。结果表明，SAP-ViT 在保持强分类性能的同时，跨数据集提供一致且可解释的块级解释。消融结果进一步表明，稀疏正则化和输入空间反向映射的对齐组件都有助于最终解释质量。总体而言，SAP-ViT 为基于 ViT 的医学图像分类在预测准确性与可解释性之间提供了有利的权衡。

title: O2D-MedNet: An Optimization-Aware Dual-Domain Framework for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: O2D-MedNet：优化感知双域医学图像分割框架
summary: arXiv 预印本提出双域医学图像分割框架，用退化感知双域交互与轮廓引导融合模块提升鲁棒性。

CGF 模块跨骨干做轮廓引导融合

abstract: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.
zh_abstract: 医学图像分割（Medical image segmentation, MIS）由于复合退化与多尺度几何变化而仍然具有挑战性，这些因素共同损害病灶-背景可分离性、结构一致性和优化稳定性。现有的单流框架在单一表示路径中纠缠异构线索，而混合流方法通常依赖通用或静态融合，限制了跨域的有效协调，并且未能明确解决优化不稳定性。为克服这些局限，我们提出一种新的面向MIS的优化感知双域框架（O2D-MedNet）。首先，退化感知双域交互（degradation-aware dual-domain interaction, DDI）模块集成傅里叶域和小波域特征，以抑制退化敏感响应，同时保留结构和精细细节信息。其次，跨骨干轮廓引导融合（cross-backbone contour-guided fusion, CGF）模块使基于CNN的局部细节建模与基于视觉状态空间的全局结构建模之间能够进行选择性交互，提高边界准确性和表示一致性。第三，梯度上下文优化（gradient-context optimization, GCO）策略通过基于损失趋势和梯度统计自适应调整学习动态来稳定训练，减轻由类别不平衡和异构样本难度引起的不稳定性。在六个基准上的大量实验表明，在多种成像模态下，相较于最先进的MIS方法取得了一致改进。进一步分析证实了灵敏度、结构一致性和优化稳定性的增强，验证了所提出的O2D-MedNet在异构条件下实现鲁棒MIS的有效性。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Chang Gung Memorial Hospital; conditions: Clinical Competence, Communication Skills, Self Efficacy; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 53; status: COMPLETED] The goal of this study is to compare two methods for teaching psychiatric work-history interviewing to third-year occupational therapy students: practice with a generative AI simulated patient and an expert demonstration video. The main questions it aims to answer are: 1. Which teaching method leads to better interview performance in an objective structured clinical examination (OSCE) with a standardized patient? 2. How do the two methods affect students' interview self-efficacy? 3. How do students evaluate the two methods, and which learning sequence do they prefer? Students enrolled in a required vocational rehabilitation course were randomly assigned to one of two sequences. In the first teaching week, one sequence practiced interviewing a GPT-4o-based simulated patient (a 35-year-old person with schizophrenia), and the other watched and discussed an expert demonstration interview of the same case. Both groups completed a 9-minute standardized-patient OSCE on the same day. In the following week, the two sequences crossed over to the other method. Interview self-efficacy was measured before teaching, after the first method, and after the second method.

abstract: Deep learning shows promise for breast cancer diagnosis, but limited interpretability hinders clinical adoption. We benchmark ten ImageNet-pretrained models (ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT, and Swin Transformer) for benign-versus-malignant classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset using a patient-level split, and explain their predictions with Grad-CAM, LIME, Integrated Gradients, and LRP. DenseNet121 performed best, with 99.4% test accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 0.999, and significantly outperformed all other models (p < 0.001). Transformer-based models trailed the CNNs. The explanations consistently highlighted nuclei-rich and glandular regions of diagnostic relevance. Combining transfer learning with explainable AI can thus yield accurate, interpretable tools for breast cancer diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 深度学习在乳腺癌诊断中显示出前景，但可解释性有限阻碍了临床采用。我们在 BreakHis 组织病理学数据集上，使用患者级划分，对十个 ImageNet 预训练模型（ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet、ConvNeXt、ViT 和 Swin Transformer）进行良性与恶性分类基准测试，并用 Grad-CAM、LIME、Integrated Gradients 和 LRP 解释其预测。DenseNet121 表现最佳，测试准确率为 99.4%，AUC-ROC 为 0.999，并显著优于所有其他模型（p < 0.001）。基于 Transformer 的模型落后于 CNN。解释一致突出显示具有诊断相关性的富细胞核区域和腺体区域。因此，将迁移学习与可解释 AI 相结合，可产生用于乳腺癌诊断的准确、可解释工具。

title: The application value of artificial intelligence in medical imaging: foundations, progress, and challenges.

abstract: [Medical review (2021)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming medical imaging, reshaping the field as it does everyday life. As imaging data grow in complexity and clinical workloads continue to rise, AI has become increasingly essential for improving diagnostic efficiency and precision. However, despite these technical advances, the clinical adoption of AI in medical imaging remains fragmented, with limited generalizability, insufficient interpretability, and unclear clinical responsibility. In this review, we critically examine the evolution of AI in medical imaging, with a particular focus on its functional roles across the imaging workflow and its actual contributions to contemporary clinical needs. We systematically analyze current application paradigms, identify methodological and translational bottlenecks, and discuss emerging strategies to improve model robustness, interpretability, and clinical integration. In addition, we identify key barriers to the practical implementation of AI in medical imaging, including challenges related to cross-domain generalizability, data privacy issues and regulatory compliance. By examining these opportunities and challenges, this review aims to guide future research directions and foster deeper interdisciplinary collaboration among AI, clinical medicine, and biomedical engineering.
zh_abstract: 【医学综述（2021）】人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变医学影像，正如它改变日常生活一样重塑该领域。随着影像数据复杂性增加和临床工作量持续上升，AI在提高诊断效率和精确性方面变得越来越重要。然而，尽管有这些技术进步，AI在医学影像中的临床采用仍然碎片化，存在泛化能力有限、可解释性不足和临床责任不明确的问题。在这篇综述中，我们批判性地审视AI在医学影像中的演进，特别关注其在影像工作流程中的功能角色及其对当代临床需求的实际贡献。我们系统分析当前应用范式，识别方法和转化瓶颈，并讨论提高模型稳健性、可解释性和临床整合的新兴策略。此外，我们识别AI在医学影像中实际实施的关键障碍，包括跨域泛化能力、数据隐私问题和监管合规相关挑战。通过审视这些机遇与挑战，本综述旨在指导未来研究方向，并促进AI、临床医学和生物医学工程之间更深入的跨学科合作。

title: AntiOxiPred: Predicting Antioxidant Peptides using Machine Learning Techniques and BLAST
zh_title: AntiOxiPred：机器学习预测抗氧化肽
summary: 基于1511条实验验证抗氧化肽与1511条非抗氧化肽，构建结合BLAST与机器学习的预测方法。
key_points: 数据集含1511条实验验证抗氧化肽
训练集2417条、测试集606条
采用CatBoost与融合特征
reason: 小数据集预印本，仅内部测试，方法增量
abstract: Antioxidant peptides (AOPs) offer significant therapeutic potential in counteracting oxidative damage associated with chronic diseases. As AOPs gain market traction in cosmeceuticals, functional foods, and clinical trials for disease intervention, efficient computational methods are essential to accelerate their discovery. In this study, a systematic attempt has been made to develop a highly accurate and reliable method for predicting AOPs from their primary sequences. The dataset comprises 1,511 experimentally validated AOPs and 1,511 randomly generated non-AOPs, partitioned into 2,417 sequences for training and 606 for testing. First, we developed machine learning-based models using one-hot encoded (OHE) representations, sequence-derived compositional features, protein language model (PLM) embeddings, and feature fusion. Our CatBoost model, developed using selected fused features, achieved the best performance, with an AUC of 0.945 and an MCC of 0.788 on the independent testing dataset. An ensemble model combining CatBoost with BLAST achieved a peak AUC of 0.956 on the same testing dataset. Furthermore, our method outperformed existing state-of-the-art predictors when benchmarked on two external validation datasets comprising 150 peptides (75 AOPs and 75 non-AOPs) and 248 peptides (124 AOPs and 124 non-AOPs). AntiOxiPred (https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/antioxipred/) is freely available as an interactive web server, a standalone package, and a pip-installable tool to support the scientific community.
zh_abstract: 抗氧化肽（AOP）在对抗与慢性疾病相关的氧化损伤方面具有显著治疗潜力。随着 AOP 在药妆品、功能性食品和疾病干预临床试验中获得市场关注，高效计算方法对于加速其发现至关重要。本研究系统性地尝试开发一种高度准确且可靠的方法，从一级序列预测 AOP。数据集包含1,511个经实验验证的 AOP 和1,511个随机生成的非 AOP，其中2,417条序列用于训练，606条用于测试。首先，我们使用独热编码（OHE）表示、序列衍生的组成特征、蛋白质语言模型（PLM）嵌入和特征融合开发了基于机器学习的模型。我们使用选定融合特征开发的 CatBoost 模型表现最佳，在独立测试数据集上 AUC 为0.945，MCC 为0.788。将 CatBoost 与 BLAST 结合的集成模型在同一测试数据集上达到峰值 AUC 0.956。此外，在两个外部验证数据集（分别包含150条肽[75个 AOP 和75个非 AOP]和248条肽[124个 AOP 和124个非 AOP]）上进行基准测试时，我们的方法优于现有最先进预测器。AntiOxiPred（https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/antioxipred/）作为交互式网络服务器、独立软件包和可通过 pip 安装的工具免费提供，以支持科学界。

title: Predicting Protein-Protein Interactions Using Vectorized Sequence Descriptors and Machine Learning Classifiers
zh_title: 用向量化序列描述符与机器学习分类器预测蛋白质相互作用
summary: 预印本提出可解释机器学习框架，融合自协方差、联合三联与局部描述符特征，用SVM、随机森林和XGBoost预测蛋白质相互作用。
key_points: 融合120维AC、686维CT与1820维LD序列特征
采用分层五折交叉验证评估
报告交叉验证最高准确率97.97%
reason: 经典机器学习+仅交叉验证、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) is fundamental for elucidating cellular mechanisms and accelerating drug discovery. Although experimental techniques provide extensive interaction maps, their high cost and time requirements necessitate robust computational alternatives. In this study, we present an interpretable machine-learning framework that integrates sequence-derived descriptors, specifically 120 Auto-Covariance (AC) features, 686 Conjoint Triad (CT) features, and 1,820 Local Descriptors (LD) features, with classical classification algorithms, including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests (RF), and XGBoost (XGB). Evaluated on a gold-standard sequence-based PPI benchmark dataset using stratified five-fold cross-validation, the models achieved robust classification accuracies: 86.92% (SVM), 97.75% (RF), and a peak cross-validation accuracy of 97.97% with XGBoost (Rec: 98.09%, Pr: 98.10%, F1: 98.09%). Furthermore, rigorous evaluation on an independent unseen (Human-PPI) test set demonstrated exceptional generalization capabilities. The Random Forest model emerged as the top-performing architecture, yielding an outstanding accuracy of 99.51%, a precision of 99.72%, a recall of 99.29%, an F1-score of 99.50%, an Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.9990, and an Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC) of 0.9989 (closely followed by XGBoost with 98.54% accuracy, AUROC 0.9979, and AUPRC 0.9974). Feature-importance analysis revealed that short-range physicochemical correlations (such as polarity and hydrophobicity lags in Protein 2), regional amino-acid compositions, and specific triad patterns (e.g., A/G/V-M/S/T/YM/S/T/Y) drive accurate PPI discrimination. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of domain-informed, handcrafted sequence features combined with machine-learning classifiers for PPI prediction, providing biologically interpretable insights with minimal computational overhead and enabling efficient, scalable interactome screening.
zh_abstract: 准确预测蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）是阐明细胞机制和加速药物发现的基础。尽管实验技术提供了广泛的相互作用图谱，但其高成本和时间需求使得稳健的计算替代方法成为必要。在本研究中，我们提出一个可解释的机器学习框架，该框架将序列衍生描述符，具体为 120 个自协方差（AC）特征、686 个联合三元组（CT）特征和 1,820 个局部描述符（LD）特征，与经典分类算法整合，包括支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林（RF）和 XGBoost（XGB）。在基于序列的金标准 PPI 基准数据集上采用分层五折交叉验证进行评估，这些模型取得了稳健的分类准确率：86.92%（SVM）、97.75%（RF），XGBoost 达到峰值交叉验证准确率 97.97%（Rec：98.09%，Pr：98.10%，F1：98.09%）。此外，在一个独立的未见（Human-PPI）测试集上进行严格评估，显示出卓越的泛化能力。随机森林模型成为表现最佳的架构，取得出色的准确率 99.51%、精确率 99.72%、召回率 99.29%、F1 分数 99.50%、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.9990，以及精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）0.9989（紧随其后的是 XGBoost，准确率 98.54%、AUROC 0.9979、AUPRC 0.9974）。特征重要性分析揭示，短程物理化学相关性（如 Protein 2 中的极性和疏水性滞后）、区域氨基酸组成以及特定三元组模式（例如 A/G/V-M/S/T/YM/S/T/Y）驱动了准确的 PPI 判别。这些发现证明了领域知识驱动的手工序列特征与机器学习分类器结合用于 PPI 预测的有效性，提供了具有生物学可解释性的见解，且计算开销极小，并能够实现高效、可扩展的相互作用组筛选。
